Adjusting the level of the machine tool

sections.text: 2) Special accessories to expand the use performance of the machine tool shall be supplied according to the technical agreement according to user requirements.
4. Safety and Hygiene

items: The safety of the electrical system shall conform to the provisions of GB 5226.1—2008 (replaced by GB/T 5226.1—2019).
The safety of the hydraulic system shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 23572—2009.

In addition to conforming to the provisions of GB 15760—2004, the safety protection of the machine tool shall also conform to the following requirements: ① The grinding rod box carriage of the machine tool should be equipped with an insurance device for the limit position, and the transmission system of the machine tool should be equipped with an overload protection device. ② When the machine tool stops (or power failure) during operation, the stopping of independent feed motion should not be later than the main motion. ③ When emergency stop or power system failure occurs, the clamping system should not lose its function.

The overall noise of the machine tool shall be inspected according to the provisions of GB/T 16769—2008 (already repealed). Under no-load operation conditions, the overall noise sound pressure level of the machine tool should not exceed 85dB(A).

sections.text: 5. Processing and Assembly Quality

items: The bed, spindle box, and grinding rod box are important castings and should be subjected to aging treatment after rough machining.
Gears, racks, worm gears, worms, rotating positioning pins and other main parts that are prone to wear should take wear-resistant measures adapted to their service life.
The guide rail pair between the grinding rod box carriage and the bed is a rolling guide rail pair, and wear-resistant measures adapted to its service life should be taken.
Important fixed joints should be tightly fitted, and should not be inserted when inspected with a 0.04 mm feeler gauge after tightening.

sections.text: The following joints shall be evaluated according to the requirements of important fixed joints: ① Joint surface between grinding rod box and carriage ② Joint surface between spindle box and bed ③ Joint surface between grinding rod guide frame and bed 5) When the joint surface of two mating parts processed by mechanical processing method is inspected by coloring method, the contact should be uniform, and the contact index should not be lower than the provisions of Table 3-11.

sections.caption: Table 3-11  Contact Index of Joint Surface

sections.text: 6) The support of welded parts shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 23570—2009, and important welded components shall be subjected to non-destructive testing, and should not have cracks.

7) The cleanliness of the machine tool after final assembly shall be inspected according to the provisions of GB/T 25374—2010. Generally, visual inspection and hand feeling method are used for inspection. There should be no obvious miscellaneous dirt in each part. When necessary, random inspection by weight method is used, and the limit of miscellaneous dirt is: the spindle box should not exceed 400mg/L; the hydraulic system should not exceed 150mg/L.
6. No-Load Operation Test of Machine Tool
(1) Temperature Rise Test and Inspection of Main Motion and Feed Motion

items: The main motion (including grinding rod box) mechanism of the machine tool should start from the lowest speed, and run in sequence. For the machine tool with stepless speed change, no less than 10 kinds of speeds including low, medium and high speeds should be run; for the machine tool with stepped speed change, no-load operation test should be carried out from the lowest to the highest level by level. The running time of each gear speed should not be less than 2 min, and the running time at the highest speed should not be less than 1 h, so that the spindle bearing reaches a stable temperature, and the temperature and temperature rise are measured near the spindle center bearing, and the temperature should not exceed 60℃, and the temperature rise should not exceed 30℃. During operation at various speeds, the operation should be stable, and the working mechanism should be normal and reliable.

The moving parts on each linear axis are respectively subjected to no-load operation test at low, medium and high feed speeds and fast speed, and the movement should be stable and reliable, with no vibration at high speed and no obvious crawling at low speed.

Under no-load operation conditions, the actual deviation of spindle speed and feed speed at each level of stepped transmission should not exceed -2%~6% of the set value; the actual deviation of spindle speed and feed speed of stepless transmission should not exceed ±10% of the set value.
The no-load power of the main transmission system of the machine tool (excluding the no-load power of the main motor) should not exceed the provisions of the design document.

sections.text: (2) Function Test of Machine Tool

items: Manual function test (test the parts of the machine tool by manual or CNC manual operation). ① Use medium speed to continuously perform 10 times of starting, stopping (including braking) and orienting operation test on the main shaft in forward and reverse directions, and the action should be stable and reliable.

sections.text: flexible and reliable.

items: ② For a continuously variable speed spindle, speed change operation tests should be conducted at low, medium, and high speeds. For a stepped speed spindle, tests should be conducted at each speed level. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

③ For the moving parts along each linear axis, continuous start-stop operation tests should be conducted 10 times in both forward and reverse directions at medium feed rate. Incremental feed tests should also be conducted in both forward and reverse directions. The operation should be flexible, reliable, and accurate.

④ For the feed system, at least 10 speed change operation tests should be conducted within the low, medium, and high feed rate ranges and the rapid traverse range. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

⑤ For the machine tool's numerical control functions such as indicator lights, control buttons, DNC communication transmission equipment, and temperature control devices, no-load operation tests should be conducted. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

⑥ For the machine tool's safety, insurance, and protection devices, as well as the control, interlocking, and protection functions of the electrical system, necessary tests should be conducted. The functions should be reliable, and the operation should be flexible and accurate.

⑦ For the machine tool's hydraulic, lubrication, cooling, and pneumatic systems, operation tests should be conducted. The machine tool should be well-sealed, adequately cooled, and well-lubricated, with flexible and reliable operation. No leakage should occur in any of the systems.
⑧ For the machine tool's various auxiliary devices, tests should be conducted. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

sections.text: 2) Numerical Control Function Test (Using numerical control programs to operate the machine tool's components for testing).

items: ① Using medium speed, continuous start-stop (including braking) and positioning operation tests should be conducted 10 times in both forward and reverse directions for the spindle. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

② For a continuously variable speed spindle, speed change operation tests should be conducted at low, medium, and high speeds. For a stepped speed spindle, tests should be conducted at each speed level. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

③ For the moving parts along each linear axis, continuous start-stop and incremental feed operation tests should be conducted in both forward and reverse directions at medium feed rate. The operation should be flexible, reliable, and accurate.
④ For the feed system, at least low, medium, and high feed rate and rapid traverse speed change operation tests should be conducted. The operation should be flexible and reliable.

⑤ For the various instructions that the machine tool is capable of, such as program pause and emergency stop, as well as the clamping and unclamping of related components and tools, and the start and stop of hydraulic, cooling, pneumatic, and lubrication systems, numerical control function tests should be conducted one by one. The functions should be reliable, and the operation should be flexible and accurate.

sections.text: (3) Continuous No-Load Operation Test for the Machine Tool
1) The continuous no-load operation test should be conducted after the manual function test and numerical control function test, and before the precision inspection.

2) The continuous no-load operation test should use a numerical control program that includes various main functions of the machine tool to operate the machine tool's components for continuous no-load operation. The total continuous no-load operation time should not be less than 48 hours.

3) Throughout the entire continuous no-load operation process, the machine tool's operation should be normal, smooth, and reliable, without any malfunctions. Otherwise, the operation should be repeated.
4) The continuous no-load operation program should include the following content:

items: ① The spindle speed should include more than 5 types of forward rotation, reverse rotation, stop, and positioning at low, medium, and high speeds. Generally, the high-speed operation time should not be less than 10% of the time used by each cycle program.

② The feed rate should combine the movement of components along each axis at low, medium, and high speeds and rapid traverse in both forward and reverse directions, running within the full stroke range. Arbitrary points can be selected for positioning. The use of the magnification switch is not allowed during operation. The time for high feed rate and rapid traverse should not be less than 10% of the time used by each cycle program.
③ Coordinated operation of each linked axis.
④ Operation of special attachments.
⑤ The pause time for each cycle program should not exceed 0.5 minutes.

sections.text: 7. Load Test for the Machine Tool
(1) Test of Maximum Torque of the Main Drive System

1) Within the constant torque speed range of the machine tool spindle, select an appropriate spindle speed and conduct the test using the grinding method. Change the feed rate or grinding depth to make the main drive system of the machine tool reach the maximum torque specified in the design.
2) The test piece material is 45 steel, and the cutting tool is a honing head.

3) During the test, the transmission system and speed change mechanism of the machine tool should work normally and reliably, with smooth and accurate operation. For machine tools produced in batches, the test can be conducted at 2/3 of the maximum cutting torque, but periodic spot checks of the maximum torque should be conducted.
(2) Test of Main Drive System Reaching Maximum Power (Spot Check)

1) Within the constant power speed range of the machine tool, select an appropriate spindle speed and conduct the test using the grinding method. Change the feed rate or grinding depth to make the main motor of the machine tool reach the rated power or the maximum power specified in the design.
2) The test piece material is 45 steel, and the cutting tool is a honing head.
3) During the test, the transmission system and speed change mechanism of the machine tool should work normally and reliably, with smooth operation and no obvious vibration.
8. Minimum Setting Unit Test
(1) Test Method

First, use rapid traverse to move the moving parts along the linear axis a certain distance in the positive (or negative) direction, stop, then give a number of instructions for the minimum setting unit in the same direction, and stop again. Use this position as the reference position, give one instruction each time, and give a total of 20 instructions for the minimum setting unit in the same direction, moving the parts. Measure the stopping position of each instruction. From the final position mentioned above, continue to give a number of instructions for the minimum setting unit in the same direction, stop, then give a number of instructions for the minimum setting unit in the negative (or positive) direction to make the moving parts return to approximately the above final measurement position. The stopping positions of these positive and negative instructions for the minimum setting unit are not measured. Then, starting from the above final position, give one instruction each time, and give a total of 20 instructions for the minimum setting unit in the same direction, moving the parts. Measure the stopping position of each instruction.

Issue one, a total of 20 minimum setting unit commands are given, so that it continues to move in the negative (or positive) direction, and the stop position of each command is measured, as shown in Figure 1 of JB/T 12403.2-2015 (or refer to Figure 3-2, where only Li is used instead of θi). Each linear axis should be tested at least at three positions in the middle of the stroke and near both ends. Calculation is performed according to formulas (3-8) and (3-9), and the maximum error value at the three positions is taken as the error for this item.
(2) Error Calculation
1) The minimum setting unit error Sa is calculated according to formula (3-8).
Sa = Li - m    (3-8)

Where Sa — minimum setting unit error, in mm; Li — actual displacement of one minimum setting unit command (if the direction of actual displacement is opposite to the given direction, the displacement Li is negative), in mm; m — theoretical displacement of one minimum setting unit command, in mm.
2) The minimum setting unit relative error Sb is calculated according to formula (3-9).
Where Sb — minimum setting unit relative error (%); ∑(i=1 to 20) Li — sum of actual displacements of 20 consecutive minimum setting unit commands, in mm.
3) Tolerance. Sa shall be in accordance with the manufacturer's design specifications, and Sb shall not exceed 25%.
4) Inspection tools. Laser interferometer or reading microscope and metal line scale.
9. Return to Origin Test

Test method: The moving parts of each linear axis perform 5 return-to-origin Po tests at high speed in the same moving direction from any point on the stroke. Measure the deviation Xio (i = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) of each actual position Pio from the theoretical position Po, as shown in Figure 2 of JB/T 12403.2-2015 (or refer to Figure 3-3). Each linear axis should be tested at least at three arbitrary positions in the middle of the stroke and near both ends, and the error is calculated based on the maximum error value at the three positions.

Error calculation. The return-to-origin error is calculated as four times the maximum estimated value of the standard uncertainty of the return-to-origin deviation obtained through calculations at at least three test positions on each linear axis, see formula (3-10).

Where Ro — return-to-origin error, in mm; So — estimated value of the standard uncertainty of the return-to-origin deviation (So is calculated according to the relevant formulas in GB/T 17421.2), in mm.
3) Tolerance. According to the manufacturer's design specifications.
4) Inspection tools. Laser interferometer or reading microscope and metal line scale.
10. Machine Tool Accuracy Inspection

items: The machine tool accuracy inspection shall be conducted according to the provisions of JB/T 12403.1-2015.
The inspection of G9, G14, G19, G20, and working accuracy M1 in the machine tool accuracy inspection shall be carried out when the machine tool reaches a stable medium temperature.
During the machine tool working accuracy inspection, the maximum allowable surface roughness Ra of the finished workpiece is 6.3μm.

sections.text: 11. Packaging and Random Documents

items: The machine tool shall be rust-proofed before packaging.
The packaging of the machine tool shall comply with the packaging design drawings and technical documents.
The machine tool packaged in separate boxes shall comply with the packing list.

The technical documents provided with the machine tool shall include the instruction manual, qualification certificate, packing list, etc., and it is advisable to provide two sets of random documents.

sections.text: 3.1.5 Vertical inner circular honing machine and honing head

JB/T 7422.3-2006 "Vertical inner circular honing machine Part 3: Technical Conditions" specifies the technical requirements for design, manufacturing, inspection and acceptance of vertical inner circular honing machines, applicable to vertical inner circular honing machines with maximum honing diameter φ25-φ1000mm. JB/T 7422.4-2013 "Vertical inner circular honing machine Part 4: Honing head Parameters" specifies the parameters of honing heads for vertical inner circular honing machines, applicable to honing heads for newly designed ordinary, semi-automatic and CNC vertical inner circular honing machines.

sections.text: 2) Empty Running Test of Machine Tool

① All joints or exposed joints of the hydraulic, pneumatic, cooling, and lubrication systems and other parts of the machine tool should not leak (seep) oil, leak (seep) water, or leak (seep) air. The coolant should not be mixed into the hydraulic system and the lubrication system.

② The main motion mechanism of the machine tool should run from the lowest speed in sequence, and the running time of each speed level should not be less than 2 min. For machine tools with stepless speed regulation, low, medium, and high-speed running can be performed. At the highest speed, it should run for a sufficient time (not less than 1 h) to make the spindle bearing reach a stable temperature. The temperature and temperature rise of the bearing should be measured near the spindle bearing, and their values should not exceed the regulations in Table 3-20.

sections.text: 3.1.6  External Cylindrical Grinder

JB/T7418.1—2019 'External cylindrical grinder Part 1: Type and parameters' specifies the type and parameters of general-purpose external cylindrical grinder, which is applicable to the newly designed worktable mobile and grinding wheel frame mobile external cylindrical grinder. JB/T7418.2—2015 'External cylindrical grinder Part 2: Technical conditions' specifies the manufacturing and acceptance requirements of general-purpose external cylindrical grinder, which is applicable to ordinary precision grade worktable mobile external cylindrical grinder, universal external cylindrical grinder, maximum grinding diameter of 50~800mm, maximum grinding length of 150~5000mm; precision grade, high precision grade worktable mobile external cylindrical grinder, universal external cylindrical grinder, maximum grinding diameter of 50~800mm, maximum grinding length of 150~5000mm; ordinary precision grade worktable mobile end face external cylindrical grinder, maximum grinding diameter of 50~500mm, maximum grinding length of 150~3000mm; ordinary precision grade grinding wheel frame mobile external cylindrical grinder, maximum grinding diameter of 500~2000mm, maximum grinding length of 5000~15000mm. JB/T7418.3—2014 'External cylindrical grinder Part 3: High precision machine tool accuracy inspection' specifies the inspection methods and corresponding tolerances of geometric accuracy, working accuracy, positioning accuracy and repetitive positioning accuracy of high-precision worktable mobile external cylindrical grinder, universal external cylindrical grinder and end face external cylindrical grinder, which is applicable to high-precision external cylindrical grinder, high-precision universal external cylindrical grinder with maximum grinding diameter of 50~800mm and maximum grinding length of 150~4000mm, and high-precision end face external cylindrical grinder with maximum grinding diameter of 50~500mm and maximum grinding length of 150~3000mm.

items: The reciprocating moving parts such as worktable or pallet and grinding wheel frame with inertial impact should be provided with limit insurance devices to prevent collision, and safety measures should be taken to prevent collision for fast approach of grinding wheel frame (such as setting buffer devices, etc.).

Safety interlock devices should be set for workpiece rotation, tailstock foot pedal hydraulic cylinder or motorized tailstock sleeve movement, grinding wheel frame fast movement, etc. to control the action sequence.
Bed guide rail, grinding wheel frame pad plate guide rail should be provided with safety protection devices to prevent chips and cutting fluid from splashing into the guide rail surface.

There should be no abnormal sharp noise and impact noise when the machine tool is running. Under no-load running conditions, the noise of the machine tool should be tested according to the provisions of GB/T 16769—2008 (has been repealed), and the noise sound pressure level of the machine tool should not be greater than the provisions of Table 3-27.

(4) Processing and Assembly Inspection

items: Important castings of the machine tool (bed, base plate, upper and lower worktables, or apron, etc.) should undergo aging treatment after rough machining. For precision and high-precision machine tools, important castings should also undergo secondary aging treatment after semi-finish machining.

Spindles of the headstock, wheel spindle, sleeve of the tailstock, screws, gears, and other easily worn parts should generally adopt wear-resistant measures that are commensurate with their service life.

The bed guide and wheel spindle guide are important guide pairs and should adopt wear-resistant measures such as wear-resistant cast iron, rolling guides, inlaid steel guides, and plastic-coated guides that are commensurate with their service life.

The following mating surfaces should be assessed according to the requirements of "Particularly Important Fixed Mating Surfaces" in GB/T 25373—2010: ① Mating surfaces of combined beds. ② Mating surfaces between the wheel spindle base plate and the bed or apron. ③ Mating surfaces between the cover plate and the wheel spindle housing (only applicable to machine tools with the internal grinding tool support mounted on the wheel spindle cover plate). ④ Mating surfaces between the internal grinding tool support and its mating parts. ⑤ Mating surfaces between the headstock housing and its mating rotating base. ⑥ Mating surfaces between the wheel spindle housing and its mating rotating base. ⑦ Mating surfaces between the upper and lower worktables. ⑧ Mating surfaces between the upper worktable pressure plate and the upper and lower worktables (except for special structures).
The guide rails of the worktable or pallet, wheel spindle guide, and their mating parts should be assessed according to the requirements of "Hydrostatic, Sliding Guide Rails" in GB/T 25373—2010.

The guide rails of the worktable guide surface or workpiece bed and the mating head and tailstock guides should be assessed according to the requirements of "Relocated Guide Rails" in GB/T 25373—2010.

sections.text: (5) Bench Lathe No-Load Test
1) Temperature and Temperature Rise Test of Lathe

① The spindle of the wheel frame (with wheel) should undergo a no-load test run, starting from the lowest speed and running sequentially to the highest speed or the highest speed specified in the design. It should run for at least 1 h at the highest speed to stabilize the temperature of the spindle bearing of the wheel frame. For ordinary precision lathes, the temperature and temperature rise of the spindle sliding bearing should be checked in the oil pool of the wheel frame, and the temperature should not exceed 55°C, and the temperature rise should not exceed 25°C. The temperature and temperature rise of the bearing should be checked at the outer shell near the rolling bearing of the spindle of the wheel frame, and the temperature should not exceed 65°C, and the temperature rise should not exceed 35°C. The temperature and temperature rise of precision and high-precision lathes are specified by the design.

② In the temperature rise test of the hydraulic system, the method of measuring the temperature and temperature rise of the oil in the bed body oil pool (or separate oil tank oil pool) should conform to GB/T 23572-2009.
2) Test of Main Motion and Feed Motion
① The speed deviation of the grinding wheel spindle under no-load condition should not exceed -5% to 0% of the design specified value.

② The speed deviation of the main shaft of the headstock and other parts under no-load conditions: For stepless speed change transmission, it is ±5% of the design specified value (speed label) (sampling inspection); for stepless speed change transmission, it is ±10% of the design specified value (speed table has digital position point).

③ The operation status of the main shaft of the headstock and other parts under no-load conditions: There is no impact and abnormal vibration during high-speed operation; there is no crawling and oscillation during low-speed operation.

④ The linear motion parts of the lathe should undergo a no-load test run at low, medium, and high feed speeds respectively. When the moving parts move, they should be stable, flexible, and reliable, without obvious crawling and vibration.
⑤ The relative error of the lateral feed of the non-CNC wheel frame generally should not exceed the provisions of Table 3-33.
3) Power Test of Wheel Frame No-Load

The power of the wheel frame (with wheel) no-load should not exceed 115% of the wheel frame motor no-load power index. When the wheel frame motor no-load power index has not been determined, the wheel frame motor no-load power can be assessed as not greater than 25% of the rated power, or it can be specified by the design.

Ten sets of wheel frames with better assembly support can be selected to measure their no-load power (the motor no-load power should be deducted during measurement level inspection), and the average value is taken as the wheel frame motor no-load running power index.
4) Test of Lathe Function
① Manual Function Test (test of each part of the lathe operated manually or by CNC manual mode).

a. The spindle of the headstock or wheel frame is subjected to a manual operation test of 10 starts and stops at medium speed or the designed speed, and the action should be flexible and reliable; for the spindle with stepless speed change, the speed change operation test should be performed at the low, medium, and high speeds specified in the design, and the action should be flexible and reliable.

b. The workbench or carriage and other linear motion parts are subjected to 10 consecutive starts and stops in the forward and reverse directions at medium speed. The flexibility and reliability of the test action.

c. Each control button corresponding to the manual function of the lathe numerical control system should be tested one by one, and the action should be flexible and reliable, and the indicator light should display correctly and reliably.
② Automatic Function Test (test of each part of the lathe operated by automatic program).

a. The spindle of the headstock or wheel frame is subjected to an automatic operation test of 10 starts and stops at medium speed or the designed speed, and the action should be flexible and reliable. For the spindle with stepless speed change, the speed change automatic operation test should be performed at the low, medium, and high speeds specified in the design, and the action should be flexible and reliable.

b. For each linear motion part, an automatic operation test of starting, stopping, and incremental feeding in the forward and reverse directions should be performed continuously at medium feed rate or the designed speed; the automatic operation test of speed change of the feed system at low, medium, and high feed speeds and fast speed should be performed, and the action should be flexible, reliable, and correct.
c. Each function of the lathe linkage, positioning, and numerical control system linear compensation, grinding cycle, etc. should be tested, and its action should be reliable, flexible, and correct.

After lateral feed grinding until no sparks are produced, perform continuous unidirectional feed 5 times according to the following feed rates: When the maximum grinding diameter is less than or equal to 125 mm, the feed rate is 0.005 mm; when greater than 125 mm, it is 0.01 mm. sections.text: (7) Machine Tool Accuracy Testing

items: The accuracy testing of ordinary grade worktable moving type external cylindrical grinders should be conducted according to the provisions of GB/T 4685-2007 "External Cylindrical Grinders - Accuracy Testing"; precision grade machines should be tested according to JB/T 7418.3-2014; ordinary grade wheel head moving type external cylindrical grinders should be tested according to the provisions of JB/T 7418.4-2014 "External Cylindrical Grinders Part 4: Wheel Head Moving Type Machines - Accuracy Testing".

3.2.1 Integrity of Mechanical Manufacturing Process Documents

In GB/T24738-2009 'Integrity of Mechanical Manufacturing Process Documents', according to the production type and product complexity, the integrity requirements of commonly used process documents are specified, which are applicable to the process management of mechanical manufacturing enterprises.

items: General Requirements: 1) Process documents are the main basis for guiding workers' operations and for production and process management. They should be correct, complete, unified, and clear. 2) The types and contents of process documents should vary according to the production characteristics, production type, and product complexity. 3) The production characteristics of products include prototype trial production, small batch trial production, and formal mass production. Prototype trial production mainly verifies the product design structure, and the integrity of process documents is not required. Each enterprise can determine according to specific conditions; small batch trial production mainly verifies the process, so the process documents of small batch trial production should be basically the same as those of formal mass production, except that the latter is more perfect after being modified and supplemented through the small batch trial production process.

3. Basic Requirements for Designing Process Specifications

1) Process specifications are important technical documents that directly guide on-site production operations. They should be correct, complete, unified, and clear.
2) Based on full utilization of the existing production conditions of the enterprise, adopt advanced process technologies and experiences from both domestic and international sources as much as possible.
3) While ensuring product quality, strive to improve productivity and reduce consumption.
4) Designing process specifications must consider safety and industrial hygiene measures.
5) Parts with similar structural characteristics and process characteristics should be designed with typical process specifications as much as possible.
6) Process specifications from various specialties should be consistent and coordinated during the design process, without contradictions.
7) The format, layout, and filling method of process specifications should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9165.2—1998 "Format of Process Specifications".
8) The terms, symbols, and codes used in process specifications should comply with the relevant standards.
9) The units of measurement in process specifications should all use legal units.
10) The numbering of process specifications should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9166—1998 "Numbering Method for Process Documents".

sections.text: 6. Approval Procedures for Process Programs
(1) Review

1) The review of process procedures is generally conducted by the product's chief process engineer or the process group leader. For critical process procedures, the review can be conducted by the chief of the process department (section).
2) The main contents of the review:

items: Whether the arrangement of processes and process requirements are reasonable.
Whether the selected equipment and process tooling are reasonable.

sections.text: (2) Standardization Review
Refer to JB/T 9169.7—1998 "Guidelines for Process Management - Standardization Review of Process Documents" for standardization review.
(3) Joint Review
1) After the process procedure has been reviewed and subjected to standardization review, it should be sent to the relevant production workshop for joint review.
2) The main contents of the joint review:

items: Based on the production capacity of the workshop, review whether the processing or assembly content arranged in the process procedure can be realized in the workshop.
Whether the equipment and process tooling selected in the process procedure are reasonable.

sections.text: (4) Approval

After the joint review, the complete set of process procedures is generally approved by the chief of the process department (section). For process procedures of products produced in batches and critical products produced individually, approval should be given by the chief process engineer or chief engineer.

sections.text: 3) Hydraulic cylinders should undergo a pressure test at 25×1.5 MPa, with a holding time of 10 seconds during factory testing.
4) The pressure test for the rodless chamber should be conducted with the collision block serving as the cylinder stroke limiter.
5) The travel positioning accuracy and travel repeat positioning accuracy tests should be performed according to the enterprise standard's test methods and inspection rules.
6) The surface of the hydraulic cylinder can be painted according to user requirements, but it should have a rust prevention capability of at least 6 months.

7) After testing, dust-proof plugs should be installed on all oil port connections, protective sleeves on the input shaft of the travel adjustment device, protective covers on the spherical connections and threaded holes at the piston rod end, and the piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder should be in a fully retracted state. If necessary, additional devices can be used to fix the piston rod to the cylinder body.
8) The markings on the packaging box should match the nameplate, and the hydraulic cylinder is allowed to be placed horizontally as specified.

sections.text: Technical requirements for the parts diagram of the cylinder body are as follows:

items: After forging, the forging should undergo heat treatment to reduce or eliminate forging stress and provide good machining performance. The hardness after stress relief should be 170-210 HBW.
The mechanical properties of the quenched and quenched and tempered forging should be Rm ≥ 590 MPa, ReL ≥ 345 MPa, and hardness 28-32 HRC.

The forging should not have visible cracks, folds, or other appearance defects affecting use. It should not have white spots, internal cracks, or residual shrinkage cavities. Defects exceeding the machining allowance and forging dimensional tolerances must be removed and welded only with the consent of Party A.

The tolerance grade for unmarked linear dimensions is m level, for unmarked fillet radii and chamfer heights is m level, for unmarked angles is m level, and for unmarked geometric tolerances is K level.
Unmarked chamfers are 2×45°, and for each sealing groove, the bottom fillet radius and groove edge fillet radius are R ≤ 0.2 mm.
The perpendicularity tolerance for the 8×M20-6H threaded hole to the mounting surface is 0.10 mm.
The two ports are allowed to be processed according to GB/T19674.1-2005 and sealed with combination seals specified in JB982.
The cylinder body must be demagnetized after grinding.
No scoring marks are allowed on each surface, especially the mounting surface. No bumps or scratches are allowed. Pay attention to rust prevention between processes.
Surface coating or pre-treatment should be performed according to user requirements.
The cylinder body should undergo a pressure test at 25×1.5 MPa, with a holding time of 10 seconds during factory testing.
The uncoated surface of the finished product should be coated with rust preventive oil and stored vertically, with attention to protecting each end face.

sections.text: 2. Design description of adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder

The WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder is designed to be used with the WC67Y-100T/(2500, 3200, 4000) synchronous hydraulic up-moving plate bending machine. According to the provisions of JB/T2184-2007 "Model Compilation Method for Hydraulic Components", the model of this hydraulic cylinder should be: SG1-G180×120Q-160C120-※※2WS100/(2500, 3200, 4000), where ※※ is the manufacturer's code.
(1) Main design basis

The design of this hydraulic cylinder is mainly based on the following standards:
GB/T7935-2005 "General Technical Conditions for Hydraulic Components"
GB/T14349-2011 "Accuracy of Sheet Metal Bending Machines"
GB/T15622-2005 "Hydraulic Cylinder Test Method"
GB28243-2012 "Safety Technical Requirements for Hydraulic Sheet Metal Bending Machines"
JB/T2257.1-1992 (2014) "Technical Conditions for Sheet Metal Bending Machines"
JB/T2257.2-1999 "Types and Basic Parameters of Sheet Metal Bending Machines"
JB/T10205-2010 "Hydraulic Cylinders"
Enterprise standards and other relevant standards.
(2) Parameter calculation and determination

The WC67Y-100T hydraulic up-moving plate bending machine is a double-cylinder hydraulic press with a nominal force of 1000kN. The weight of the movable parts driven by the hydraulic cylinder, such as the slider, is approximately 3000kg. According to the provisions of JB/T10205-2010, the load efficiency of the hydraulic cylinder should not be less than 90%; according to JB/T2257.1, JB/T2257.2, the overload test should generally not exceed 110% of the nominal force.
1) Based on GB/T2346 and hydraulic system parameters, the nominal pressure of the hydraulic cylinder is set to 25MPa.
2) Cylinder bore (piston diameter) D calculation:

3) Based on GB/T2348 and considering the load efficiency of the hydraulic cylinder, the bore diameter is determined to be 180mm.
4) Maximum working pressure calculation:
5) Rated pressure calculation: p_r = (1000×10³)/(2×π/4×0.18²) MPa = 19.66MPa

6) According to JB/T2257.2-1999, the piston rod diameter is determined to be 170mm.
7) Cylinder return force calculation: Cylinder pull force = π/4×(0.18² - 0.17²) ×19.7kN = 54kN
Under rated pressure, the cylinder return force (cylinder pull force) 54kN > 30kN (cylinder return load).
8) According to JB/T2257.2, the stroke is determined to be 120mm, and the stroke adjustment amount is 100mm.
(3) Working condition

The hydraulic cylinder should meet the performance requirements specified in various relevant standards and should be designed based on these as working conditions.
Hydraulic test bench test requirements:
1) Pressure test.
2) Full load test.
3) Or overload test.
4) Or perform durability tests for some performance under rated conditions.
5) Other performance tests.
6) Geometric accuracy test.
7) Working accuracy test.
Field installation test requirements:
1) Geometric accuracy test.
2) Full load test.
3) Or perform durability tests for some performance under rated conditions.
4) Working accuracy test.
5) Other performance tests.
(4) Design description

9) Design of the impact block (trapezoidal nut).
During the cylinder's travel, when the piston end cover's lower plane approaches and impacts the upper plane of the impact block, the cylinder's travel is limited, creating a dead point in the travel. The impact block is driven by input torque and speed through the trapezoidal thread shaft. The axial position of its upper plane relative to the positioning boss of the trapezoidal thread shaft and the amount of change relates to the accuracy of the hydraulic cylinder. Therefore, it is required to have precise positioning, repeatable accurate positioning, and long service life.
① The trapezoidal thread transmission pair requires high transmission accuracy and axial positioning requirements. T80×3-7 (JB/T 2886) is selected.
② There are requirements for its geometric tolerances. The impact end face must be perpendicular to the centerline of the trapezoidal thread hole (thread pitch diameter).
③ The trapezoidal thread has sufficient strength, stiffness, and service life.
④ The impact plane has sufficient compressive strength and service life.
⑤ The guiding key has high guiding accuracy, requiring a small clearance and being parallel to the centerline of the trapezoidal thread shaft.
⑥ During transmission, it cannot drive the piston rod to rotate together, meaning it cannot follow rotation.
⑦ When the piston rod moves, the hydraulic oil above and below the impact block can pass through smoothly without causing abnormal noise.
⑧ No abnormal noise is generated when the impact block is impacted and separated.

③ Verification of planar compressive strength.

③ Reasonable heat treatment and technology.
④ Convenient installation and removal.
⑤ Design of reducer mounting flange and pressure sleeve.

⑧ The direction of the reducer input shaft can be adjusted to allow one drive shaft to drive two reducers.

3.3.2 Design Accuracy and Machining Accuracy Analysis of Adjustable Stroke Hydraulic Cylinder

The adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder for hydraulic up-moving plate bending machine, in addition to having the general structure of a double-acting single piston rod hydraulic cylinder, also has the special structure of an "adjustable stroke cylinder" whose stroke stop position can be changed to allow changes in stroke length.

The positioning accuracy of the stroke and the repeated positioning accuracy of the stroke of the adjustable stroke cylinder to a certain extent indicate the level of domestic hydraulic cylinder design and manufacturing. Taking the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder as an example, the positioning accuracy of the stroke and the repeated positioning accuracy of the stroke of the adjustable stroke cylinder in China can reach ≤±0.080 mm and ≤0.080 mm in the hydraulic test bench detection, while a patent design of the adjustable stroke cylinder can reach ≤±0.015 mm and ≤0.010 mm in the hydraulic cylinder test bench detection.

Since the positioning accuracy of the stroke and the repeated positioning accuracy of the stroke of this adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder are the main performance parameters that distinguish it from other hydraulic cylinders, the following focuses on analyzing it in terms of design accuracy and manufacturing accuracy.
1. Design Accuracy Analysis

Since the hydraulic cylinder is a special pressure vessel, it is required that the designed structure itself has stability under the pressure test (or rated) pressure, that is, the assembly and parts must have sufficient strength, rigidity and impact toughness. Design accuracy is given under steady-state working conditions, and design accuracy analysis is based on the premise of structural stability.

Design accuracy is the degree of conformity between the geometric parameters (dimensions, shapes, positions and surface structures, etc.) given in advance in the design and the ideal geometric parameters. Design accuracy analysis is mainly to analyze the necessity of the accuracy level of the geometric parameters given in the drawing, that is, whether it meets the functional and performance requirements of the product, including the compliance with some design specifications, principles and criteria, such as whether it conforms to the current product geometric technical specifications, tolerance principles, the selection principles of geometric tolerances and surface roughness parameters and their values, the structural design criteria for tolerance requirements, etc.
Generally, design accuracy analysis can be carried out in the following aspects:

items: Dimensional accuracy design analysis, including the analysis of the selection of datum, matching system, standard tolerance (dimensional element accuracy) level, tolerance and fit, etc. Among them, dimensional elements refer to geometric shapes determined by linear dimensions or angular dimensions of a certain size.
Geometric accuracy design analysis, including the analysis of the selection of datum, geometric (shape, direction, position and runout) tolerances and tolerance principles, etc.

Surface structure accuracy analysis, including the analysis of surface roughness parameters (arithmetic average deviation of profile Ra, maximum height of profile Rz, sampling length of profile, etc.)

sections.text: The mean roughness Rsm and the spacing of the profile height Rmr of the measured values and their numbers, the surface roughness number and the extraction analysis of the reference value.

The following is an analysis of the design accuracy of the main cylinder components of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder (except for surface roughness, all linear dimensions in the following text are in mm).
(1) Design accuracy analysis of the cylinder body

Figure 3-5 shows the cylinder body (right) of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder. The cylinder body is the main body of the hydraulic cylinder and one of its main components. Other components and the host are installed on it, and oil ports for connecting pipelines are also set on the cylinder body.

The cylindrical surface of the cylinder bore serves as a guide rail for the piston and piston rod (since the piston rod and piston are coaxial and combined into one). It is more appropriate to use the axis of the inner hole of the cylinder body (cylinder) as the design datum during design, as shown in Datum A.

As shown in Figure 3-4, since the hydraulic cylinder is a special pressure vessel, it is divided into a rodless cavity and a rod cavity through the piston, piston rod, and sealing device or system, and the piston and piston rod reciprocate within it. Therefore, the bore should ensure certain dimensional tolerances and geometric accuracy. In Figure 3-5, the cylinder bore is designed as ф180H8, and straightness, roundness, and cylindricity tolerances are given, which can ensure movement and sealing; to ensure the maximum cylinder stroke, relevant dimensions of 310±0.20 are given; to install the piston sealing device or system, chamfers for installation and lead-in are provided, and it is required that the lead-in chamfer intersect with the cylindrical surface of the cylinder bore with a rounded corner; to ensure the sealing performance and durability of the sealing device or system, the surface roughness value of the cylinder bore surface is selected as Ra0.4μm, but Rz and Rmr are not further specified; the rod cavity flow channel is set at the retraction groove of the cylinder bore, which not only facilitates the uniform action of the oil liquid in the rod cavity on the effective area of the rod end of the piston but also eliminates the sharp edge chamfer like the rodless cavity flow channel.

The piston rod sealing groove, including the bearing ring groove, is all set on the cylinder body. To ensure the concentricity of all groove bottom surfaces with the inner hole axis of the cylinder, all of them use the inner hole axis of the cylinder as the design datum and give concentricity tolerances, including the hole (or coupling hole) ф170.6H9 that generally does not contact the piston rod; the rounded corners at all parts of the groove are all given rounded corner radii on the drawing and in the technical requirements, and the groove bottom surface and side surface are all given surface roughness requirements.

The installation surface of the hydraulic cylinder is set on the cylinder body. When installed with the host, it must ensure that the axis of the reciprocating motion of the piston and piston rod is parallel to the installation surface of the host and perpendicular to the worktable of the host, and it bears the reaction force of the cylinder output force. In Figure 3-5, geometric tolerances are given for both the two-step contact surface and the step clamping surface, especially the intersection of the step contact surface and the step clamping surface, which is prone to fatigue failure. Therefore, referring to the crossing groove of the external cylindrical grinding wheel (see Figure 1-21, Table 1-85), an alternating load is given for the plane grinding wheel crossing groove. The 8×M20-6H threaded hole on the installation surface is used for installation with the host, and position tolerance is given for it.

Each oil port is designed according to relevant standards, but the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder adopts a combined sealing washer for oil port sealing. Therefore, no further requirements are given for the O-ring angular sealing at the end of the oil port, and only a perpendicularity tolerance is given for the sealing surface.

Other parts such as the threaded connection and positioning stop between the cylinder body and the end cover, the chamfer for installing the sealing ring, and the outer shape of the cylinder body are all given dimensions and tolerances, geometric tolerances, and surface roughness requirements according to relevant standards and technical requirements. The edges of the cylinder body are not marked with chamfers of 2×45°, and the technical requirements state that the surface of the cylinder body can be surface-coated or pre-treated according to user requirements.
See Figure 3-5 for specific geometric accuracy levels and surface roughness at each location.

For linear dimensions without marked tolerance levels, the tolerance level is grade m; for rounded corner radii and chamfer height dimensions without marked dimensions, the tolerance level is grade m; for angles without marked angles, the tolerance level is grade m; for geometric tolerances without marked tolerance levels, the tolerance level is grade K.
The position of the oil port on the cylinder body (left) of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder is different from that on the cylinder body (right) of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder.
(2) Design accuracy analysis of the cylinder end cover

In Figure 3-4, since the cylinder end cover, together with the cylinder body and other cylinder components, forms the rodless cavity of the hydraulic cylinder, its sealing performance must be ensured, especially the rotary shaft seal composed of the ф85f8 cylindrical surface with the trapezoidal thread shaft.

Figure 3-6 shows the design datum of the cylinder end cover of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder as the axis of the ф85H8 hole, as shown in Datum A, which should be in a straight line with the axis of the inner hole of the cylinder body (cylinder body design datum A) during assembly.

To ensure that all sealing groove bottom surfaces are in a straight line with the axis of the inner hole of the cylinder body during assembly, geometric tolerances are given for all sealing groove bottom surfaces relative to the design datum of the cylinder body end cover.

Similarly, the threaded connection with the cylinder body, the positioning boss, the bottom surface of the keyway, the stop surface of the installation flange of the reducer, and the cylindrical surface that cooperates with the cylinder body where the O-ring static seal is located, etc., are all given dimensions and tolerances, geometric tolerances, etc.

To ensure that the axis of the trapezoidal thread shaft installed on the cylinder end cover can be in a straight line with the axis of the inner hole of the cylinder body, in addition to ensuring the fitting accuracy of ф85H8/f8 between the cylinder end cover and the trapezoidal thread shaft, it is also necessary to ensure that the bottom surface of the axial positioning boss on the trapezoidal thread shaft is perpendicular to this axis and has a small assembly clearance with other cylinder components. Therefore, the relevant surfaces and keyway of the cylinder end cover are all given dimensions and tolerances and geometric accuracy requirements.

The lower end surface of the cylinder end cover involves the eccentricity problem of the cylinder return end, and the upper end surface is related to the concentricity of the installation flange of the reducer. Both are given perpendicularity tolerances on the drawing.
Chamfers at each location, especially rounded corners at each sealing groove, are given chamfer dimensions and rounded corner radii. The maximum chamfer at each threaded hole is 1.05D×120°.
The tightening and anti-loosening between the cylinder end cover and the cylinder body are very important. First, the accuracy of the M195×3-6h thread should be ensured.
See Figure 3-6 for specific geometric accuracy levels and surface roughness at each location.

For linear dimensions without marked tolerance levels, the tolerance level is grade m; for rounded corner radii and chamfer height dimensions without marked dimensions, the tolerance level is grade m; for angles without marked angles, the tolerance level is grade m; for geometric tolerances without marked tolerance levels, the tolerance level is grade K.
(3) Design accuracy analysis of the piston rod

sections.text: In Figure 3-4, the piston, piston rod, and sealing device or system divide the cylinder body into rodless and rod cavities, with the piston and piston rod moving reciprocally within.

As shown in Figure 3-7, the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder's piston rod and piston form an integrated structure with a hollow piston rod. Due to structural limitations, the hollow opening faces the cylinder bottom side, increasing the rodless cavity (inner cavity) wet volume.

To ensure the sealing and reciprocating movement precision of the piston and piston rod, the centerline of the piston rod outer cylindrical surface φ17.0f7 is determined as the design datum for the piston rod, specifically shown as datum A, which should align with the cylinder bore centerline (cylinder body design datum A) during assembly.

The piston rod end cap (or piston rod end cap) is screwed onto the piston rod end and directly contacts the stroke limiter component of the cylinder. The cylinder stroke (unidirectional) positioning accuracy and cylinder stroke (unidirectional) repeated positioning accuracy are the most important precision requirements for the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder used in hydraulic up-motion plate bending machines. Therefore, the precision of the piston rod (piston end) end face and threads is crucial. Additionally, a guide key groove is set in the hollow piston rod to prevent the collision block from rotating during axial movement, with the guide key groove also specifying dimensions, tolerances, geometric accuracy requirements, and surface roughness.

To ensure the sealing of the piston and piston rod, geometric accuracy requirements such as straightness, roundness, and cylindricity are specified for the piston rod outer cylindrical surface. Concentricity tolerances are given for the piston seal groove bottom surface and other related cylindrical surfaces relative to the design datum, along with surface roughness for each cylindrical surface.

The piston rod is subjected to alternating loads, and fatigue failure is likely to occur at the relief groove or grinding wheel exit groove locations. The drawing specifies chamfer dimensions and fillet radii at these locations. The seal groove bottom fillet radius and groove edge fillet radius R=0.2mm are not specified for each seal groove.

Specific geometric accuracy levels and surface roughness are shown in Figure 3-7. Tolerance grades for unmarked linear dimensions are m-level, for unmarked fillet radii and chamfer heights are m-level, for unmarked angles are m-level, and for unmarked geometric tolerances are K-level.
(4) Design Precision Analysis of Piston End Cap

In Figure 3-4, the piston end cap is threadedly connected and tightened with the piston rod (piston end), moving reciprocally together, and contacts the collision block at the dead point of cylinder travel, serving as the stroke limiter component of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder.

As shown in Figure 3-8, the piston end cap of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder, to ensure the perpendicularity of each end face (three locations), takes the axis of the threaded minor diameter on the piston rod end (piston end) as the design datum, specifically shown as datum A.

The thread design for screwing and tightening with the piston rod end is M130×3-6H/6h, which is a medium-precision preferred tolerance and fit. To ensure that the thread minor diameter axis can align with the piston rod design datum during assembly, a perpendicularity tolerance is given for the contact surface after screwing and tightening the piston end cap with the piston rod end; to avoid cylinder misalignment at the return limit dead point, a perpendicularity tolerance is given for the top of the piston end cap; to ensure unidirectional positioning accuracy and unidirectional repeated positioning accuracy of cylinder travel, a perpendicularity tolerance is given for the bottom of the piston end cap.

The piston end cap is subjected to alternating loads, and fatigue failure is likely to occur at the relief groove locations. The drawing specifies chamfer dimensions and fillet radii at these locations.

Specific geometric accuracy levels and surface roughness are shown in Figure 3-8. Tolerance grades for unmarked linear dimensions are m-level, for unmarked fillet radii and chamfer heights are m-level, for unmarked angles are m-level, and for unmarked geometric tolerances are K-level.
(5) Design Precision Analysis of Trapezoidal Thread Shaft

As shown in Figure 3-4, the trapezoidal thread shaft is an important cylinder component in the travel adjustment device of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder. Its design precision, machining precision, and assembly precision directly affect the unidirectional positioning accuracy and unidirectional repeated positioning accuracy of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder. The trapezoidal thread shaft requires rotary shaft sealing with the cylinder end cap and forms the generalized cylinder body together with other cylinder components.

As shown in Figure 3-9, the trapezoidal thread shaft of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder, to ensure connection, sealing, positioning accuracy, and transmission precision, takes the φ28f7 and T80×4-7 trapezoidal thread (major diameter) axis as the combined datum elements, specifically shown as datum A and datum B. Its left end (see Figure 3-9) has a keyed shaft φ28f7 connected to the reducer, φ125×23 is the positioning boss of the trapezoidal thread shaft itself, a section of φ85f8 shaft (or cylinder) fits with the hole φ85H8 in the cylinder end cap to form rotary shaft sealing (seal groove is set on the cylinder end cap). To ensure that the trapezoidal thread shaft design datum aligns with the cylinder body design datum during assembly and to meet other technical requirements, the drawing therefore specifies the rotary shaft dimensions and fit φ85H8/f8 and other dimensions and tolerances, geometric accuracy, and surface roughness requirements.

The precision of the trapezoidal thread affects the setting of various target positions and target reference points of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder, so the drawing provides detailed information about the trapezoidal thread T80×4-7 (JB/T2886-2008) details, which can also be seen in Table 3-49.

The trapezoidal thread shaft is subjected to variable loads during testing and use, and may be subjected to large impact loads in special situations. Fatigue failure is likely to occur at the relief groove or grinding wheel exit groove locations on the shaft, so the drawing specifies chamfer dimensions and fillet radii at all relief groove or grinding wheel exit groove locations. Chamfers at other locations are also detailed in the drawing, especially the installation lead-in chamfer and the fillet at the intersection with the φ85f8 shaft.

The trapezoidal thread shaft requires center holes for external turning and fine trapezoidal thread cutting, so the drawing specifies center holes that need to be ground, with a surface roughness of Ra0.2μm, and requires protection of these two center holes during all process steps including assembly. These two center holes

The hole is still the inspection reference. The specific geometric accuracy levels and surface roughness of each part are shown in Figure 3-9. For dimensions without specified linear tolerances, the tolerance level is m; for dimensions without specified fillet radius and chamfer height, the tolerance level is m; for angles without specified tolerances, the tolerance level is m; for geometric tolerances without specified levels, the tolerance level is K.
(6) Accuracy Analysis of the Impact Block

In Figure 3-4, the impact block (or trapezoidal nut) is connected to the trapezoidal thread shaft and is directly used for setting the various target positions and target reference points of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder. It is an important cylinder component in the stroke adjustment device of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder. Its design accuracy, processing accuracy, and assembly accuracy directly affect the unidirectional positioning accuracy of the adjustable stroke hydraulic cylinder and the unidirectional repetitive positioning accuracy of the cylinder stroke.

Figure 3-10 shows the impact block of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder. To ensure connection, positioning accuracy, and transmission accuracy, the axis of the T80×4-7 trapezoidal thread (small diameter) is determined as the design reference, as shown in the reference A.

The upper surface of the impact block (see Figure 3-10) directly contacts the lower surface of the piston end cap. Therefore, this surface must be perpendicular to the design reference. It may require grinding a plane during processing, so this surface is determined as another reference for measuring, grinding the lower surface of the impact block, and grinding the upper and lower surfaces relative to each other.

The accuracy of the trapezoidal thread is very important. The drawing provides detailed information about the trapezoidal thread T80×4-7 (JB/T2886-2008) and its various details, as shown in Table 3-50.

During the target setting process, the impact block cannot rotate. Therefore, a guide flat key is designed to be installed on the impact block, and the keyway provides dimensions, tolerances, and geometric accuracy requirements.

The specific geometric accuracy levels and surface roughness of each part are shown in Figure 3-10. For dimensions without specified linear tolerances, the tolerance level is m; for dimensions without specified fillet radius and chamfer height, the tolerance level is m; for angles without specified tolerances, the tolerance level is m; for geometric tolerances without specified levels, the tolerance level is K.
Some terms in the above text are discussed in Section 3.6, "Several Issues in the Accuracy Inspection of Adjustable Stroke Hydraulic Cylinders for Hydraulic Up-Motion Plate Bending Machines."
2. Processing Accuracy Analysis

During the product technical design phase, process designers should analyze and evaluate the processability of the product structure. Under the premise of meeting the functional and performance requirements of the product, the processing accuracy should be limited to the economical processing accuracy as much as possible to achieve the best economic benefits.

Processing accuracy refers to the degree of conformity between the actual geometric parameters (dimensions, shapes, and positions) of the part after processing and the ideal geometric parameters. However, in general cases, processing accuracy can be predicted and judged based on accumulated practical experience and summarized process trials. Therefore, process design and process review are indispensable processes in product technical design.
When necessary, process verification can be conducted to further check the rationality of the process design. The WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder has undergone process verification.

Processing accuracy analysis is the analysis of the feasibility and economic feasibility of achieving the designed accuracy under existing conditions, including analysis of processing errors, process capability, and economical processing accuracy.

The following is the processing accuracy analysis of the main cylinder components of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder. In the following text, except for surface roughness, all length dimensions are in millimeters.
(1) Processing Accuracy Analysis of the Cylinder Body

The processing accuracy of the cylinder body mainly involves the cylinder bore, piston rod seal groove, and threaded connection. The following mainly analyzes the processing accuracy of the cylinder bore and piston rod seal groove of the cylinder body (right side) of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder shown in Figure 3-5.

1) Processing Accuracy Analysis of the Cylinder Bore. Using single-action chuck clamping and aligning the cylinder body, turning the inner bore and other parts of the cylinder, and finish rolling the inner bore, based on the current process level and practical experience, it is completely possible to achieve the dimensions and tolerances, geometric accuracy, and surface roughness shown in Figure 3-5.

The main problem in the processing of the cylinder bore now is that rough machining and finish machining are performed simultaneously (in one clamping) for processing. Even if the surface roughness value can reach Ra1.6μm or below before finishing rolling, the geometric accuracy may be out of tolerance. The main issue is the out-of-tolerance of cylindricity, i.e., the out-of-tolerance of parallelism.
The ordinary lathe used must ensure its geometric accuracy and working accuracy; otherwise, the inner bore of the cylinder will definitely be out of tolerance during processing.
Under the premise of ensuring the accuracy of the ordinary lathe, the following issues should be noted for finish turning:

items: Before finish turning, the workpiece must be cooled to room temperature or the specified temperature.
The finish turning allowance should not be left too small; it should be at least enough for two finish turning cuts.
Measurement should be taken before finish turning. When finish turning the first cut for a certain length, measurement should be taken again.
When finish turning the first cut, it is generally not advisable to directly turn to the relief groove.
When finish turning the last cut, it must be completed in one processing.
When turning steel parts, the turning tool should be able to break chips (with chip-breaking grooves) and remove chips in a timely manner.

sections.text: According to the characteristics of the rolling process and practical experience, it is recommended to use clean emulsified or synthetic cutting fluid for cooling, lubrication, rust prevention, and cleaning when rolling the inner bore of the steel cylinder.

2) Processing Accuracy Analysis of the Piston Rod Seal Groove. On the cylinder body (right side) of the WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder shown in Figure 3-5, each seal groove of the piston rod can be processed simultaneously with the processing of the cylinder bore (in one clamping). However, the processing difficulty is high, and the support is unstable, making online inspection and measurement difficult.

Now, it is generally processed after the coupling hole (φ170.6H9) of the piston rod coupling is processed, and then each seal groove including the support ring groove is processed. The main problem is alignment.
Using single-action chuck clamping to process one end of the cylinder body (see the upper end in Figure 3-5), aligning with the processed hole φ170.6H9, the error value is generally

Not less than 0.02, although it is less than 1/3 of the dimensional tolerance, it is still very difficult to ensure the coaxiality tolerance φ0.03 of the bottom of the groove, because the comprehensive result of the linearity, roundness and parallelism of the ordinary lathe has exceeded 0.02.

Only when the alignment error is ≤0.01, it is possible to process qualified products on an ordinary lathe, but the premise is that the geometric accuracy and working accuracy of the ordinary lathe have not decreased or been lost.
Batch production should adopt process assembly and clamping of the cylinder body, such as a 120° tapered threaded joint disc.
(2) Analysis of Piston Rod Processing Accuracy

Generally, the processing accuracy of piston rods mainly depends on before and after hard chromium plating, but the piston rod of WC67Y-100T hydraulic cylinder shown in Figure 3-7 is different from general piston rods, which is an open hollow piston rod facing the cylinder bottom.

The reasons for the difficulty in ensuring the processing accuracy of this piston rod are: ① When finishing, hard chromium plating before and after hard chromium plating, and grinding the outer circle including polishing the outer circle, the direct top-clamping method cannot be used for processing; ② The workpiece must be turned around during processing; ③ There are key grooves in the inner hole (non-through hole).

In order to realize the processing by the top-clamping method, the inner hole of the piston rod should be processed first except for the key grooves, and then a 90° tapered center plug should be used.

After turning around, the piston end is clamped with a self-centering chuck, and the center hole and various parts such as SR70 are processed. The main problems are the accuracy of the machine tool and chuck itself, such as the two center holes (the center hole at the piston end is on the 90° center plug) are not on the same straight line. The center hole being processed can be corrected by grinding, but the SR70 center point is difficult to correct.
If a one-time 90° tapered center plug is used, it can only be removed after hard chromium plating and polishing, and key slot processing will become the last process.
(3) Analysis of Trapezoidal Thread Shaft and Block Processing Accuracy
The processing accuracy of the trapezoidal thread shaft mainly lies in the processing of the trapezoidal thread, and the block is the same.

Before finishing the trapezoidal thread shaft, the center hole should be ground, and the surface roughness should be Ra0.2μm, and the top-clamping method should be used to finish the trapezoidal thread. There are certain difficulties in processing T80×4.7 (JB/T 2886-2008) trapezoidal thread on an ordinary lathe. First, whether the accumulated error of the pitch of the ordinary lathe can reach δP60≤0.010, secondly, the consistency of the pitch diameter of the trapezoidal thread, and thirdly, the surface roughness of the trapezoidal thread.
When turning trapezoidal threads, a clamped hard alloy thread forming turning tool is generally used now.

The accuracy of the two center holes is related to the accuracy of the trapezoidal thread. After grinding, the center hole must ensure that the contact surface is not less than 85% when matching with the standard center. When grinding the outer circle of the major diameter of the thread, the cylindricity tolerance must be ensured.

The processing technology of trapezoidal thread accuracy is very important. Choosing the correct processing technology and process parameters, under the condition that the geometric accuracy and working accuracy of the processing machine tool are qualified, a trapezoidal thread with 7-level accuracy can be turned.
3.3.3 Main Cylinder Parts Surface Quality Economic Accuracy

Economic accuracy of processing is the processing accuracy that can be guaranteed under normal processing conditions (using equipment, process equipment and workers with standard technical levels that meet the supporting standards, without prolonging processing time).

Taking turning as an example, according to practical experience, it is not very easy to achieve a surface roughness value of Ra0.8μm. Considering the economy of surface supporting under the requirements of adaptability and durability of cylinder parts, for surfaces with a surface roughness value of Ra0.8μm in Tables 3-54 and 3-55, it is still appropriate to preferentially select a surface roughness value of Ra1.6μm if possible.

The calculation of dimension chains mainly involves calculating the relationships between the basic dimensions, tolerances, and limit deviations of the closed loop and its constituent loops. The basic formulas for dimension chain calculation are shown in Table 3-56.
