sections.text: (2) Technical Requirements

items: The forgings shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.8.

The cast iron parts shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.4, the cast steel parts shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.6, and the non-ferrous metal castings shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.5.
The welded parts shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.3.
The machined parts shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.9.
The surfaces of all piston rods of hydraulic cylinders shall be subjected to hardening treatment or hard chrome plating.
The seals of hydraulic cylinder piston rods shall adopt an externally compressible and adjustable structure.

The six surface guard plates constituting the compression chamber of the baler's material box shall be subjected to hardening treatment or manufactured using wear-resistant steel plates. Their surface hardness shall reach 380-450 HBW. Scrap grooves shall be provided on the guard plates on both sides and the bottom plate of the compression chamber.
The baler shall be equipped with an automatic hopper feeding device.
The baler shall be equipped with a machine cover or shearing mechanism to compress or cut the scrap metal material protruding above the material box into the box.
The discharge opening shall adopt an unconstrained and spacious door structure.
Progressive automatic lubrication devices shall be installed at the door guide rails and the guide rails of the secondary ram moving downward.

The manufacturing quality of the baler shall conform to the following requirements: ① All machined parts of the baler shall conform to the design drawing requirements. ② The unspecified dimensional tolerances of welded parts, cast steel parts, and cast iron parts shall conform to the provisions of IT16 in GB/T 1800.1-2009. ③ The unspecified dimensional tolerances of machined parts shall conform to the provisions of IT14 in GB/T 1800.1-2009.

The assembly quality of the baler shall conform to the following requirements: ① Gaskets, adjustment sleeves and other parts not specified in the drawing shall not be allowed to be installed in the assembly of the baler. ② The mating surfaces of the baler body, material box, and tie rod nuts shall be well fitted. They shall be inspected using a 0.05 mm feeler gauge. Local insertion is allowed, but the insertion depth shall not exceed 20% of the width of the mating surface. ③ The sum of the gaps between the side guard plates of the first, second, and third rams and the material box and the guard plates of the compression chamber shall conform to the provisions in Table 2 of JB/T 11394-2013. ④ The hydraulic assembly quality shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 3766. ⑤ All pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed connections, sealing points shall be reliably connected, well sealed, and free from liquid leakage. They shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.11. ⑥ The pipeline channels of the hydraulic, cooling and heating systems of the baler and the inner surface of the oil tank shall be subjected to rust and dirt removal treatment before assembly. They shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 3766. ⑦ All components and assembly of the electrical control system of the baler shall conform to the provisions of GB 5226.1. ⑧ The operation assembly of the hydraulic system shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 3766. ⑨ The hydraulic pumps, pressure valves, directional valves, sequence valves and other hydraulic components used in the hydraulic system shall be accompanied by product qualification certificates and shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 7935.

The baler shall be equipped with the following reliable safety protection devices and shall conform to the provisions of GB 17120: ① The baler shall be equipped with a light and sound warning device at the beginning of each working cycle. ② The secondary ram running downward from above of the baler shall be provided with measures to prevent it from falling by itself. ③ The machine cover running downward from above of the baler shall be provided with measures to prevent it from falling by itself. ④ After the hydraulic cylinder-driven secondary ram, door, machine cover, and hopper stop at any position respectively, their inertia sliding value shall be ≤20 mm/3 min. ⑤ When the single-cycle action of the baler stops, the next cycle shall not be automatically initiated. ⑥ The safety and protection of the electrical control system shall conform to the provisions of GB 5226.1.

The appearance quality shall conform to the following requirements: ① The outer surface of the baler shall not have protrusions, depressions, roughness, and other damages not specified in the drawing. ② The joints of the various parts of the baler shall be flat, and obvious gaps and misalignments shall not be present. ③ The exposed welds shall be trimmed to be straight and uniform, and shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.3. ④ When the hydraulic, lubricating pipelines and electrical lines are installed along the outer contour of the baler, they shall be arranged neatly and beautifully, and shall not contact with parts with relative motion. ⑤ The countersunk head screws shall not protrude from the surface of the parts. ⑥ The various nameplates and signs of the baler shall be fixed at obvious, clear, flat, and firm positions, and shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 13306.

The painting shall conform to the following requirements: ① The painting quality shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5000.12. ② The hopper, machine cover, door and other visible moving parts shall be painted with safety colors at obvious positions, and shall conform to the provisions of GB 2893.

4. Horizontal Automatic Hydraulic Baler

JB/T 12096—2014 specifies the model and basic parameters, technical requirements, inspection or test methods, inspection rules, signs, packaging, transportation, and storage of horizontal automatic hydraulic balers, which are suitable for compressing non-metallic materials such as waste paper, waste plastic, and straw into bales for convenient transportation and storage (hereinafter referred to as balers).
(1) Model and Basic Parameters
1) Model Numbering Method. The model numbering of balers shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 28761.
2) Basic Parameters. Basic parameters shall conform to the provisions in Table 4-56.

sections.text: Note: Nominal thrust of baler is the preferred specification, and special specifications can be determined according to customer requirements.
(2) Technical Requirements
1) General Requirements

items: The baler shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 12096—2014 standard and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.

All purchased electrical components, hydraulic components, parts, and fasteners of the baler shall conform to the provisions of the technical documents and shall be accompanied by the manufacturer's qualification certificate before use, and shall be installed on the main unit and tested for operation simultaneously. Outsourced parts shall also have the quality certificate from the manufacturer.

The baler shall ensure its integrity when leaving the factory and be equipped with spare wearing parts and special accessories specified in the technical documents; special accessories shall be determined jointly by the user and the manufacturer, supplied with the machine or ordered separately. Accessories, spare parts, and tools shall be interchangeable and conform to the provisions of the technical documents.
The product instruction manual shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 9969.

sections.text: 2) Structure and Function

items: The body of the baler must have sufficient strength and stiffness and conform to the provisions of the technical documents.

① The main hydraulic cylinder and pressing head should adopt a floating connection. ② The pressing head should still be able to slide smoothly on the guide rail when the load deviates from the center by 1/4 of the height dimension. ③ The blade of the V-shaped shearing knife should be sharp enough to cut off the scrap. ④ Compress non-metallic materials such as waste paper, waste plastic, and straw into bales. ⑤ The baler should have an automatic bundling mechanism with automatic threading, cutting, and knotting functions.

sections.text: 3) Machining

items: The machined parts of the baler should conform to the requirements specified in the design drawings and process specifications; the machined surfaces should not have burrs, spots, or other mechanical damage; except for special requirements, sharp corners should be blunted.
For machined dimensions without tolerance requirements marked on the drawings, the tolerances shall conform to the provisions of the specifications.

sections.text: The limit deviation shall comply with the requirements specified in the technical documentation.

(3) Important castings, forgings, and welded parts shall have quality certificates. In addition to meeting the technical requirements marked on the drawing, they shall also comply with the provisions of JB/T 1829. Welded parts shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 8609.

(4) Defects in castings, forgings, and welded parts may be repaired according to the provisions of the technical documentation, provided that the requirements for use and surface quality are guaranteed.
(5) The hardness of the cutting blade shall reach 53~55 HRC.
4) Assembly

(1) The baler shall be assembled according to the assembly process specification. No gaskets, bushings, and other parts not specified in the drawing, as well as unqualified components, shall be allowed to be assembled.
(2) When assembling bearings, their position shall be kept correct, force shall be uniform, and no damage shall occur.

(3) The connection of fasteners shall comply with the standard pre-tightening force. Components that may become loose shall be provided with anti-loosening measures. After assembly, the heads of bolts and screws and the end faces of nuts shall be in uniform contact with the plane of the fastened parts, and no inclination or gap shall be allowed. The lengths of screws assembled in the same part shall be consistent. No looseness of tightened screws, bolts, and nuts shall occur, and the tightening force of screws affecting accuracy shall be consistent.

(4) No damage shall occur to the sealing element. Before assembly, grease shall be applied to the sealing element and the sealing surface. When assembling overlapping sealing rings, they shall be pressed against each other, and the opening shall face the side with higher pressure.

(5) The straightness error of the guide rail of the pressing head on the machine body shall not be greater than 1 mm/1000 mm, and the full length shall not exceed 5 mm. The parallelism error of the guide rails on both sides shall not be greater than 2 mm/1000 mm, and the full length shall not exceed 6 mm.

(6) Before assembly, the channel of the pipeline and the inner surface of the oil tank in the hydraulic system shall be treated for rust prevention and decontamination. No dirt shall be allowed to exist. The cleanliness of the hydraulic system shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
(7) All pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed connections and sealing parts shall be reliably connected and well sealed, and no leakage shall be allowed.
5) Hydraulic System
(1) The hydraulic system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766.

(2) The hydraulic cylinder must undergo a pressure test, and the pressure holding time shall not be less than 10 min, and no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage shall occur. The pressure test pressure shall be 1.2 times the rated working pressure.
(3) Various valves in the hydraulic system shall be sensitive in action and reliable in operation.

(4) The cooling system shall meet the requirements for the temperature and temperature rise of the hydraulic oil. It shall be ensured that the oil temperature at the oil inlet in the oil tank shall not exceed 60°C during normal operation.
(5) No leakage shall occur in the hydraulic system and the cooling system.
(6) The cleanliness of the hydraulic system shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
6) Noise. When the baler is running idle, its noise limit shall comply with the provisions of GB 26484.
7) Electrical System
(1) The electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(2) The continuity of the protective grounding circuit of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(3) The grounding protection and insulation resistance of the electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(4) The withstand voltage performance of the electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
8) Safety and Protection
(1) The design and manufacture of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 17120.
(2) After the hydraulic pump of the baler is started, the working parts must not move without pressing the working button.
(3) The hydraulic system shall be equipped with a safety device to prevent hydraulic overload.

(4) The pressure gauge of the hydraulic system shall be installed in a place where it is easy for the operator to observe. Protective measures and necessary signal displays shall be provided for sudden pressure loss or interruption.
(5) The safety and protection of the electrical system of the baler shall comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
9) Appearance and Painting

(1) No protrusions, depressions, roughness, and other damages not specified in the drawing shall occur on the outer surface of the baler. The joint surfaces shall be flat, and no obvious gaps and misalignments shall occur.
(2) No defects such as knocks, scratches, and rust shall occur on the exposed machined surfaces. No defects such as twisting and hammering shall occur at the ends of all kinds of fasteners.
(3) The exposed weld seams shall be smooth and uniform.
(4) The hydraulic pipelines and electrical lines shall be arranged neatly and fixed firmly, and shall not touch the parts with relative motion.
(5) The nameplates and various signs shall be flat and upright.

(6) The coating surface of the baler shall be flat and the color shall be uniform. No defects such as sagging and bottom exposure shall occur. The paints of different colors shall have clear boundaries and shall not pollute each other.

(7) Other unpainted surfaces of the baler (except for the surfaces in direct contact with the processed materials) shall be treated for rust prevention by applying anti-rust oil, and shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 4879.
(8) Adjusting bolts and nuts that need to be frequently rotated shall not be painted.
(3) Inspection or Test Methods
1) Inspection of Basic Parameters

(1) The inspection of basic parameters shall be carried out during the no-load running test and the load running test. The inspection of working pressure and working speed may be carried out during the load running test.

(2) The basic parameters of the baler shall be inspected according to the provisions of JB/T 12096—2014 standard and technical documentation. The requirements for basic parameters shall comply with the provisions of Table 4-57.

2) No-load test.
① The no-load test should be conducted without load, and the no-load test time should not be less than 4 h. Among them, the uninterrupted no-load test between each cycle should not be less than 2 h, and the remaining time can be used for single-cycle or single hydraulic cylinder action tests.
② During the test, pressurize step by step from low pressure to high pressure, and the running time at each pressure level should not be less than 5 min, then conduct no-load test at the highest pressure.
③ During the no-load test of the baler, check that each working part runs smoothly, flexibly, reliably, and without any abnormal phenomena or abnormal noises.
④ Check that when the hydraulic cylinder piston runs within the range of the specified stroke speed, there should be no obvious vibration, crawling, or stagnation, and there should be no impact that affects normal work when reversing and unloading.
⑤ Check the sensitivity of the action of various valves in the hydraulic system and the reliability of their work.
⑥ Check the reliability and sealing of all pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed connections, and sealing places.
⑦ Check that the running sound of the baler should be normal and uniform, and there should be no sharp screams and irregular impact sounds.
⑧ Check the flexibility, sensitivity, and reliability of the baler operation; there should be no misoperation during jog, and actions should be performed in the specified sequence during automatic operation.
⑨ Check the safety and reliability of the operating mechanism of the baler. When the baler performs a single-cycle action, the next cycle action should not occur.
⑩ Measure the noise of the baler during the no-load test, and the measurement method should comply with the provisions of GB/T 23281.

3) Overload test.
① During the test, adjust the test pressure to 1.1 times the nominal pressure, and perform actual feeding and baling operations. At least 3 bales should be baled.
② After the overload test of the baler, there should be no damage or permanent deformation of parts, and no leakage or other abnormal phenomena in the hydraulic system.

The following contents can be referred to in the design and manufacture of hydraulic cylinders for horizontal fully automatic hydraulic balers:
① The body of the baler must have sufficient strength and rigidity.
② The main hydraulic cylinder and the platen should adopt a floating connection.
③ The baler should be assembled according to the assembly process specification, and no gaskets, sleeves, and other parts not specified in the drawing, as well as unqualified parts and components, should be installed.
④ The hydraulic cylinder must undergo a pressure test, and the pressure holding time should not be less than 10 min, and there should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage. The pressure test pressure should be 1.2 times the rated working pressure.
⑤ Deviation of maximum stroke of platen: 0~10% of maximum stroke of platen.
⑥ Overload test: During the test, adjust the test pressure to 1.1 times the nominal pressure, and perform actual feeding and baling operations. At least 3 bales should be baled.

sections.text: 4.2.19 Hydraulic press for fluid forming

Although there are many similarities between JB/T 12098—2014 and JB/T 12099—2014, and there are repeated expressions in each standard, such as the requirements for nameplates and instruction manuals in the general requirements, and the requirements for setting medium recovery and filtering devices in the structure and performance and hydraulic systems, both standards stipulate the requirements for hydraulic cylinders (including boosters) applicable to this hydraulic press, which should be satisfied in the selection and design of hydraulic cylinders for sheet fluid forming hydraulic press and pipe fluid forming hydraulic press.
1. Sheet fluid forming hydraulic press

In GB/T 8541—2012, GB/T 36484—2018, JB/T 4174—2014 and JB/T 12098—2014, there is no term "sheet fluid forming hydraulic press" and definition. JB/T 12098—2014 stipulates the model and basic parameters, requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation and storage of sheet fluid forming hydraulic press, which is applicable to sheet fluid forming hydraulic press (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).
(1) Model and basic parameters

items: Model: The model of the hydraulic press should be compiled in accordance with the provisions of GB/T 28761.
Basic parameters: The basic parameters of the hydraulic press include nominal force, blank holding force, and maximum hydraulic forming pressure.

sections.text: (2) Requirements

items: General requirements:
① The hydraulic press should indicate its basic parameters and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.
② The hydraulic forming process should comply with the provisions of GB/T 28273—2012 "Classification of Hydraulic Forming Processes for Tubes and Sheets".

③ A product nameplate should be fixed on an appropriate conspicuous position of each product, and the nameplate should meet the requirements specified in GB/T 13306. The nameplate of the product should at least include the product name, model, basic parameters, manufacturing date, factory number, manufacturer's name and address, etc.

④ The preparation of the product instruction manual should meet the requirements specified in GB/T 9969, and its content should include the product name, model, main performance [nominal force and maximum stroke of the main hydraulic cylinder and blank holding cylinder, (highest or maximum) working pressure of the hydraulic system, maximum working pressure of the boosting cylinder, volume, distance from the movable beam to the worktable, lifting speed of the movable beam; effective dimensions of the worktable, power of the motor, etc.], standard number executed by the product, manufacturer's name and address, usage method, maintenance, and maintenance requirements, etc.
2) Appearance:
① The outer surface of the hydraulic press should not have protrusions, depressions, rough unevenness, and other damages not specified in the drawing.
② The edges of the joint surfaces of parts should be neat and uniform, and there should be no obvious misalignment. There should be no obvious gaps between the door, cover, and joint surfaces.
③ The exposed welds should be trimmed to be flat and uniform.

④ When the hydraulic pipelines, lubrication pipelines, and electrical lines are installed along the outline of the hydraulic press, they should be arranged neatly and should not contact with relatively moving parts.

⑤ The countersunk head screws should not protrude from the surface of the part, and there should be no obvious eccentricity between the head and the countersunk hole. The fixed pin should slightly protrude from the surface of the part, and the end of the bolt should protrude from the nut, but the protruding part should not be too long or uneven.

sections.text: ⑥ The painting of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of the technical documents. Adjusting bolts and nuts that need to be frequently tightened should not be painted. The non-machined metal external surfaces of the hydraulic press should be painted, or protected by other specified methods. The boundaries between different colored paints should be clear. After painting, the joints of the detachable assembly mating surfaces should be cut open, and the edges should not be torn during cutting.

⑦ Nameplates and trademarks should be fixed at conspicuous positions on the hydraulic press. The fixed positions of various nameplates should be correct, firm, straight, and neat, and should be clear and durable.
3) Assembly

① The assembly of the hydraulic press should comply with the assembly process specifications. Parts and their surfaces, as well as the lips of sealing rings, should not be damaged due to assembly. All assembled components (including externally purchased parts and outsourced parts) should meet quality requirements.

② Important fixed mating surfaces should be tightly fitted. After pre-tightening, they should be inspected with a 0.05mm feeler gauge. The allowable depth of the feeler gauge insertion should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface. The total length of the parts where the feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. Important fixed mating surfaces include:

items: a. The fixed mating surface between the shoulder of the column and the working surface.
b. The fixed mating surface between the adjusting nut and locknut of the column and the upper beam and working table.
c. The fixed mating surface between the locknut of the hydraulic cylinder and the upper beam or frame beam.
d. The fixed mating surface between the shoulder of the piston (column) and the slider.
e. The fixed mating surface between the frame and the guide rail, and the fixed mating surface between the slider and the wear strip.
f. The fixed mating surface between the crossbeam and column of the combined frame frame.
g. The fixed mating surface between the working table plate and the working table.

sections.text: ③ For hydraulic cylinders with supporting ring sealing structures, the supporting ring should be properly tight and reliably locked. For moving parts (including pistons, movable crossbeams or sliders) that slide down quickly by their own weight, there should be no stagnation during rapid descent.

④ Before assembly, the pipe channels of the hydraulic system, lubrication system, cooling system, as well as the internal surfaces of the filling device and oil tank should be treated for rust removal and cleaning. The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the requirements of JB/T 9954.
⑤ All pipes, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed or movable connected sealing points should be reliably connected and well sealed, without any oil leakage.
4) Accuracy. The accuracy of the hydraulic press should meet the requirements of GB/T 9166.
5) Structure and Performance.

items: ① The hydraulic press consists of a frame, main hydraulic cylinder, pressing cylinder, ultra-high pressure generating device, ultra-high pressure liquid chamber, hydraulic control system, electrical system, and ultra-high pressure safety protection system.
② The moving parts of the hydraulic press should operate correctly, smoothly, and reliably.

sections.text: ③ Within the specified stroke speed range, there should be no vibration, crawling, or stagnation.
④ During commutation and unloading, there should be no impact that affects normal operation.
⑤ The hydraulic press should have the function of controlling the forming liquid pressure (boosting cylinder pressure), main hydraulic cylinder pressure, pressing cylinder pressure, and stroke.
⑥ The hydraulic press should be equipped with a boosting cylinder. When the working pressure exceeds the set value, the equipment should be able to automatically unload and alarm.
⑦ The display accuracy of the system working pressure, the minimum setting value should not be greater than 0.2MPa.

⑧ During no-load operation, load operation, and overload operation, there should be no leakage at the sealing points of various hydraulic components, pipes, etc. The oil temperature in the oil tank should not exceed 60°C.

⑨ The opening pressure of the safety valve (including the relief valve used with the safety valve) should generally not exceed 1.1 times the rated pressure. To prevent arbitrary pressure adjustment, protective measures should be taken.
⑩ The forming medium in the liquid chamber adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion; a medium recovery and filtration device should be installed.
6) Pressure Resistance Performance.

items: ① The main hydraulic cylinder should be pressure tested at 1.25 times the maximum working pressure for 10 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or damage.
② The pressing cylinder should be pressure tested at 1.25 times the maximum working pressure for 10 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or damage.

③ The boosting cylinder should undergo ultrasonic testing and be pressure tested at 1.1 times the maximum working pressure for 3 minutes without any leakage. The deformation amount of the cylinder barrel measured at the middle of the outer diameter should be less than the specified value of H8.

④ The ultra-high pressure liquid chamber and ultra-high pressure metal hard pipe should pass ultrasonic testing and be pressure tested at 1.1 times the maximum working pressure for 3 minutes without any leakage, permanent deformation, or damage, and the pipes should not burst.

sections.text: 7) Hydraulic System.

items: ① The hydraulic system should have no oil leakage.
② The oil temperature in the oil tank and the inlet temperature of the hydraulic pump should not exceed 60°C.
③ The forming medium in the liquid chamber adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion. A medium recovery and filtration device should be installed around the liquid chamber and on the working table.
⑧ Noise. The noise limit of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of GB 26484.
⑨ Safety.
① It should comply with the requirements of GB 17120 and GB 28241.
② Safety protection doors and protective covers should be installed in the working area and around the mold of the hydraulic press.
③ The boosting cylinder should be equipped with a safety protection device.

576.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Machine (Pump) Hydraulic Pressure Cylinder Design and Selection  565

sections.text:
④ Protective sleeves should be installed on ultra-high pressure pipelines.
⑤ The pressure relief device should operate reliably.
⑥ During liquid filling and stretching, if the workpiece cracks, the liquid filling system should immediately relieve pressure, and the hydraulic press should automatically stop and alarm.
⑦ The movable protective device should be interlocked with the electrical system to ensure that the mold closing and forming actions of the hydraulic press can only be performed after the protective door is closed.
⑧ The electrical safety of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
2. Hydraulic Press for Liquid Filling Forming of Pipes

There are no terms and definitions for "Hydraulic Press for Liquid Filling Forming of Pipes" in GB/T 8541—2012, GB/T 36484—2018, JB/T 4174—2014, and JB/T 12099—2014. JB/T 12099—2014 stipulates the model and basic parameters, requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, and storage of the hydraulic press for liquid filling forming of pipes (hereinafter referred to as the hydraulic press).
Note: The terms "Hydraulic Forming (Internal High-Pressure Forming)" and their definitions are available in GB/T 8541—2012 and GB/T 36484—2018.
(1) Model and Basic Parameters

1) Model. The model compilation of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 28761.
2) Basic Parameters. The basic parameters of the hydraulic press include clamping nominal force, axial feed nominal force, and maximum hydraulic forming pressure.
(2) Requirements

1) General Requirements.
① The hydraulic press should clearly indicate its basic parameters and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved through the prescribed procedures.
② The hydraulic forming process should comply with the provisions of GB/T 28273—2012 "Classification of Hydraulic Forming Processes for Tubes and Plates".
③ Each product should have a product nameplate fixed in an appropriate and conspicuous position, which should meet the requirements specified in GB/T 13306. The product nameplate should at least include the product name, model, main technical parameters, manufacturing date, and factory number, as well as the manufacturer's name and address.
④ The compilation of the product manual should comply with the requirements of GB/T 9969, and its content should include the product name, model, main product performance (nominal force and maximum stroke of the clamping cylinder and axial feed cylinder, maximum working pressure of the hydraulic system, maximum working pressure of the booster cylinder, volume, distance from the movable crossbeam to the worktable, lifting speed of the movable crossbeam, effective dimensions of the worktable, motor power, etc.), product standard number, manufacturer's name and address, usage method, maintenance, and repair requirements.
2) Appearance.
① The outer surface of the hydraulic press should not have protrusions, depressions, roughness, and other damages not specified in the drawings.
② The edges of the mating surfaces of parts should be neat and uniform, without obvious misalignment.

The doors and covers should not have obvious gaps with the mating surfaces.
③ The exposed weld seams should be straight and uniform.
④ The hydraulic pipelines, lubrication pipelines, and electrical lines should be arranged neatly and should not contact with relatively moving parts.
⑤ The countersunk screws should not protrude from the surface of the parts, and there should be no obvious eccentricity between the head and the counterbore. The fixed pins should slightly protrude from the surface of the parts, and the end of the bolt should protrude from the nut, but the protruding part should not be too long or uneven.
⑥ The painting of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of the technical documents. The frequently adjusted adjusting bolts and nuts should not be painted. The non-machined metal outer surfaces of the hydraulic press should be painted or protected by other specified methods. The dividing lines between different colors of paint should be clear, and the seams of the mating surfaces of the detachable assemblies should be cut open after painting, without tearing the edges during cutting.
⑦ The nameplates, trademarks, etc., should be fixed in conspicuous positions on the hydraulic press. The fixed positions of various nameplates should be correct, firm, straight, and neat, and should be clear and durable.
3) Assembly.

① The assembly of the hydraulic press should comply with the assembly process specifications, and parts, their surfaces, and the lips of the sealing rings should not be damaged due to assembly. All assembled parts (including purchased parts and outsourced parts) should meet the quality requirements.
② The important fixed mating surfaces should fit tightly and be securely pre-tightened. After pre-tightening, they should be inspected with a 0.05 mm feeler gauge, and the allowable depth of the feeler gauge insertion should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface. The cumulative length of the parts where the feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. The important fixed mating surfaces include:
a. The fixed mating surface between the shoulder of the column and the working surface.
b. The fixed mating surface between the adjusting nut, locknut of the column, and the upper crossbeam and worktable.
c. The fixed mating surface between the locknut of the hydraulic cylinder and the upper crossbeam or frame beam.
d. The fixed mating surface between the shoulder of the piston (column) and the slider.
e. The fixed mating surface between the frame and the guide rail, and the fixed mating surface between the slider and the wear strip.
f. The fixed mating surface between the crossbeam and the column of the combined frame frame.
g. The fixed mating surface between the worktable and the worktable.
③ For hydraulic cylinders with support ring sealing structures, the support ring should be moderately tight and reliably locked. The moving parts that slide down rapidly by their own weight (including pistons, movable crossbeams, or sliders, etc.) should not have stagnation during rapid downward sliding.
④ Before assembly, the channels of the hydraulic system, lubrication system, and cooling system, as well as the inner surfaces of the liquid filling device and oil tank, should be derusted and decontaminated. The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
⑤ All pipelines, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed or moving
The sealing parts of the connections should be reliably connected, well sealed, and there should be no leakage of hydraulic oil.

items.text: Precision. The precision of the hydraulic press should meet the requirements of GB/T 9166.

Structure and Performance. ① The hydraulic press is composed of a frame, clamping cylinder, axial feed cylinder, ultra-high pressure generating device, hydraulic control system, electrical system, ultra-high pressure safety protection system, and other parts. ② The moving parts of the hydraulic press should operate correctly, smoothly, and reliably. ③ Within the specified stroke speed range, there should be no vibration, crawling, or stagnation phenomena. ④ When reversing and releasing pressure, there should be no impact phenomena that affect normal operation. ⑤ The hydraulic press should have the function of controlling the forming liquid pressure of the product (booster cylinder pressure), working pressure of the clamping cylinder, working pressure of the axial feed cylinder, and piston displacement of the axial feed cylinder. ⑥ The hydraulic press should be equipped with a booster cylinder. When the working pressure exceeds the set value, the equipment should be able to automatically unload and alarm. ⑦ The display accuracy of the system working pressure, the minimum setting value should not be greater than 0.2 MPa. ⑧ During no-load operation, load operation, and overload operation, there should be no leakage at the sealing parts of hydraulic components, pipelines, etc., and the oil temperature in the oil tank should not exceed 60°C. ⑨ The opening pressure of the safety valve (including the relief valve used with the safety valve) should generally not be greater than 1.1 times the rated pressure. To prevent arbitrary pressure adjustment, protective measures should be taken. ⑩ The liquid forming medium adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion; a medium recovery and filtration device should be installed.

Pressure Resistance Performance. ① The clamping cylinder should be kept under pressure for 10 minutes at a test pressure of 1.25 times the maximum working pressure, and there should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage. ② The axial feed cylinder should be kept under pressure for 10 minutes at a test pressure of 1.25 times the maximum working pressure, and there should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage. ③ The booster cylinder should undergo ultrasonic testing and be kept under pressure for 3 minutes at a test pressure of 1.1 times the maximum working pressure. There should be no leakage, and the deformation amount of the cylinder barrel should be less than the specified value of H8. ④ The ultra-high pressure metal hard pipe should pass ultrasonic testing and be kept under pressure for 3 minutes at a test pressure of 1.1 times the maximum working pressure. There should be no leakage, permanent deformation, or damage, and the pipeline should not burst.

Hydraulic System. ① The hydraulic system should have no oil leakage. ② The oil temperature in the oil tank and the inlet temperature of the hydraulic pump should not exceed 60°C. ③ The liquid forming medium adopts hydraulic oil or emulsion, and a medium recovery and filtration device is installed, which should operate reliably.
Noise. The noise limit of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 26484.

Safety. ① It should comply with the provisions of GB 17120 and GB 28241. ② Safety protection doors and protective covers should be installed around the working area and molds of the hydraulic press, and they should operate reliably. ③ A safety protection device should be installed on the booster cylinder. ④ The ultra-high pressure pipeline should have a protective sleeve. ⑤ The pressure relief device should operate reliably. ⑥ During the liquid forming process, if the workpiece being processed ruptures, the liquid filling system should immediately relieve pressure, and the hydraulic press should automatically stop and alarm. ⑦ The movable protective device should be interlocked with the electrical system to ensure that the hydraulic press can only perform clamping and forming actions after the protective door is closed. ⑧ Electrical safety should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.

sections.text: 4.2.20 Precision Servo Straightening Hydraulic Press

The precision servo straightening hydraulic press is a hydraulic press that uses hydraulic servo drive technology, with a repeat positioning accuracy of the pressure head not greater than 0.1 mm when straightening workpieces. It is mainly used for straightening shaft, tube, and rod workpieces. JB/T 12100—2014 stipulates the types and basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods and acceptance rules, signs, packaging, transportation and storage, and guarantees of the manufacturer and user for the precision servo straightening hydraulic press (hereinafter referred to as the hydraulic press).
1. Types and Basic Parameters
(1) Types

items.text: The model representation method of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 28761.
The hydraulic press is divided into the following two basic types: ① Single-column hydraulic press (see Figure 1 in JB/T 12100—2014). ② Frame-type hydraulic press (see Figure 2 in JB/T 12100—2014).

sections.text: (2) Basic Parameters

items.text: The main parameter of the hydraulic press is the nominal force.
The basic parameters of the single-column hydraulic press are shown in Table 4-62.
The basic parameters of the frame-type hydraulic press are shown in Table 4-63.

sections.text: 2. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements

items.text: The drawings and technical documents of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements stipulated in the JB/T 12100—2014 standard and should be approved according to the prescribed procedures before being put into production and use.

578.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Pump (Machine) Selection and Design for Hydraulic Systems  567

sections.caption: Table 4-62  Basic Parameters of Single-Column Hydraulic Presses
Table 4-63  Basic Parameters of Frame-Type Hydraulic Presses

sections.text: 2) The product modeling and layout of the hydraulic press should consider the requirements of aesthetic design and ergonomics. Components and devices should be reasonably arranged and at appropriate heights to facilitate operators' observation of the machining area. Handwheels, handles, and buttons should be reasonably arranged, easy to operate, and comply with the specifications in the design documents.
3) The configuration of the hydraulic press should meet the requirements of the production process, and its working capacity should match that of the hydraulic press.
4) The hydraulic press should be convenient for use, maintenance, assembly, disassembly, and transportation.

5) The installation of the hydraulic press should comply with GB/T50272-2009 'Installation Engineering and Acceptance Specification for Forging Equipment' and the specifications in the design documents.
6) The hydraulic press should be able to work normally under the following environmental conditions:

items: Ambient temperature of 5-40°C. For extremely hot environments (such as tropical climates, steel plants) or cold environments, additional requirements must be proposed.

Relative humidity. When the highest temperature is 40°C, the relative humidity should not exceed 50%, and the hydraulic press should be able to work normally. Lower temperatures allow higher relative humidity, such as 90% when the highest temperature is 20°C.
Altitude. The hydraulic press should be able to work normally at altitudes below 1000m.
Under correct use and normal maintenance conditions, the working time from initial use to the first major overhaul of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T18293.

sections.text: (2) Performance, Structure, and Functions
1) The hydraulic press should have sufficient rigidity. It should be able to work normally during testing under maximum load conditions.
2) The ram speed should meet the requirements of the technical documents and achieve functions such as fast approach, precise servo-controlled straightening, and return.
3) The hydraulic press control system adopts servo control technology and should have a position-holding function, with adjustable pressure-holding time.
4) The hydraulic press has the function of straightening shaft, tube, and rod workpieces.
5) The CNC system of the hydraulic press can control ram pressure, ram stroke, etc., and achieve precise straightening function through the control of multi-axis servo motion.
6) The ram stroke can be adjusted separately according to process requirements.
7) Wear-resistant measures should be taken for the sliding friction pairs of the hydraulic press, and there should be a reasonable hardness difference.

8) The operation of the hydraulic press should be stable and reliable. The hydraulic actuators should not have vibration, crawling, or jamming phenomena within the specified stroke and speed ranges, and there should be no impact phenomena affecting normal operation during commutation.
9) The hydraulic system has automatic alarm functions and protective measures for situations such as pressure overload, oil temperature overrun, and low oil level.
10) The hydraulic press can be equipped with interfaces for mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and electrical devices for loading and unloading according to demand.
11) The connection and action between the hydraulic press and its auxiliary devices should be coordinated and reliable.
(3) Safety
1) When manufactured, installed, transported, and used according to regulations, the hydraulic press should not pose any danger to personnel and should comply with the provisions of GB17120.
2) The safety requirements for electrical drive and control of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB5226.1.
(4) Noise
The noise of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB26484.
(5) Random Accessories, Tools, and Technical Documents

1) When leaving the factory, the hydraulic press should be complete with necessary accessories for normal use of the equipment, as well as required special tools. The supply of special accessories is determined through negotiation between the supplier and the demander.

2) The manufacturer should ensure the quality of purchased parts (including hydraulic components, electrical components, pneumatic components, cooling components) for the hydraulic press and comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards. The purchased parts should undergo no-load testing with the hydraulic press when leaving the factory.

3) The random technical documents should include product instruction manual, product inspection certificate, packing list, installation and maintenance drawings, and drawings of wearing parts. The product instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T9969, and its content should include requirements for installation, transportation, storage, use, maintenance, and safety and health.

4) The spare parts or wearing parts provided randomly with the hydraulic press should be interchangeable. Spare parts and special accessories are not included in the necessary random accessories. Users can negotiate with the manufacturer, and spare parts can be supplied randomly or separately, or as a complete set.
The contents of the goods shall be executed according to the purchase contract.
(6) Nameplate and Signage

items: The hydraulic press shall be provided with nameplates, lubrication and safety signs or labels. The type, size, material and technical requirements of the nameplate shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 13306.
The nameplate shall be firmly fixed in an obvious position of the hydraulic press and shall be kept clear.

The nameplate of the hydraulic press shall include at least the following contents: ① Name and address of the manufacturer. ② Model and basic parameters of the product. ③ Year of delivery and serial number.

sections.text: (7) Castings, Forgings and Welded Parts

items: The general requirements for castings, forgings and welded parts shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 1829 and JB/T 3818.
Castings and forgings for the manufacture of important parts of the hydraulic press shall be provided with a certificate of conformity and shall conform to the provisions of the technical documents.

The gray cast iron parts of the hydraulic press shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 5775. The cast steel parts and non-ferrous metal castings shall conform to the provisions of the technical documents. Important castings shall be subjected to heat treatment or other methods of stress relief to eliminate internal stress.
Important forgings shall be subjected to non-destructive testing and shall be subjected to heat treatment or other methods of stress relief to eliminate internal stress.

The welded structures and pipe welding shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 8609. The main welded structural materials shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 1591. Important welded metal components shall be subjected to heat treatment or other methods of stress relief to eliminate internal stress.

sections.text: (8) Machining

items: The general requirements for part machining shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 1829 and JB/T 3818.

The grade and mechanical properties of the materials of the various machined parts of the hydraulic press shall meet the functional requirements of the hydraulic press and conform to the provisions of the technical documents.
The machining requirements for the main parts shall conform to the provisions of the technical documents.

The machined surfaces shall be free from burrs, scratches and other mechanical damage and shall be free from defects that would reduce the quality of use of the hydraulic press or impair its appearance. Unless otherwise specified, sharp edges shall be chamfered.
The machining accuracy and surface roughness of the sliding surfaces shall be such as to ensure that the accuracy and technical requirements of the hydraulic press are met.

sections.text: (9) Assembly

items: The general requirements for assembly shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 3818.

The hydraulic press shall be assembled in accordance with the technical documents and drawings. No damage shall be caused to the parts, their surfaces, the lips of the seals, etc. during assembly. After assembly, the actions of the various mechanisms shall be flexible, accurate and reliable.

After assembly, the heads of bolts and screws and the end faces of nuts shall be in uniform contact with the plane of the part being fastened. They shall not be inclined or have any clearance. The lengths of screws mounted at the same location shall generally be the same. There shall be no loosening of the tightened screws, bolts and nuts, and the tightening force of the screws affecting accuracy shall be uniform.

The seals shall be free from damage. Before assembly, the seals and sealing surfaces shall be coated with grease. The direction of assembly shall be such that the working pressure of the medium will press the lip tightly. When assembling overlapping seals, the rings shall be pressed against each other, with the openings on the side of higher pressure.
After assembly of the moving parts and rotating parts, the operation shall be smooth, flexible, light and free from obstruction.
Each hydraulic press shall be assembled as a whole at the manufacturing plant, in accordance with the mutual agreement or contract.

sections.text: (10) Electrical Equipment
The electrical system of the hydraulic press shall conform to the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(11) Hydraulic System, Pneumatic System, Cooling System and Lubrication System

items: The general requirements for the hydraulic system shall conform to the requirements of GB/T 3766.
The technical requirements and connecting dimensions of the hydraulic components purchased and manufactured shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 7935.
During operation of the hydraulic press, the oil temperature at the oil inlet of the oil tank of the hydraulic system shall generally not exceed 50°C.
The hydraulic system shall be equipped with a precision oil filter.
Before assembly, the pipe channels of the hydraulic system and cooling system and the inner surfaces of the oil tank shall be thoroughly treated for rust prevention and decontamination.
The cleanliness of the hydraulic system shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 9995.
The pneumatic system shall conform to the provisions of GB/T 7932. The installation slope of the pipeline on the side of the condensed water discharge shall not be less than 1:500.
The cooling system shall meet the temperature and temperature rise requirements of the hydraulic press.
The lubrication system and cooling system shall continuously or periodically deliver the lubricant or coolant to the specified locations as required.

The hydraulic system, pneumatic system, lubrication system and cooling system shall be free from oil, water and air leakage. The coolant shall not be mixed into the hydraulic system and lubrication system.

sections.text: (12) Piping

items: The pipes used in the hydraulic system, pneumatic system and lubrication system shall have smooth inner walls and shall be free from defects such as rust and flattening.

Steel pipes with anti-corrosion treatment on the inner and outer surfaces may be directly installed and used. Steel pipes without anti-corrosion treatment shall be pickled. Anti-rust measures shall be taken immediately after pickling.
Before installation or welding, the burrs at the pipe ends shall be removed. The welding slag shall be removed from the welded pipes.

sections.text: (13) Appearance

items: The appearance of the hydraulic press shall conform to the provisions of JB/T 1829 and JB/T 3818.

The outer surfaces of the parts, electrical cabinets and machine panels of the hydraulic press shall be free from obvious dents, scratches, cracks and deformation. The surface coating and plating shall be free from defects such as bubbles, cracks, peeling and rust.

580.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Machine (Pump) Pressure Vessel Design and Selection  569

items: The painting quality shall comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
Non-machined surfaces shall be neat and aesthetically pleasing.
Text descriptions, signs, patterns, etc. shall be clear.
Protective covers and safety doors shall be flat and uniform, and shall not be warped or sunken.

sections.text: 3. Accuracy
(1) Accuracy inspection instructions

items: The worktable is the reference plane for the overall assembly accuracy inspection of the hydraulic press.

Before the accuracy inspection, the hydraulic press should be leveled, and the longitudinal and transverse level error of its working table surface shall not exceed 0.20/1000. The main operator of the hydraulic press is in front, with the right side being the right side.
If there is a movable worktable or movable straightening auxiliary tool, it needs to be placed in the working position of the hydraulic press and locked firmly.
The accuracy inspection should be conducted separately after the no-load test run and load test run, with the accuracy inspection value after the load test run being the standard.
The accuracy inspection method should comply with the provisions of GB/T10923-2009, or other equivalent inspection methods may be adopted.

(2) Accuracy inspection
1) Perpendicularity of the ram movement trajectory to the worktable surface.

① Inspection method. Place a square ruler at the center of the worktable surface (a flat ruler can be placed underneath), fix the dial indicator on the lower plane of the slider, and make the indicator probe touch the square ruler. When the ram moves up and down, measure in the left-right and front-back directions through the center respectively, and the maximum difference in the dial indicator readings is the measured value. The measurement position is within the range of 1/2 before the lower limit of the stroke.

② Tolerance. The tolerance for the perpendicularity of the ram movement trajectory to the worktable surface shall be 0.05 mm. If there is a movable worktable, the perpendicularity of the ram movement trajectory to the movable worktable shall comply with the provisions of Table 4-64.

2) Ram repeat positioning accuracy.

① Inspection method. When the ram is moved directly below, fix the dial indicator on the worktable surface. Set the target value for the ram movement through the control system. When the ram moves to the target value, make the lower bottom surface of the ram contact the probe of the dial indicator. Move the ram to the target position 5 times, and read the dial indicator readings each time. The maximum value of the 5 dial indicator readings is the ram repeat positioning accuracy at that target position. Take 3 target positions (10 mm, S/2, S) within the ram stroke range (0～S) for detection respectively, and the maximum value of the ram repeat positioning accuracy at the 3 target positions is the measured value. 4.2.21  Medium and Thick Steel Plate Pressure Leveling Hydraulic Press

The medium and thick steel plate pressure leveling hydraulic press is a hydraulic press that uses high-pressure liquid transmission for leveling steel plates. JB/T12510-2015 stipulates the terminology and definitions, types, basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection and acceptance rules, signs, packaging, transportation and storage of medium and thick steel plate pressure leveling hydraulic presses (hereinafter referred to as leveling press), which applies to medium and thick steel plate pressure leveling hydraulic presses that use mineral oil type hydraulic oil as the working medium.
1. Types and Basic Parameters
(1) Types
The basic structure type of the leveling press body is shown in Figure 1 of JB/T12510-2015.
(2) Basic Parameters
The basic parameters of the plate leveling machine are shown in Table 4-66.

sections.caption: Table 4-66 Basic Parameters of Plate Leveling Machine

sections.text: Note: The specifications of steel plates that can be leveled by the plate leveling machine are related to the yield strength, thickness, width of the steel plate material, and the degree of bending of the steel plate.
2. Technical Requirements
(1) General Technical Requirements

items: The general technical requirements for the assembly of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.10.

The scope of equipment for the plate leveling machine includes: the leveling machine body, hydraulic transmission and control system (including pump station, control valve, and pipelines, etc.), electrical transmission and control system (including control cabinet, control panel, and pipelines, etc.), mechanical equipment and auxiliary devices.

The mechanical equipment and auxiliary devices of the plate leveling machine consist of platform, roller lifting mechanism, large supporting roller, chain conveyor, lubrication system, special tools, air lines, stroke and position detection, platform ladders and railings, spare parts, etc.
The main spare parts and components of the plate leveling machine should be specified in the contract or agreement.

The working environment temperature of the plate leveling machine (including pump station) is 0~40°C, with a maximum relative humidity of 60%. If there are special working environment requirements, they should be clearly stated in the technical agreement.

Within 12 months from the date of successful load test acceptance, if damage occurs due to design and manufacturing reasons under correct use, normal maintenance, and upkeep conditions, the manufacturer should provide free repair or replacement of parts (excluding wearing parts).

After the plate leveling machine is put into use, under correct use, normal maintenance, and upkeep conditions, the first comprehensive overhaul should be arranged after 28,500 hours of load operation or between 4 to 6 years of use.

The product manual of the plate leveling machine should comprehensively provide product knowledge and methods of use that are compatible with the intended functions. It should include important information related to the safety and economical use of the plate leveling machine, as well as drawings and technical documents provided with the machine.

sections.text: (2) Safety and Environmental Protection

items: The safety and hygiene design of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 5083.
The safety protection of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 17120 and JB 3915 (already repealed).
The hydraulic transmission and control system of the plate leveling machine should be equipped with overload safety protection devices.
The safety requirements for the electrical transmission and control system of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
The plate leveling machine and its mechanical equipment and auxiliary devices should be equipped with safety interlock control and stroke limit protection devices.
Emergency stop buttons should be installed at multiple locations such as the control panel in the control room, control system, and pump station of the plate leveling machine.
The noise limit value of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB 26484.
The measurement methods for noise sound pressure level and sound pressure power level of the plate leveling machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 23281 and GB/T 23282.

Discarded or leaked working medium of the plate leveling machine should be entrusted to a qualified professional company for recycling and treatment, or processed according to the requirements of the local environmental protection department. It is prohibited to burn, dump, abandon, or discharge it at will.

The plate leveling machine uses mineral oil-based hydraulic oil as the working medium. It is a device that can generate force driven directly by a hydraulic pump and is equipped with liquid pressure and gas pressure devices. Therefore, the fire prevention requirements for the design and use of the plate leveling machine should be consistent with the recognized fire safety standards.

sections.text: (3) Strength and Stiffness Conditions for the Frame

items: A three-dimensional finite element method (FEM) should be used to calculate and analyze the stress and deformation of the frame of the plate leveling machine, with particular attention to the high-stress areas.

sections.text: (4) Technical Requirements for Main Components

1) The upper beam, lower beam and column of combined frame are generally welded structures made of carbon structural steel plates specified in JB/T 7000, and the welds shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.3. Stress relief heat treatment shall be performed after welding, and secondary heat treatment shall be performed after rough machining. Appropriate materials and ReL values shall be selected according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor shall be 2-2.5 (take the upper limit for small hydraulic presses and the lower limit for large hydraulic presses). The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard.

2) The tie rods in the combined frame are generally made of carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T 6999, and shall be subjected to quenching and tempering heat treatment. Appropriate materials and ReL values shall be selected according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor shall be 2.5-3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard. The inspection items and sampling quantity shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8-2007 for the acceptance grouping level of forgings, Group V.

3) The main cylinder and return stroke cylinder are generally made of integral carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T 6397, or can also be manufactured by welding method of split forgings. The forgings shall be subjected to quenching and tempering treatment. Appropriate materials and ReL values shall be selected according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor shall be greater than or equal to 3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard. The inspection items and sampling quantity shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8-2007 for the acceptance grouping level of forgings, Group V. The tangential mechanical properties ReL, Rm, A, Z, and Ak shall be inspected piece by piece.

4) The plunger of the working cylinder is generally made of integral carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T 6397, or can also be manufactured by welding method of split forgings, and shall be subjected to corresponding heat treatment. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of materials shall comply with the provisions of the selected material standard. The surface of the plunger shall be hardened, and the hardness of the working surface shall not be lower than 48 HRC, and the thickness of the hardened layer shall be greater than 3 mm.
5) The hardness of the horizontal and side guide plate surface fixed on the upper beam shall not be lower than 269 HBW.
6) The hardness of the upper guide plate surface for supporting the roller of the workbench moving trolley fixed on the upper beam shall not be lower than 269 HBW.
(5) Forgings, Castings, and Welded Parts
1) The general technical conditions for non-ferrous metal castings of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.5.
2) The general technical conditions for forgings of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8.
3) The general technical conditions for welded parts of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.3.
4) The general technical conditions for flame-cut parts in the product manufacturing process shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.2.
5) The quality grade of fully penetrated welds in welded parts of products is BK, BS grade, and ultrasonic testing shall be carried out according to GB/T 11345.
6) The parts and grades for ultrasonic testing of the upper beam, lower beam and column after rough machining shall be clearly marked on the drawing.

7) When the non-destructive testing depth of the upper and lower machining planes of each beam and the upper and lower end machining surfaces of the column is less than or equal to 400 mm, the ultrasonic testing grade is Grade 3.

8) The ultrasonic testing grade of the working cylinder forging shall be Grade III according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and the ultrasonic testing of the cylinder weld shall be carried out according to GB/T 11345.

9) The ultrasonic testing grade of the working cylinder plunger within 350 mm from the outer surface shall be Grade III according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and Grade IV for greater than 350 mm; when the plunger is a welded structure, the ultrasonic testing grades of forgings and welds are the same as those of the working cylinder.
10) The ultrasonic testing grade of the tie rod within 100 mm from the outer circular surface shall be Grade II according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and Grade III for the rest.
(6) Machined Parts
1) The general technical conditions for machined parts of products shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.9.
2) The upper beam, lower beam and column, and worktable shall comply with the following requirements:

items: The maximum allowable value of surface roughness Ra of the main working surface is 3.2 μm.
The main geometric tolerances are not lower than Grade 7.

sections.text: 3) The working cylinder shall comply with the following requirements:

items: The maximum allowable value of surface roughness Ra at the transition fillet R of the cylinder bottom and the transition fillet R1 of the flange shoulder is 1.6 μm.
The maximum allowable value of surface roughness Ra of the inner hole surface of the cylinder, flange shoulder, and the mating surface with the beam is 3.2 μm.
The main geometric tolerances are not lower than Grade 7.

sections.text: 4) The plunger of the working cylinder shall comply with the following requirements:

items: The allowable value of surface roughness Ra of the outer circular surface is 0.8-1.6 μm.
The main geometric tolerances are not lower than Grade 7.

sections.text: 5) The tie rod shall comply with the following requirements:

items: The maximum allowable value of surface roughness Ra of the thread bearing surface and the fillet radius R at the root of the thread is 0.8 μm.

sections.text: ② The maximum allowable value of surface roughness Ra on the external cylindrical surface corresponding to the external diameter of the thread, the transitional arc at the end of the thread, and the diameter is 1.6μm.
③ The maximum allowable value of surface roughness Ra on the external cylindrical surface corresponding to the diameter of the tie rod is 3.2μm.
(7) Assembly

items: The general technical conditions for product assembly should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.10.

The product should be fully assembled before leaving the factory. For extra-large products or complete sets of equipment, if the manufacturer's conditions do not allow for full assembly, trial assembly should be conducted. During trial assembly, all connecting or mating parts must meet the design requirements.

The main body of the leveler should be installed based on the acceptance of the product, and process adjustment and accuracy inspection should be carried out according to the assembly process specifications of the leveler. Regardless of the type of accuracy adjustment, methods that cause local forced deformation of components should not be used.

The important fixed mating surfaces of the main body should be tightly fitted to ensure maximum contact area. After assembly and tightening, a 0.05mm feeler gauge should be used for inspection. The allowable depth of local insertion between the mating surfaces should not exceed 20% of the contact length in the depth direction. The cumulative movable length of the feeler gauge insertion should not exceed 10% of the testable length. (Important fixed mating surfaces) include: ① The mating surface between the tie rod nut and the fastening surface. ② The mating surfaces between the upper and lower cross beams and the columns, respectively. ③ The mating surface between the flange shoulder of the working cylinder and the mounting surface. ④ The mating surfaces between the spherical pad of the working cylinder piston, the working cylinder, and the support seat.

sections.text: ⑤ The mating surfaces between the horizontal and side guide plates fixed on the upper cross beam and the upper guide plate supporting the lateral movement of the lower carriage roller wheel and their respective fixed surfaces.

⑥ The contact between the working cylinder piston, the spherical pad of the working cylinder, and the support seat, as well as between the double spherical pads, should be uniform and good. The contact area before assembly should be greater than 70%, and the local gap should not be greater than 0.05mm.

(8) Painting
The general technical conditions for product painting should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.12.
(9) Hydraulic, Lubricating, and Pneumatic Systems

items: The general technical conditions for the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 6996 and JB/T 3818.
The technical requirements and connection dimensions of externally purchased and self-made hydraulic components should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7935.

The externally purchased hydraulic cylinder should undergo pressure testing by the supplier. The test pressure is 1.25 times the working pressure, and the holding time should not be less than 10 minutes. There should be no leakage or any phenomenon that affects strength.

The externally purchased hydraulic valve integrated valve block system should undergo pressure testing by the supplier. The test pressure is 1.25 times the working pressure, and the holding time should not be less than 10 minutes. There should be no leakage; at the same time, valve opening and closing performance and pressure regulating performance tests should be conducted.
The sealing parts of the self-made pilot-operated check valve, filling valve, and gate valve should undergo kerosene leakage testing and opening and closing performance testing.
The flow velocity of the main pipelines of the hydraulic system is generally: high pressure is 6-8m/s, and low pressure is 2-4m/s.

For hydraulic cylinders manufactured using integral forgings or welded split forgings, both the forgings and welds should undergo non-destructive testing, and a qualified non-destructive testing report should be provided.

The hydraulic pump station should be installed in isolation, set in a closed area near the leveler, and should comply with the following requirements: ① The design of the pump station should prioritize safety and environmental protection requirements. ② The layout of the pump station should fully consider sufficient installation and maintenance space. ③ The engineering design of the pump room should take necessary ventilation and heat dissipation measures and provide lifting facilities for maintenance.

sections.text: 9) The fuel tank must undergo kerosene leakage testing, and no leakage should be observed.

10) The working medium of the hydraulic transmission system generally adopts HM anti-wear hydraulic oil (first-class product), and its medium characteristics and quality should comply with the corresponding medium specifications.

11) After the hydraulic pump station and control system are assembled, the entire system should be flushed according to relevant process specifications, and the cleanliness should meet the requirements specified in the design.

(10) Piping
1) The general technical conditions for piping systems should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.11 and JB/T 5000.3.
2) Seamless pipes for hydraulic and pneumatic systems should comply with the provisions of GB/T 8163, the inner wall of the pipes should be smooth, and there should be no defects such as rust, dents, etc.
3) Stainless steel or copper pipes should be used for lubricating system piping, the inner wall of the pipes should be smooth, and there should be no defects such as rust, dents, etc.
4) When welding hydraulic and lubricating piping, tungsten argon arc welding or tungsten argon arc welding bottoming with high-pressure flange connection should be used, and high-neck flanges should be used for high-pressure flange connections.
5) When the maximum working pressure of the liquid exceeds 31.5 MPa, non-destructive testing should be performed on the weld seams, and a qualified non-destructive testing report should be provided.
6) Hydraulic piping should be pre-assembled. After pre-assembly, the pipes should be removed for internal cleaning and pickling; after thorough cleaning, anti-rust measures should be taken promptly; then, the piping should be installed for the second time.
(11) Electrical System
1) The general technical conditions for electrical equipment should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
2) For hydraulic press pump stations with smaller total installed power, a 380V motor is generally used.
3) The programmable logic controller (PLC) and industrial computer (IPC) for foundation automation and process control should achieve control and management of the working process of the hydraulic press, as well as real-time display of equipment operation information, alarms, and fault diagnosis.
4) The hydraulic press should have manual and semi-automatic working modes.
5) The control panel should be close to the equipment body, and the height should be convenient for observation and operation.
(12) Appearance
1) The outer surface of the hydraulic press should not have protrusions, depressions, roughness, and other defects that affect the appearance.
2) The edges of the mating surfaces of the parts should be neat and uniform.
3) The weld seams should be smooth and uniform, and any defects should be ground flat.
(13) Installation Construction and Acceptance
The general specifications for installation construction and acceptance of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 50231 and GB 50272.

Note:
1) The hydraulic press lacks specifications such as "general technical conditions should comply with JB/T 1829 and JB/T 3818."
2) The general technical conditions for cast iron and cast steel parts are missing.
3) The surface roughness Ra of the outer surface of the working cylinder piston rod should be 0.8-1.6 μm, which is too low.
4) For purchased hydraulic cylinders, the test pressure is 1.25 times the working pressure, and the pressure holding time should not be less than 10 minutes, with no leakage or strength issues. For purchased hydraulic valve integrated valve block systems, the test pressure is 1.25 times the working pressure, and the pressure holding time should not be less than 10 minutes, with no leakage. Such technical requirements have problems.
5) In load operation (non-process) testing, the liquid working pressure for load operation pressure resistance testing should comply with the design documents. If there are no provisions in the design documents, the following requirements should be met:
① When the maximum working pressure of the liquid is less than or equal to 31.5 MPa, the test pressure should be 1-1.25 times the maximum working pressure of the liquid.
② When the maximum working pressure of the liquid is greater than 31.5 MPa and less than or equal to 35 MPa, the test pressure should be 1-1.1 times the maximum working pressure of the liquid.
③ When the maximum working pressure of the liquid is greater than 35 MPa and less than or equal to 42 MPa, the test pressure should be 1-1.05 times the maximum working pressure of the liquid.
④ The pressure holding time for pressure resistance testing should be greater than or equal to 5 minutes, with no leakage. This is of great significance for the design and manufacturing of hydraulic cylinders for hydraulic presses.
4.2.22 CNC High-Pressure Forming Hydraulic Press

The terms "CNC high-pressure forming hydraulic press" and its definition are not mentioned in GB/T 8541-2012, GB/T 36484-2018, JB/T 4174-2014, JB/T 12381.1-2015, and JB/T 12381.2-2015. In JB/T 12381.1-2015, the basic parameters for CNC high-pressure forming hydraulic presses with a force range of 6300-63000 kN are specified; in JB/T 12381.2-2015, the technical requirements, testing methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, and storage for CNC high-pressure forming hydraulic presses with a forming liquid pressure not exceeding 500 MPa are specified; in JB/T 12381.3-2015, the inspection requirements and accuracy inspection for CNC high-pressure forming hydraulic presses with a forming liquid pressure not exceeding 500 MPa are specified. The above three standards apply to CNC high-pressure forming hydraulic presses (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic presses).
Note: In GB/T 8541-2012 and GB/T 36484-2018, the terms "tube hydraulic forming" and its definition are mentioned.
1. Types and Basic Parameters

items: The drawings and technical documents of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of JB/T 12381.2—2015 standard, and should be approved through the prescribed procedures before production.
