The basic parameters of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T 12381.1 (see Table 4-69) or meet the contractual agreement.
(3) Structure, Performance, and Function

items: The hydraulic press should have sufficient strength and stiffness.
The hydraulic press should have the ability to work continuously according to the predetermined instructions.

The hydraulic press should have the function of controlling the forming liquid pressure of the product, the working pressure of the horizontal cylinder, and the displacement of the piston of the horizontal cylinder.
The hydraulic press should be equipped with an internal exhaust system, and the exhaust time can be controlled.
The hydraulic press should be able to output the forming liquid pressure curve of the product, the working pressure input and output curve of the horizontal cylinder.
For a hydraulic press equipped with a booster cylinder, when the working pressure exceeds the set (maximum) value, it should be able to automatically unload and give an alarm.

(4) Safety and Protection

items: The safety protection of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 17120 and GB 28241.

Fixed protective doors should be installed on the left and right sides of the worktable. Movable protective doors should be used on the front and rear sides, and should be interlocked and controlled by the electrical system to ensure that the hydraulic press can enter the mold closing and forming actions only when the protective doors are closed.
A slide block locking device should be used when changing or repairing the mold.
The oil tank should be equipped with a liquid level alarm device.
The hydraulic system should have overload protection function, and be equipped with a hydraulic safety valve to ensure that the hydraulic press will not work under overload conditions.

sections.text: (5) Noise

(6) Precision
The precision of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T 12381.3.
(7) Marking

items: The hydraulic press should have nameplates and various signs or marks for lubrication, safety, etc. The type, size, material, and technical requirements of the signs should comply with the provisions of GB/T 13306. The symbolic signs on the nameplates should comply with the provisions of JB/T 3240.
The signs should be fixed properly in obvious parts of the hydraulic press, and ensure clarity.
The nameplate of the hydraulic press should include at least the following contents: ① The name and address of the manufacturing enterprise. ② The model and basic parameters of the product.

(8) Random accessories, tools and technical documents

1) The hydraulic press should be complete when leaving the factory, and should be equipped with accessories for normal use of the equipment, as well as the required special tools. The supply of special accessories shall be negotiated by both the supplier and the demander.

2) The manufacturer shall ensure the quality of the purchased parts (including electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic parts) used in the hydraulic press, and comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards.
3) Random technical documents should include operation manual, certificate of conformity, and packing list.
4) The spare parts or wearing parts of the hydraulic press provided randomly should have interchangeability.
(9) Machining and assembly
1) The quality of part machining should comply with the provisions of design drawings, process, and relevant current standards.
2) The machined surface of parts should not have rust, burrs, bumps, scratches, and other defects.

3) The assembly of the hydraulic press should comply with the assembly process specifications. The parts (including purchased and outsourced parts) assembled on the hydraulic press should all meet the quality requirements. It is not allowed to install gaskets, sleeves, and other parts that are not included in the product drawings.

4) The important fixed joints should be tightly fitted. After tightening, they should be inspected with a 0.05 mm feeler gauge. The allowable insertion depth of the feeler gauge should not be greater than 1/4 of the width of the contact surface. The cumulative length of the parts where the feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not be greater than 1/10 of the circumference. The important fixed joints include:
① The fixed joints between the adjusting nuts, locknuts of the columns and the upper beam and the worktable.
② The fixed joints between the locknuts of the hydraulic cylinder and the upper beam or the frame beam.
③ The fixed joints between the end faces of the ram (column) and the slider.
④ The fixed joints between the crossbeams and the columns of the combined frame body.
⑤ The fixed joints between the bottom plate of the slider and the backing plate, and between the backing plate of the worktable and the worktable.

5) The pipe channels of the hydraulic, lubrication, and cooling systems, as well as the inner surfaces of the liquid filling device and the oil tank, should be thoroughly derusted and decontaminated before assembly. The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
6) All pipes, pipe joints, flanges, and other fixed or movable connected sealing parts should be reliably connected, well sealed, and should not have oil leakage.

(10) Electrical System
The electrical system of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.

(11) Hydraulic System
The hydraulic system of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766. The hydraulic components used in the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7935.

(12) Numerical Control System
1) The environmental adaptability, safety, power supply adaptability, electromagnetic compatibility, and manufacturing quality of the numerical control system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 8832 (already obsolete).
2) The numerical control system should meet the functional requirements of the hydraulic press and should have jog, manual, and semi-automatic operation functions, as well as program editing, self-diagnosis, and alarm display functions.

(13) Appearance
The appearance should comply with the provisions of JB/T 3818.
3. Test Methods
(1) Load Operation Test
1) The load operation test should be conducted after the empty operation test is qualified, and the nominal force, required power, temperature change, noise, and other items should be detected.

2) Adjust the liquid working pressure. Gradually increase the input pressure of the upper cylinder, horizontal cylinder, and booster cylinder to 12 MPa, 18 MPa, and 25 MPa respectively. Maintain it for 3 seconds at each pressure level and repeat it 3 times. The pressure repetition accuracy of the upper cylinder is ±1.5 MPa, and that of the horizontal cylinder is ±0.8 MPa. The action should be accurate and reliable.
3) Under the system pressure of 25 MPa, conduct a working cycle to check whether the signal elements are reliable and whether the hydraulic and electrical systems are sensitive and reliable.
4) During load operation, there should be no leakage at the sealing parts of various hydraulic components and pipes, and the oil temperature of the oil tank should not exceed 60°C.
5) During load operation, the current of the motor should comply with the specified requirements.
6) The noise of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 2648.
7) After the above detections are qualified, conduct a 4-hour continuous load operation detection in semi-automatic mode.
(2) Overload Test

The overload test should be combined with the test of the allowable setting value of the safety valve. The overload test of the booster cylinder only tests the primary pressure. The overload test pressure is 27.5 MPa. The test should be conducted for at least 3 times, each time lasting 3 seconds. The parts of the hydraulic press should not have any damage or permanent deformation, and the hydraulic system should not have leakage or other abnormal phenomena.
4. Accuracy
The inspection requirements and accuracy inspection of the hydraulic press are shown in JB/T 12381.3-2015.

Among them, the inspection of "the parallelism of the vertical direction of the movement trajectory of the piston of the horizontal cylinder to the plane of the worktable (backing plate)" and "the parallelism of the horizontal direction of the movement trajectory of the piston of the horizontal cylinder" has reference value for the detection of the runout of the hydraulic cylinder.
4.2.23 High-speed Numerical Control Thin Plate Stamping Hydraulic Press

High-speed numerical control thin plate stamping hydraulic press refers to a hydraulic press with a fast descent and return speed of not less than 300 mm/s, and a pressing speed of 15-40 mm/s (15 mm/s refers to the pressing speed when the nominal force is 100%, and 40 mm/s refers to the pressing speed when the nominal force is not less than 30%). It can control pressure, stroke, holding pressure, and other parameters.

Hydraulic press for thin plate stamping and stretching with automatic control of time and closing height. It is used for bending, punching, blanking, stretching, shaping, and forming of various metal thin plate parts. The terms and definitions, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, storage, and guarantee of quick CNC thin plate stamping hydraulic press are specified in JB/T 12769-2015, applicable to quick CNC thin plate stamping hydraulic press (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).
1. Types and Basic Parameters
(1) Types
1) The model representation of hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 28761.

2) Hydraulic press is divided into three basic types: ① Front-moving workbench type (see Figure 1 in JB/T 12769-2015). ② Side-moving workbench type (see Figure 2 in JB/T 12769-2015). ③ Fixed workbench type.
(2) Basic Parameters
1) The main parameter of hydraulic press is nominal force.
2) The basic parameters of hydraulic press are shown in Table 4-70.

2. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements

1) The drawings and technical documents of hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of JB/T 12769-2015 standard, and can only be put into production after approval according to the prescribed procedures.

2) The shape and layout of hydraulic press products should consider the requirements of process aesthetics and ergonomics, and the components and devices should be reasonably arranged and of moderate height, facilitating the operator to observe the processing area.
3) Hydraulic press should be convenient for use, maintenance, assembly, disassembly, and transportation.

4) Hydraulic press should be able to work normally under the following environmental conditions: ① Ambient temperature: 5~40°C. ② Relative humidity: When the highest temperature is 40°C, the relative humidity should not exceed 50%, and when the temperature is lower, higher relative humidity is allowed. ③ Altitude: Hydraulic press should be able to work normally at an altitude below 1000 m.
(2) Performance, Structure, and Function

1) Hydraulic press should have sufficient rigidity. Under the maximum load condition, hydraulic press should be able to work normally. 2) The speed of the slide should comply with the provisions of Table 4-70 and the requirements of technical documents, realizing the functions of fast descent, pressing, and return. 3) Hydraulic press should have pressure holding function, and the pressure holding time should be adjustable. 4) Hydraulic press has the functions of stamping, stretching, blanking, shaping, and forming. 5) The CNC system of hydraulic press can control the pressure of the slide, the force of the hydraulic cushion, the stroke of the slide, the stroke of the hydraulic cushion, etc., and can realize synchronous or separate control.

Action.
6) The pressure and stroke of the slider and hydraulic pad can be adjusted separately according to process requirements.
7) The sliding friction pairs of the hydraulic press should adopt wear-resistant measures and have a reasonable hardness difference.
8) The operation of the hydraulic press should be stable and reliable. The hydraulic actuators should not have vibration, crawling, or stagnation phenomena within the specified stroke and speed ranges, and there should be no impact phenomena affecting normal operation during commutation.
9) When the system pressure is overloaded, oil temperature is exceeded, or oil level is below the lower limit, the hydraulic press should automatically shut down and alarm. The control system should have the function to detect and alarm for blocked filters.
10) The hydraulic press can be equipped with a buffer device. The buffer device should effectively absorb the energy generated during the punching process. The punching buffer process should be smooth and low-noise, and its buffer action point can be adjusted within the specified range.
11) According to demand, the hydraulic press can be configured with mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical interfaces for loading and unloading devices.
12) The connection and action between the hydraulic press and its supporting auxiliary devices should be coordinated and reliable.
(3) Safety and Protection

1) When manufactured, installed, transported, and used according to regulations, the hydraulic press should not cause danger to personnel and should comply with the provisions of GB 28241 and GB 17120.
2) The electrical safety requirements of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(4) Noise

The noise measurement method of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 23281, and the sound power level measurement method should comply with the provisions of GB/T 23282. The noise value of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 26484.
(5) Random Accessories, Tools, and Technical Documents

1) When leaving the factory, the hydraulic press should be complete and have accessories for normal use of the equipment, as well as the required special tools. The supply of special accessories shall be agreed upon by both the supplier and the demander.
2) The manufacturer should ensure the quality of purchased parts (including hydraulic parts, electrical parts, pneumatic parts, and cooling parts) for the hydraulic press and should comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards. The purchased parts should be tested for no-load operation with the hydraulic press when leaving the factory.
3) The random technical documents should include the product instruction manual, product qualification certificate, packing list, installation and maintenance drawings, and drawings of wearing parts. The instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T 9969, and its content should include requirements for installation, transportation, storage, use, maintenance, and safety and health.
4) The spare parts or wearing parts provided randomly for the hydraulic press should have interchangeability. Spare parts and special accessories are not included. Users can negotiate with the manufacturer. Spare parts can be supplied randomly or separately, and the supply content shall be executed according to the contract.
(6) Nameplates and Signs

1) The hydraulic press should have a nameplate and various nameplates or signs indicating lubrication and safety requirements. The type, size, material, and technical requirements of the nameplates should comply with the provisions of GB/T 13306.
2) The nameplates should be fixed properly in obvious parts of the hydraulic press and should be clear.
3) The nameplate of the hydraulic press should at least include the following contents:
① The name and address of the manufacturing enterprise.
② The model and basic parameters of the product.
③ The year of leaving the factory and the serial number.
(7) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts

1) Castings and forgings used for important parts of the hydraulic press should have a qualification certificate.
2) The gray cast iron parts of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5775, and the cast steel parts and non-ferrous metal castings should comply with the provisions of the technical documents. Important castings should adopt heat treatment or other methods to eliminate internal stress.
3) Important forgings should undergo non-destructive testing and heat treatment.
4) The welding structure parts and pipe welding should comply with the provisions of JB/T 8609. The material of the main welding structure parts should comply with the provisions of GB/T 700 and GB/T 1591, and its performance should not be lower than that of Q235 steel. The important welded metal components should adopt heat treatment or other methods to eliminate internal stress.
5) The requirements for tie rods should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
6) The requirements for plungers and piston rods should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
(8) Mechanical Processing

1) The brand and mechanical properties of the materials of various processed parts of the hydraulic press should meet the functional requirements of the hydraulic press and comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards.
2) The processing requirements for main parts should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
3) The processed surfaces should not have burrs, spots, and other mechanical damages, and should not have defects that reduce the use quality and worsen the appearance of the hydraulic press. Unless otherwise specified, sharp edges should be blunted.
4) The processing accuracy and surface roughness of the guide rail surfaces should ensure that they meet the accuracy requirements and technical requirements of the hydraulic press.
5) The contact of the guide rail working surfaces should be uniform. The cumulative value of the contact area should not be less than 80% along the full length of the guide rail and not less than 70% along the width direction of the guide rail.
(9) Assembly

1) The hydraulic press should be assembled according to the provisions of the technical documents and drawings. It should not damage parts, their surfaces, the lip of the sealing ring, etc. due to assembly. After assembly, the actions of each mechanism should be flexible, accurate, and reliable.
2) The heads of bolts, screws, and the end faces of nuts after assembly should have uniform contact with the plane of the fastened parts. They should not be tilted or have gaps. The lengths of screws in the same part should generally be the same. The fastened screws, bolts, and nuts should not have looseness, and screws affecting accuracy should not have looseness.
The tightening torque should be consistent.

3) The seal should not be damaged, and the seal and sealing surface should be coated with grease before assembly. The assembly direction should be selected to ensure that the working pressure of the medium presses the lip tightly. When assembling overlapping seals, the rings should be pressed tightly against each other, and the opening direction should be placed on the side with higher pressure.

4) After assembling the moving and rotating parts, the movement should be smooth, flexible, light, and free of jamming. The rolling guide surface and all rolling elements should be in uniform contact, and the movement should be light, flexible, and free of jamming.

5) After tightening the important mating surfaces, they should be tightly fitted, and the gap should not be greater than the requirements specified in Table 4-71. The allowable depth of the feeler gauge insertion should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface, and the cumulative length of the feeler gauge insertion on the contact surface should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. The important mating surfaces are:

items: Mating surfaces between large nuts and beams (upper beams, lower beams).
Mating surfaces between upper beams, lower beams, and frame (columns in frame type).
Mating surfaces between hydraulic cylinder flange shoulders and beams.
Mating surfaces between piston rod, plunger end face, and slider.
Mating surfaces between worktable and lower beam.

items: The electrical equipment of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB5226.1.

sections.text: (11) Hydraulic, Pneumatic, Lubrication, and Cooling Systems

items: The hydraulic system of the hydraulic press should meet the requirements of GB/T3766.
The technical requirements and connection dimensions of purchased and self-made hydraulic components should comply with the provisions of GB/T7935.

For cast hydraulic cylinders and forged welded hydraulic cylinders, a pressure test should be conducted after rough machining, with a test pressure of 1.25 times the working pressure, and a holding time of not less than 10 minutes, without leakage or permanent deformation. For integral forged cylinders and forged welded structure hydraulic cylinders, if there are non-destructive testing and other process guarantees for welding, the intermediate pressure test may not be conducted.
During the operation of the hydraulic press, the oil temperature at the oil inlet of the hydraulic system oil tank should generally not exceed 60°C.

sections.text: 6) The oil tank must undergo kerosene leakage test; an air filter should be installed in the open oil tank.
7) Before assembly, the pipeline channels of the hydraulic and cooling systems and the inner surfaces of the oil tank should be thoroughly treated for rust prevention and cleaning.
8) The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T9954.

9) The pneumatic system of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T7932, and the installation slope of the pipeline on the side of condensed water discharge should not be less than 1:500.
10) The lubrication system of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T6576.

11) The important friction parts of the hydraulic press should generally adopt a centralized lubrication system. Only when a centralized lubrication system cannot be used, a decentralized lubrication device may be used.
12) The cooling system should meet the temperature and temperature rise requirements of the hydraulic press.

(12) Piping

items: The selected pipes for the hydraulic, pneumatic, and lubrication systems should have smooth inner walls, without defects such as rust, flattening, etc.

Steel pipes with anti-corrosion treatment on the inner and outer surfaces can be directly installed and used. Steel pipes without anti-corrosion treatment should be pickled, and anti-rust measures should be taken in a timely manner after pickling.

sections.text: (13) Appearance

items: The appearance of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T1829.

The painting quality should comply with the provisions of the technical document.
Non-machined surfaces should be neat and beautiful.
Text descriptions, markings, patterns, etc. should be clear.

sections.text: 3. Test Methods
(1) General Requirements

items: Attention should be paid to prevent interference from environmental temperature changes, airflow, light, and strong magnetic fields during testing.

Before testing, the hydraulic press should be installed and adjusted. Generally, it should be leveled naturally, and the installation levelness error should not exceed 0.20/1000 in both longitudinal and transverse directions.

During the testing process, components and parts that affect the performance and accuracy of the hydraulic press should not be adjusted. If adjustment is necessary, relevant items should be re-examined.

The test should be conducted after the hydraulic press is fully assembled. Except for parts that need to be disassembled during testing as specified in the standard or technical document, other parts should not be disassembled.

(2) Overload Test

The overload test should be combined with the adjustment test of the safety valve. The overload test should generally not exceed 1.1 times the rated pressure, and the test should be no less than 3 times. The parts of the hydraulic press should not be damaged or permanently deformed, the hydraulic system should not leak or have other abnormal phenomena.
(3) Others

Other inspections or tests, such as appearance inspection, accessories and tools inspection, type and basic parameter inspection (which provides tolerance tables), performance, structure and function inspection, machining inspection, safety inspection, assembly and piping inspection, no-load operation test, noise inspection, electrical equipment, numerical control system inspection, hydraulic, pneumatic, cooling and lubrication system inspection, load operation test, accuracy inspection, cleanliness inspection, etc. See JB/T12769—2015; In addition, it also includes other content inspections listed in the technical documents of the product or the contract between the supply and demand parties.

(1) Accuracy Level of Hydraulic Press

The accuracy of hydraulic press is divided into special grade and grade I according to its purpose. Users can choose the accuracy level according to the purpose. Manufacturers can design, manufacture and price according to user requirements. See Table 4-72 for accuracy levels.

sections.text: (2) Conditions for Accuracy Inspection of Hydraulic Press

items: Before the accuracy inspection, the hydraulic press should be adjusted to level, and the longitudinal and transverse level error of the working table should not exceed 0.20/1000.
For the hydraulic press equipped with a movable worktable, it should be in the working position of the hydraulic press and locked firmly.

The accuracy inspection of the hydraulic press should be carried out separately after the no-load operation test and the full-load operation test. The accuracy detection value after the full-load operation test should be recorded in the factory qualification certificate, and the accuracy measurement record should be filed for reference.
The accuracy inspection method, inspection tools and devices should comply with the provisions of GB/T10923, and other equivalent inspection methods can also be adopted.

Before the overall assembly accuracy inspection, for the frame structure, the adjustment principle of the gap between the slider and the guide rail should be: on the premise of ensuring the overall assembly accuracy, the guide rail should not generate heat, not pull hair, and be able to form an oil film.
When checking the plane, when the maximum length L of the plane to be inspected is ≤1000 mm, the length l=0.1L is not checked; when L>1000 mm, the length l=100 mm is not checked.

4.2.24 High-speed Thin Plate Stamping and Drawing Hydraulic Press

High-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic press refers to a frame-type thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic press with a rapid downward speed and return speed of the slider not less than 300 mm/s, and a pressing speed not less than 15-45 mm/s (15 mm/s refers to the pressing speed at 100% nominal force, and 40 mm/s refers to the pressing speed at not less than 30% nominal force). In JB/T 12994.1—2017, the types and basic parameters of high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses are specified; in JB/

T 12994.2—2017, the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, storage and warranty are specified; JB/T 12994.3—2017 specifies the accuracy inspection of high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses, applicable to high-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic presses. High-speed thin plate stamping and drawing hydraulic press is mainly used for bending, punching, blanking, drawing, shaping, forming, and other processes of various metal thin plate parts.
1. Types and Basic Parameters

(2) Basic Parameters 1) The main parameter of the hydraulic press is the nominal force. 2) The basic parameters of the hydraulic press are shown in Table 4-75.

sections.text: Note: 1. Rapid downward speed refers to the downward speed of the slider without load. 2. Return speed refers to the return speed of the slider without the upper mold installed.
2. Technical Requirements

(1) General Requirements 1) The drawings and technical documents of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of JB/T 12994.2—2017 standard and should be approved according to the prescribed procedures before production can be started.
2) The product shape and layout of the hydraulic press should consider the aesthetics of craftsmanship and

592.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Machine (Pump) Hydraulic Pressure Design and Selection  581

sections.text: Requirements of ergonomics, all components and devices should be reasonably arranged at a moderate height, which is convenient for operators to observe the processing area.
3) The hydraulic press should be easy to use, maintain, assemble, disassemble, and transport

items: The hydraulic press should be able to work normally under the following environmental conditions: ① The ambient temperature is 5 ~ 40 ℃. For extremely hot environments (such as tropical climate, steel mills) and cold environments, additional requirements must be proposed. ② When the maximum temperature is 40 ℃, the relative humidity should not exceed 50%; At lower temperatures, higher relative humidity is allowed, such as 90% relative humidity at 20 ℃. ③ Below an altitude of 1000 m.
Under correct use and normal maintenance conditions, the working time from the beginning of use to the first overhaul of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T1829.

sections.text: (2) Type and Basic Parameters
The type and basic parameters of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T12994.1-2017.
(3) Performance, Structure and Function

items: The hydraulic press should have sufficient rigidity. Under the maximum load working condition test, the hydraulic press should be able to work normally.
The speed of the slider should comply with the provisions of JB/T12994.1-2017 and the requirements of technical documents, and realize the functions of fast descent, pressing, and return.
The hydraulic press should have a pressure holding function, and the pressure holding time should be adjustable.
The hydraulic press has functions such as stamping, stretching, blanking, shaping, and forming.

The numerical control system of the hydraulic press should be able to control the slider pressure, hydraulic pad force, slider stroke, hydraulic pad stroke, etc., and can realize synchronous or independent actions.
The pressure and stroke of the slider and hydraulic pad can be adjusted separately according to process requirements.
The sliding friction pairs of the hydraulic press should take wear-resistant measures and have a reasonable hardness difference.

The operation of the hydraulic press should be stable and reliable. The hydraulic actuators should not have vibration, crawling, and stagnation phenomena within the specified stroke and speed range, and should not have impact phenomena that affect normal operation when reversing.
When the system pressure is overloaded, the oil temperature is exceeded, or the oil level is below the lower limit, the hydraulic press should automatically shut down and alarm.

The hydraulic press can be equipped with a buffer device. The buffer device should effectively absorb the energy generated during the blanking process. The blanking buffer process should be stable and low-noise, and its buffer action point can be adjusted within the specified range.
The hydraulic press can be configured with mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical interfaces for loading and unloading devices according to needs.
The coordinated and reliable connection action of the hydraulic press and its supporting auxiliary devices.

sections.text: (4) Safety and Protection

items: When the hydraulic press is manufactured, installed, transported, and used according to regulations, it should not pose a danger to personnel, and should comply with the provisions of GB28241 and GB17120.
The safety requirements for electrical transmission and control of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB5226.1.

sections.text: (5) Noise
The noise value of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB26484.
(6) Accuracy
The geometric accuracy and working accuracy of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T12994.3-2017.
(7) Random Accessories, Tools and Technical Documents

items: When the hydraulic press leaves the factory, it should ensure completeness and be equipped with accessories for normal use of the equipment, as well as the required special tools. The supply of special accessories is determined by both the supplier and the demander.

The manufacturer should ensure the quality of purchased parts (including hydraulic, electrical, pneumatic, and cooling parts) used in the hydraulic press, and should comply with the provisions of the corresponding standards. When leaving the factory, the purchased parts should be tested for empty operation with the hydraulic press.

Random technical documents should include product instruction manuals, product qualification certificates, packing lists, product installation and maintenance drawings, and drawings of wearing parts. The product instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T9969, and its content should include requirements for installation, transportation, storage, use, maintenance, and safety and hygiene.

The spare parts or wearing parts provided with the hydraulic press should have interchangeability. Spare parts and special accessories are not included, and users can negotiate with the manufacturer. Spare parts can be supplied randomly or separately, and the supply content shall be executed according to the order contract.

sections.text: (8) Nameplates and Signs

items: The hydraulic press should have nameplates and various signs or signs for lubrication, safety, etc. The type, size, material, and technical requirements of the nameplate should comply with the provisions of GB/T13306.
The nameplate should be fixed properly in a conspicuous position on the hydraulic press and ensure clarity.

The nameplate of the hydraulic press should include at least the following contents: ① The name and address of the manufacturing enterprise. ② The model and basic parameters of the product. ③ The year of leaving the factory and the serial number.

Castings and forgings for important parts used in the manufacture of hydraulic presses should have qualification certificates. The gray cast iron parts of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T5775, and the cast steel parts and non-ferrous metal castings should comply with the provisions of the technical documents. Important castings should be subjected to heat treatment or other methods to eliminate internal stress to reduce stress.
Important forgings should undergo non-destructive testing and heat treatment.

Welding structures and pipe welding should comply with the provisions of JB/T 8609. The material of main welded structures should comply with the provisions of GB/T 700 and GB/T 1591, not lower than Q235. Important welded metal components should adopt heat treatment or other methods to eliminate internal stress.
The requirements for tie rods should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
The requirements for plungers and piston rods should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.

sections.text: (10) Machining

items: The grade and mechanical properties of materials for various machined parts of hydraulic presses should meet the functional requirements of hydraulic presses and comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
The machining of main parts should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.

The machined surfaces should not have burrs, scratches, or other mechanical damage, and should not have defects that reduce the quality of use or worsen the appearance of the hydraulic press. Except for special provisions, sharp edges should be blunted.
The machining accuracy and surface roughness of guide rail surfaces should ensure meeting the accuracy requirements and technical requirements of the hydraulic press.

The contact of guide rail working surfaces should be uniform. The cumulative contact area on the full length of the guide rail should not be less than 80%, and on the width of the guide rail should not be less than 70%.

sections.text: (11) Assembly

items: The hydraulic press should be assembled according to the technical documents and drawings. Parts, their surfaces, and the lips of seals should not be damaged due to assembly. After assembly, the actions of each mechanism should be sensitive, accurate, and reliable.

After assembly, the heads of bolts and screws and the end faces of nuts should have uniform contact with the plane of the fastened parts, without tilting or gaps. The lengths of screws installed in the same part should generally be consistent. Fastened screws, bolts, and nuts should not have looseness, and the tightening force of screws affecting accuracy should be consistent.

Seals should not have damage. Before assembly, seals and sealing surfaces should be coated with grease. The assembly direction should make the working pressure of the medium press the lip tightly. When assembling overlapping seals, the rings should be pressed against each other, and the opening direction should be placed on the side with higher pressure.

After assembly of moving and rotating parts, the movement should be smooth, flexible, light, and without stagnation. The rolling guide rail surfaces and all rolling bodies should have uniform contact, and the movement should be light, flexible, and without stagnation.

Important mating surfaces, after tightening, should fit tightly. The contact gap should comply with the provisions of Table 4-76. The allowable depth of inserting a feeler gauge should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface. The cumulative length of the parts where a feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. The important mating surfaces are: ① The mating surface between the large nut and the crossbeam (upper crossbeam, lower crossbeam). ② The mating surface between the upper crossbeam, lower crossbeam, and the frame (referring to the columns in the frame type). ③ The mating surface between the flange shoulder of the hydraulic cylinder and the crossbeam. ④ The mating surface between the end faces of the piston rod and plunger and the slider. ⑤ The mating surface between the worktable and the lower crossbeam.

sections.caption: Table 4-76 Clearance of Mating Surfaces

sections.text: 6) Each hydraulic press should undergo overall assembly in the manufacturing plant. For large hydraulic presses that cannot undergo overall assembly due to the limitations of the manufacturing plant, through negotiation between the manufacturing plant and the user, the manufacturing plant can perform overall assembly at the user's site and execute according to the agreement or contract between both parties.
(12) Electrical Equipment

items: The electrical equipment of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
When using programmable controllers or computer control, it should comply with the provisions of the current relevant standards.

sections.text: (13) Hydraulic, Pneumatic, Lubrication, and Cooling Systems

items: The hydraulic system of the hydraulic press should comply with the requirements of GB/T 3766.
The technical requirements and connection dimensions of purchased and self-made hydraulic components should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7935.

For hydraulic cylinders of hydraulic presses, it is stipulated in principle that after rough machining, a pressure test should be conducted. The test pressure is 1.25 times the working pressure, and the holding time is not less than 10 minutes. After the test, the hydraulic cylinder should not leak or have permanent deformation. For integral forged cylinders and forged structure hydraulic cylinders, if there are process guarantees such as non-destructive testing of welding, intermediate pressure test may not be conducted.
The oil temperature at the oil inlet inside the oil tank of the hydraulic system during the operation of the hydraulic press should generally not exceed 60°C.
A filtering device should be installed in the hydraulic system.
The oil tank must undergo kerosene leakage test; an air filter should be installed in open oil tanks.
The pipe channel surfaces and the inner surfaces of the oil tank of the hydraulic and cooling systems should be thoroughly treated for rust prevention and cleaning before assembly.
The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
The pneumatic system of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7932. The installation slope of the pipe on the side for draining condensate should not be less than 1:500.
The lubrication system of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB/T 6576.

The lubrication of important friction parts of the hydraulic press should generally adopt a centralized lubrication system. Only when a centralized lubrication system cannot be adopted can a dispersed lubrication device be used.
The cooling system should meet the temperature and temperature rise requirements of the hydraulic press.
The lubrication and cooling systems should continuously or periodically deliver lubricants and coolants to the specified parts as needed.
The hydraulic, pneumatic, lubrication, and cooling systems should not leak oil, water, or gas. The coolant should not mix into the hydraulic system and lubrication system.

594.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Machine (Pump) Accumulator Design and Selection  583

sections.text: (14) Piping

items: The inner wall of pipes used in hydraulic, pneumatic, and lubrication systems should be smooth, without defects such as rust, flattening, etc.

Steel pipes with anti-corrosion treatment on the inner and outer surfaces can be directly installed and used. Steel pipes without anti-corrosion treatment should be pickled, and anti-rust measures should be taken in time after pickling.

sections.text: (15) Appearance

items: The appearance of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T 1829.

The outer surface of hydraulic press components, electrical cabinets, and machine panels should not have obvious dents, scratches, cracks, deformation, and the surface coating should not have defects such as bubbles, cracking, peeling, or rust.
Painting should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
Non-machined surfaces should be neat and beautiful.
Text descriptions, markings, patterns, etc. should be clear.
Protective covers and safety doors should be flat and uniform, and should not be warped or sunken.

sections.text: 3. Test Method
The test method for hydraulic press is specified in JB/T 12994.2—2017.
4. Accuracy
(1) Inspection Instructions

items: The worktable is the reference surface for the overall assembly accuracy inspection of the hydraulic press.
Before the accuracy inspection, the hydraulic press should be adjusted to be level, and the longitudinal and transverse level deviation of its worktable surface should not exceed 0.20/1000.
For hydraulic presses equipped with a movable worktable, the movable worktable should be in the working position of the hydraulic press and locked firmly.
The accuracy inspection should be carried out separately after no-load and full-load operation tests, and the accuracy inspection value after the full-load operation test shall prevail.
The accuracy inspection should comply with the provisions of GB/T 10923.
When inspecting the plane, when the maximum length L of the plane to be inspected is ≤1000 mm, the undetected length l is 0.1L. When L > 1000 mm, the undetected length l is 100 mm.
The flatness of the upper plane of the worktable and the lower plane of the slider can be inspected before assembly.

Before the overall assembly accuracy inspection, the adjustment principle of the clearance between the slider and the guide rail: it should be adjusted under the premise of ensuring the overall assembly accuracy, the guide rail should not heat up, not roughen, and be able to form an oil film. The recommended total clearance value of the guide rail in Table 4-77 is only for reference.

sections.caption: Table 4-77 Guide Rail Total Clearance Value (Unit: mm)

sections.text: Note: 1. The guide rail total clearance value refers to the sum of the internal clearances of the two guide rails perpendicular to or parallel to the front of the machine. The maximum actual measured total clearance value should be recorded in the product qualification certificate as a reference. 2. Use a feeler gauge to measure the total clearance of the upper and lower parts of the guide rail at the extreme positions of the slider's movement. It is also possible to push the slider to one side of the guide rail and measure its total clearance on one side.
(2) Accuracy Inspection

items: Verticality of the slider motion trajectory to the worktable surface.

sections.text: ① Inspection Method

Place a try square (a flat ruler can be placed underneath) in the center of the worktable surface, fix the dial indicator on the lower plane of the slider, and make the indicator probe touch the try square. When the slider moves up and down, measurements are taken respectively in the left-right and front-back directions through the center. The maximum difference in the dial indicator readings is the measured value. Measurement position is within the lower limit of the stroke range.
② Tolerance
The tolerance for the verticality of the slider motion trajectory to the worktable surface should comply with the provisions of Table 4-78.

sections.caption: Table 4-78 Tolerance for Verticality (Unit: mm)
headers: Effective Length L of Worktable Surface

sections.text: Note: L₃ is the actual measured stroke, with a minimum value of 20 mm. The guide rails should maintain sufficient lubrication.
③ Inspection Tools: Try Square, Flat Ruler, Dial Indicator

items: Tilt of the lower plane of the slider relative to the worktable surface due to eccentricity.

sections.text: ① Detection method. On the worktable surface, use a hinged support rod (the support rod only bears the weight of the slider) to sequentially support the left and right and front and rear support points on the lower plane of the slider. Use a dial indicator to measure the distance between the upper plane of the worktable and the lower plane of the slider at each support point and its symmetric point in the left-right (2L₄) and front-back (2L₅) directions, respectively. The maximum difference in the dial indicator readings is the measured value. However, diagonal directions are not measured. Measurement positions are at the lower limit of the stroke and the lower limit of the stroke range.

Note: The length of the support rod is selected as needed. The support rod only bears the weight of the moving part. L₄ and L₅ are the distances from the center of the slider to the support points. L₄=1/3L (L is the length dimension of the worktable), L₅=1/3L₆ (L₆ is the dimension of the short side of the worktable).
② Tolerance. The tolerance for the tilt of the lower plane of the slider relative to the worktable surface due to eccentricity should be 1/3000L₄.

③ Inspection tools, support rod, dial indicator. Explanation: ① The content of precision inspection and precision inspection is basically the same as JB/T 3820—2015. ② The content of technical requirements and accuracy is basically the same as JB/T 12769—2015. ③ The statement "Intermediate pressure test is not required for cylinder bodies and hydraulic cylinders with welded non-destructive testing and other process guarantees in the technical requirements" is questionable.
4.2.25 CNC Hydraulic Punching and Drilling Composite Machine

There are no terms and definitions of "CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machine" in GB/T 8541—2012, GB/T 36484—2018, JB/T 4174—2014, and JB/T 33639—2017. In JB/T 33639—2017, technical requirements, accuracy, test methods, inspection rules, and signs, packaging, and storage and transportation for the manufacturing and acceptance of CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machines are specified. It is applicable to CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machines for punching, drilling, and marking on various flat plate parts, and also to CNC hydraulic punching and drilling composite machines for punching and marking only (hereinafter referred to as composite machines).
1. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements

items: The composite machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T 33639—2017 standard and be manufactured according to the drawings and technical documents approved by the prescribed procedures.

The materials used for manufacturing the composite machine should meet the design requirements, and the grade and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the provisions of the corresponding standards.
The completeness of the composite machine should be ensured, including electrical equipment, hydraulic and pneumatic components, special tools, and anchor bolts.

sections.text: (2) Safety Protection

items: The safety of the composite machine should be ensured, and the possibility of danger should be avoided and reduced as much as possible through design.

Safety devices or safety measures should be installed on parts of the composite machine that may endanger personal safety or cause equipment damage. Its safety protection should comply with the relevant provisions of GB 17120.

The actions of various mechanisms of the composite machine should be reliably interlocked. Under the condition of correct input parameters, no action interference or component damage should occur when there is an operation or programming error.

For hydraulic circuits containing accumulators, the pressure of the accumulator should be automatically relieved when the system is shut down, or the circuit should be safely isolated from the accumulator. At the same time, a warning sign should be set in a prominent position, stating "Attention - the device must be depressurized before the start of maintenance work!".

Warning signs with the following contents should be set on the accumulator, and should be explained in the manual: ① Caution - pressure vessel. ② Only nitrogen is allowed. ③ Gas pressure is 3～3.2 MPa.
The accumulator should be designed and manufactured by a design and production unit approved by the national designated safety supervision agency, and should have a qualification certificate.

The inflation and installation of the accumulator should comply with the provisions of the manufacturer. The installation position of the accumulator should make maintenance easily accessible. The accumulator and its pressure-bearing components should be firmly fixed and safe and reliable.

sections.text: (3) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts

items: The welding quality of welded parts of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T 8609.
Forgings should not have defects such as delamination, folding, cracks, forging defects, scars, and slag inclusions.
Castings should not have casting defects such as sand holes, air holes, shrinkage cavities, cold shuts, slag inclusions, and cracks that affect working performance and appearance.
Defects that do not affect safe use, service life, and appearance are allowed to be repaired according to the relevant provisions under the condition of ensuring quality.

Important welded metal components and castings, forgings, such as the body, worktable, base, hydraulic cylinder barrel, drilling power head box, etc., should be subjected to stress relief treatment. Parts treated by artificial aging should ensure the aging effect.
Important castings, forgings, and welded parts should be subjected to flaw detection inspection, and the results should comply with the provisions of the relevant standards and technical documents.

sections.text: (4) Part Processing

items: The machined surface of parts should not have burrs and defects that reduce the use quality and worsen the appearance of the composite machine, such as bumps, scratches, and rust.
Sharp edges and corners on machined parts should be blunted if not specified in the drawing.
The scraping surface of parts should not have traces of previous machining, and the scraping points on the entire scraping surface should be uniform.

sections.text: (5) Electrical System
The electrical system of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.
(6) Numerical Control System

items: The environmental adaptability, safety, power supply adaptability, electromagnetic compatibility, and manufacturing quality of the numerical control system of the composite machine should comply with the relevant provisions of JB/T 8832 (already obsolete).

The numerical control system should meet the use requirements of the composite machine, and should have automatic and manual operation functions, program editing functions, self-diagnosis functions, and alarm display functions.
The determination of positioning accuracy and repeated positioning accuracy of numerical control axes should comply with the provisions of GB/T 17421.2.

sections.text: (7) Hydraulic, Pneumatic, Cooling, and Lubrication Systems

items: The hydraulic system of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766.

The oil tank, hydraulic cylinder, valve body, pipelines, etc. of the hydraulic system should be strictly cleaned, and there should be no iron filings and dirt inside. The burrs should be completely removed. All working media entering the oil tank and hydraulic system of the composite machine should ensure cleanliness, and the grade of working oil should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.

596.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Machine (Pump) Hydraulic System Design and Selection  585

sections.text: 4) When the hydraulic system is working stably and continuously, the oil temperature at the oil suction port of the oil tank should not exceed 60°C.
5) The high-pressure hose assemblies and pipe joints should meet the requirements of the technical documentation.
6) The cooling system of the composite machine's cutting part should circulate smoothly without leakage, and the coolant should not mix into the hydraulic system or lubrication system.
7) The pneumatic system of the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7932.
8) Various lubrication points of the composite machine should have obvious markings and be convenient for lubrication.

9) Various pipes should not have defects such as dents, wrinkles, flattening, or cracks. The bending of pipelines should be smooth. Hoses should not have twisting phenomena and should not cause friction, collision, or compression with moving parts. The arrangement of pipelines should be convenient for use, adjustment, and maintenance.
(8) Assembly
1) During sub-assembly and final assembly, parts such as gaskets and sleeves not specified in the drawings should not be installed.

2) The important fixed joint surfaces of the composite machine should be tightly fitted. A feeler gauge of 0.04 mm should only be allowed to be inserted locally, with an insertion depth not exceeding 20 mm, and the total length of the insertable part should not exceed 10% of the measurable length. The important fixed joint surfaces include: the joint surfaces between guide rails and sliders and their mating parts, the joint surfaces between screw rod supports and nut seats and their mating parts, the joint surface between punch guide seat and bed, the joint surface between die holder and bed, the joint surface between punch hydraulic cylinder and bed, and the mounting surface of the spindle box and its mating parts.

3) The top heights of the universal balls on the worktable should be consistent. The imaginary plane formed by the tops of the universal balls and the upper plane of the die should be in the same plane, with a maximum height difference not greater than 0.60 mm, and only the upper plane of the die is allowed to be lower.
4) The positioning surfaces of the two pairs of jaw plates should be in the same plane, with a maximum height difference not greater than 0.10 mm.
5) The upper plane of the lower jaw of the two pairs of jaw plates should be lower than the imaginary plane formed by the tops of the universal balls, with a height difference of 0.30 to 0.50 mm.
6) When the punch is in the lower position, the depth of the punch entering the die should be no less than 4 mm.
7) After the punch enters the die, the clearance around it should be uniform. The difference between the maximum clearance and minimum clearance should not be greater than 0.20 mm.

8) When the drill bit is in the lower position and enters the pad die's round hole, the clearance around it should be uniform. The difference between the maximum clearance and minimum clearance should not be greater than 1.0 mm.
9) The ball screw pair installed on each moving axis should be run multiple times after assembly, and the backlash should not be greater than 0.05 mm.

10) The drag chain should be fixed properly. The hoses and cables in the drag chain should be arranged neatly without tangling or crossing. When the moving parts move, the drag chain should not shift or deform.

11) The bolts and screws should be tightened, and the anti-loosening washers should be effective. Bolts and nuts of the same specification at the same location should have consistent shapes and surface treatments. Screws inserted into countersunk holes should not protrude from the surface of the parts.
12) Each travel switch should be installed firmly, in the correct position, and with an appropriate sensing distance.
(9) Noise

When the composite machine is running, there should be no abnormal vibration, irregular impact sounds, or sharp screams. The equivalent continuous sound pressure level during idling should not be greater than 85 dB(A). The measurement method should comply with the provisions of GB/T 23281.
(10) Appearance

1) The appearance surface of the composite machine should not have protrusions, depressions, roughness, or other damages not specified in the drawings. The exposed machined surfaces should not have knocks, scratches, or rust.
2) The exposed welds should be in the form of smooth or uniform scaly wave patterns. Splatter on the surface should be cleaned up and ground smooth.

3) Non-machined surfaces should be filled with putty and polished smooth. The paint color should be uniform, without defects such as peeling, bubbles, flow marks, or missing spray. The dividing line between different paint colors should be clear.
4) Surfaces of bolts, nuts, oil cups, non-metallic pipes, and other surfaces that do not need to be painted should not have paint attached.
5) The exposed parts of various pipe lines should be arranged compactly, neatly, and fixed firmly.

6) The various nameplates on the composite machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 13306, with correct motion directions, clear and easy-to-understand text descriptions, conspicuous and appropriate installation positions, and neat and beautiful fixing. The stamped text should be clear and legible.
7) The protective layer of electroplated, blued, or blackened parts on the composite machine should be intact, without defects such as discoloration, cracking, peeling, or rust.
8) The surface of the protective cover of the composite machine should be flat and should not warp or dent.
Note: The expression "splatter" is not found in JB/T 8609—2014.
(11) Random technical documents and accessories
1) The random accessories, tools, and spare parts should be complete, and the wearing parts of the composite machine should be easy to replace.

2) The random technical documents of the composite machine should include the product instruction manual, product quality certificate, and packing list. The compilation of the random technical documents should comply with the relevant provisions of GB/T 23571. The instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T 9969.
2. Other
The operation test, accuracy, inspection rules and marks, packaging, storage, and transportation of the composite machine are specified in GB/T 33639—2017.
4.2.26 Trimming Hydraulic Press

There are no terms or definitions for "trimming hydraulic press" in GB/T 4174—2014 and JB/T 1881—2010. JB/T 1881—2010 stipulates the type and basic parameters of the trimming hydraulic press, which is suitable for trimming and punching processes of hot die forging parts (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).
Note: There is a definition of the term "trimming" in GB/T 8541—2012.

4.2.27 Hydraulic High-Speed Press

There are no terms or definitions for "hydraulic high-speed press" in GB/T 8541—2012, GB/T 36484—2018, JB/T 4174—2014, JB/T 12297.1—2015, JB/T 12297.2—2015, and JB/T 12297.3—2015. 1. Basic Parameters
1) The main parameter of the high-speed press is the rated force.
2) The structural type of the high-speed press is as shown in Figure 1 of JB/T 12297.1—2015.

4) The shape and size of the worktable hole of the high-speed press are shown in Figure 2 of JB/T 12297.1—2015 and Table 4-80 of this book.
5) The distribution form and size of the grooves and holes for fastening the mold of the high-speed press should comply with the requirements of JB/T 3847.

(3) Supporting Parts and Compatibility

items: The hydraulic press should be equipped with necessary accessories and spare vulnerable parts at the time of delivery. If the user has special requirements, the accessories and spare vulnerable parts can be determined jointly by the user and the manufacturer, and supplied randomly or ordered separately.

The purchased supporting parts (including hydraulic components, electrical components, pneumatic components, and sealing parts, etc.) and outsourced processed parts of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of the technical documents, obtain a qualification certificate, and must be installed on the hydraulic press for operational testing. For supporting parts that require safety certification, the manufacturer must obtain safety certification qualifications.
The hydraulic press should be equipped with conditions for installing an automatic feeding device.

sections.text: (4) Safety and Protection

items: The safety of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of GB 17120.
The operation of the hydraulic press should use two-hand operation buttons.
The operation of the hydraulic press should be safe and reliable. During single stroke operation, continuous strokes should not occur.
The operation of the hydraulic press should be light and flexible. The operating force of frequently used handles, handwheels, and foot switches should not exceed 50 N.
For parts that are prone to loosening during the operation of the hydraulic press, reliable anti-loosening devices should be installed.
The hydraulic system should be equipped with a safety device to prevent hydraulic overload.

The hydraulic press should be equipped with a safety protection device. The type can be selected by the user according to the provisions of GB 5091-2011 "Technical Requirements for Safety Protection Devices for Presses".

sections.text: (5) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts

items: The quality of castings and welded parts of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5775 and JB/T 8609, respectively. The quality of forgings should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
The frame, worktable, slider, and guide rails of important castings, forgings, and welded parts should undergo stress relief treatment.
Defects that do not affect use and appearance are allowed to be repaired according to the specified technical requirements, provided that quality is ensured.

(1) Inspection Requirements

items: 1) The requirements before the accuracy inspection of the quick press shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 10923.
2) The accuracy tolerance value of the inspection items shall be converted according to the actual inspection length, and the result of the conversion shall be rounded to 0.01 mm.

3) The order of the accuracy inspection items in JB/T 12297.3—2015 does not indicate the actual order of inspection. In order to facilitate the disassembly of the inspection tools and the inspection, the inspection can be carried out in any order.
4) During the accuracy inspection process, the parts and mechanisms that affect the accuracy shall not be adjusted or repaired.
5) When the user has special requirements, it is not necessary to inspect all items according to the provisions of JB/T 12297.3—2015.
6) The inspection of the flatness of planes G1 and G2 can be carried out according to the method specified in GB/T 11337—2004 "Detection of Flatness Error".

sections.text: (2) Geometric Accuracy, Tolerance, and Inspection Method

1) Inspection Items. The inspection item with serial number G5 is the verticality of the slider stroke relative to the plane of the worktable, including a) left-right verticality and b) front-back verticality.

2) Tolerance. When the nominal force Pn ≤ 630kN, the tolerance for left-right and front-back verticality is 0.03/100; when Pn > 630～2500kN, the tolerance for left-right and front-back verticality is 0.04/100.

3) Inspection Method. Refer to the provisions of 5.5.2.2.1 in GB/T 10923—2009. Place a straightedge on the worktable, place a try square on the straightedge, and fix the indicator on the slider so that its stylus touches the inspection surface of the try square. When the slider moves down from the top dead center, measure the left-right and front-back directions respectively. Perform the inspection at the maximum and minimum mold heights. The error is calculated as the difference between the maximum and minimum values that the indicator can measure. In the front-back direction, the reading of the indicator at the upper position of the stroke should not be less than the reading at the lower position of the stroke. If the quick press does not have a worktable, perform the same inspection on the worktable.

sections.text: 4.2.28 End Head Hydraulic Press

The terms and definitions of "End Head Hydraulic Press" are specified in GB/T 8541—2012, GB/T 36484—2018, JB/T 4174—2014, JB/T 12995.1—2017, JB/T 12995.2—2017 and JB/T 12995.3—2017. In JB/T 12995.1—2017, the types and basic parameters of end head hydraulic press are specified; in JB/T 12995.2—2017, the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, storage and warranty of end head hydraulic press are specified; in JB/T 12995.3—2017, the accuracy inspection of end head hydraulic press is specified, which is applicable to end head hydraulic press, but JB/T 12995.3—2017 is not applicable to super large end head hydraulic press manufactured on site by users.

(1) Types

sections.text: (10) Mechanical Processing

items: The grade and mechanical properties of the materials for the various machined parts of the hydraulic press for end forming should satisfy the functions of the hydraulic press for end forming and conform to the stipulations in the technical documentation.
The processing requirements for the main parts should conform to the stipulations in the technical documentation.

The processed surfaces should not have burrs, spots, or other mechanical damage, and should not have defects that reduce the quality of use of the hydraulic press for end forming or worsen its appearance. Except for special stipulations, sharp edges should be blunted.
The processing precision and surface roughness of the guide rail surfaces should ensure that the precision requirements and technical requirements of the hydraulic press for end forming are met.

The contact of the working surfaces of the guide rails should be uniform, and the cumulative value of the contact area should not be less than 80% in the full length of the guide rails and not less than 70% in the width of the guide rails.

sections.text: (11) Assembly

items: The hydraulic press for end forming should be assembled according to the technical documentation and drawings, and parts, their surfaces, and the lips of the sealing rings should not be damaged due to assembly. After assembly, the actions of each mechanism should be sensitive, accurate, and reliable.

After assembly, the heads of bolts and screws and the end faces of nuts should have uniform contact with the plane of the parts being fastened, and should not be tilted or have gaps. The lengths of screws assembled at the same part should generally be consistent. Fastened screws, bolts, and nuts should not have looseness, and the fastening force of screws affecting precision should be consistent.

Sealing parts should not have damage, and the sealing parts and sealing surfaces should be coated with lubricating grease before assembly. The direction of assembly should make the working pressure of the medium tightly press the lips. When assembling overlapping sealing rings, the rings should be pressed against each other, and the opening direction should be placed on the side with higher pressure.

After the assembly of moving and rotating parts, the movement should be smooth, flexible, light, and free of jamming. The rolling guide rail surface and all rolling bodies should have uniform contact, and the movement should be light, flexible, and free of jamming.

The important joint surfaces, after fastening, should be tightly fitted, and the gaps should conform to the stipulations in Table 4-85. The allowable depth of insertion of a feeler gauge should not exceed 1/4 of the width of the contact surface, and the cumulative length of the parts where a feeler gauge can be inserted between the contact surfaces should not exceed 1/10 of the circumference. The important joint surfaces are:
① The joint surface between the large nut and the crossbeam (upper crossbeam, lower crossbeam).
② The joint surface between the upper crossbeam, lower crossbeam, and the frame (referring to the columns in the frame type).
③ The joint surface between the flange shoulder of the hydraulic cylinder and the crossbeam.
④ The joint surface between the end faces of the piston rod and plunger and the slider.
⑤ The joint surface between the worktable and the lower crossbeam.

(12) Electrical Equipment

items: The electrical equipment of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the stipulations of GB 5226.1.
When a programmable controller or computer control is used, it should conform to the stipulations of the current relevant standards.

sections.text: (13) Hydraulic, Pneumatic, Lubricating, and Cooling Systems

items: The hydraulic system of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the requirements of GB/T 3766.
The purchased and self-made hydraulic components should conform to the stipulations of GB/T 7935.

The cast hydraulic cylinder and the rough-processed forged hydraulic cylinder of the hydraulic press for end forming should generally undergo a pressure test, with the test pressure being 1.25 times the working pressure, and the holding time should not be less than 10 min. After the test, the hydraulic cylinder should not leak and should have no permanent deformation. If the overall forged cylinder and the forged-structured hydraulic cylinder have process guarantees such as non-destructive testing, the intermediate pressure test may not be conducted.
During the operation of the hydraulic press for end forming, the oil temperature at the oil inlet of the oil tank of the hydraulic system should generally not exceed 60°C.
A filter device should be installed in the hydraulic system.
The oil tank must undergo a kerosene leakage test; an air filter should be installed in the open oil tank.
The pipe channels of the hydraulic and cooling systems and the inner surfaces of the oil tank should be thoroughly treated for rust prevention and decontamination before assembly.
The cleanliness of the hydraulic system should conform to the stipulations of JB/T 9954.

The pneumatic system of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the stipulations of GB/T 7932, and the installation slope of the pipeline on the side for discharging condensed water should not be less than 1:500.
The lubricating system of the hydraulic press for end forming should conform to the stipulations of GB/T 6576.

The important friction parts of the hydraulic press for end forming should generally adopt a centralized lubricating system. Only when a centralized lubricating system cannot be used can a decentralized lubricating device be adopted.
The cooling system should meet the temperature and temperature rise requirements of the hydraulic press for end forming.
The lubricating and cooling systems should continuously or periodically deliver lubricants and coolants to the specified parts as needed.

sections.text: 14) The hydraulic, pneumatic, lubrication and cooling systems should not leak oil, water or air. The coolant should not mix into the hydraulic and lubrication systems.
(14) Piping

items: The inner wall of the pipes used in hydraulic, pneumatic and lubrication systems should be smooth, without defects such as rust, flattening, etc.

Steel pipes with anti-corrosion treatment on the inner and outer surfaces can be directly installed and used. Steel pipes without anti-corrosion treatment should be pickled, and anti-rust measures should be taken in time after pickling.
Burrs at the pipe ends need to be removed before installing or welding steel pipes, and welding slag needs to be removed for welded pipelines.

sections.text: (15) Appearance

items: The appearance of the end cap hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of JB/T 1829.

The outer surfaces of hydraulic press components, electrical cabinets, and machine panels should not have obvious dents, scratches, cracks, deformations, etc. The surface coating should not have defects such as bubbles, cracks, peeling or rust.
The painting should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
The non-machined surfaces should be neat and beautiful.
The text descriptions, markings, patterns, etc. should be clear.
The protective covers and safety doors should be flat and uniform, without warping or depressions.

sections.text: 3. Test Method
The test method for the end cap hydraulic press is shown in JB/T 12995.2-2017.
4. Accuracy
(1) Inspection Instructions

items: The working table surface is the reference surface for the overall assembly accuracy inspection of the end cap hydraulic press.

Before the accuracy inspection, the end cap hydraulic press should be adjusted to be level, and the longitudinal and transverse level deviation of its working table surface should not exceed 0.20/1000.
For hydraulic presses equipped with a movable working table, the movable working table should be in the working position of the hydraulic press and locked firmly.
The accuracy inspection should be carried out separately after the no-load and full-load operation tests, and the value after the full-load operation test shall prevail.
The accuracy inspection should comply with the provisions of GB/T 10923, and other equivalent inspection methods may also be used.
When inspecting the plane, when the maximum length L of the surface to be inspected is ≤1000mm, the length l not to be inspected is 0.1L, and when L>1000mm, the length l not to be inspected is 100mm.
The actual inspection stroke L₃ should not be less than 30% of the slider stroke.
The flatness of the upper plane of the working table, the lower plane of the stretching slider, and the lower plane of the blank holder slider can be inspected before assembly.

The accuracy of the end cap hydraulic press is divided into four grades: Grade I, Grade II, Grade III and Grade IV according to the purpose. Users can select the accuracy grade according to the purpose of their products. The accuracy grades are shown in Table 4-86.

sections.text: 4.2.29 Mobile Rotary Head Frame Hydraulic Press

The mobile rotary head frame hydraulic press is a frame hydraulic press in which the head and the movable worktable can move left and right simultaneously or independently, and the head and the rotary worktable can rotate 360° simultaneously or independently. JB/T 12996.1—2017 stipulates the types and basic parameters of mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses with nominal forces ranging from 6000 to 20000 kN; JB/T 12996.2—2017 stipulates the technical requirements, inspection rules, test methods, accuracy inspection, marking, packaging and random documents for mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses; JB/T 12996.3—2017 stipulates the accuracy inspection items, tolerances and inspection methods for mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses, which are applicable to assembled mobile rotary head frame hydraulic presses whose head accuracy cannot be adjusted, and whose head and movable worktable can move, and whose head and rotary worktable can rotate.
1. Types and Basic Parameters

(1) Types
The basic type of the hydraulic press is a combined frame structure (see Figure 1 in JB/T 12996.1—2017).
Note: In JB/T 12996.1—2017, the installation type of the hydraulic cylinder in Figure 1 is MF7 with front flange and rear alignment; the piston rod connection type is flange (with external thread or flange at the end of the piston rod).

(2) Basic Parameters
1) The main parameter of the hydraulic press is the nominal force.
2) The basic parameters of the hydraulic press should comply with the provisions of Figure 1 in JB/T 12996.1—2017 and Table 4-89 in this book.
