sections.text: (5) Overload Test

The overload test shall be conducted in conjunction with the permitted setting value of the safety valve. The overload test pressure shall be 27 MPa. The test shall be conducted at least 3 times, each lasting 3 s. No damage or permanent deformation shall occur in any parts of the hydraulic press, and no leakage or other abnormal phenomena shall occur in the hydraulic system. During the overload test, the ram and the moving worktable shall be subjected to the overload test at the left and right extreme positions and the center position respectively.
(6) Accuracy Inspection
The accuracy inspection of the hydraulic press shall be conducted after the test, and the inspection method shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 12996.3—2017.
5. Accuracy
(1) Explanation of Accuracy Inspection

items: The working table surface is the reference surface for the overall assembly accuracy inspection.
Before the accuracy inspection, the hydraulic press shall be leveled, and the longitudinal and transverse level deviation of its working table surface shall not exceed 0.20/1000.
The accuracy inspection shall be conducted separately after the no-load and load operation tests, and the accuracy inspection value after the load operation test shall prevail.
The accuracy inspection method shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 10923, or other equivalent inspection methods may be used.

sections.text: (2) Accuracy Inspection

items: Parallelism between the lower plane of the ram and the moving worktable. The inspection method, tolerance, and inspection tools for the parallelism between the lower plane of the ram and the moving worktable shall be as specified in JB/T 12996.3—2017.

Perpendicularity of the ram movement trajectory to the moving worktable: Inspection method. Measurements shall be taken at the left extreme position, center position, and right extreme position on the upper surface of the moving worktable respectively. During the measurement, place a straight edge on the measuring surface of the moving worktable, place a square on the straight edge, fix the dial indicator on the lower plane of the ram, and make the measuring head of the dial indicator touch the measuring surface of the square. When the ram reciprocates within 1/3 of the lower limit of the stroke, measurements shall be taken in the left-right and front-back directions through the center respectively, and the maximum difference in the readings of the dial indicator is the measured value (the instantaneous jumping error that occurs when the ram starts, stops, and reverses is not included). Take the maximum value of the measured values at the three measuring positions as the error value of the perpendicularity of the ram movement trajectory to the worktable.
The measuring position is within 1/3 of the lower limit of the stroke.

1. Classification, Model, and Basic Parameters
(1) Type
1) Classification by frame structure
Hydraulic presses are classified into beam-column hydraulic presses and integral welded hydraulic presses according to the characteristics of their frame structure.

items: Beam-column hydraulic press. The frame of the beam-column hydraulic press is composed of an upper crossbeam, a lower crossbeam, and columns connected by threads.
Integral welded hydraulic press. The frame of the integral welded hydraulic press is formed by integral welding.

sections.text: 2) Classification by pressing characteristics
Hydraulic presses are classified into upper pressing hydraulic presses, lower pressing hydraulic presses, and bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic presses according to their pressing characteristics.

items: Upper pressing hydraulic press. The main hydraulic cylinder is installed on the upper crossbeam, and the upper mold core is driven to move downward to realize the pressing action.
Lower pressing hydraulic press. The main hydraulic cylinder is installed on the lower crossbeam, and the lower mold core is driven to move upward to realize the pressing action.

Bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic press. a. Upper and lower hydraulic cylinders bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic press. The upper and lower crossbeams are respectively equipped with main hydraulic cylinders, driving the upper and lower mold cores to move towards each other to realize bidirectional pressing. b. Lower movable crossbeam floating bidirectional pressurizing hydraulic press. Bidirectional pressing is realized by utilizing the speed difference between the main hydraulic cylinder and the frame floating hydraulic cylinder.

1. Type, Model and Basic Parameters
(1) Type

Hydraulic press is classified into two types based on its pressing method: hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of upper and lower hydraulic cylinders and hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of main hydraulic cylinder and floating mold frame. 1) Hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of upper and lower hydraulic cylinders. Main hydraulic cylinders are installed on the upper and lower beams respectively to drive the upper and lower mold cores to move towards each other, thus realizing double-acting pressing, represented by S. 2) Hydraulic press with double-acting pressurization of main hydraulic cylinder and floating mold frame. Double-acting pressing is realized by the upper main hydraulic cylinder or lower main hydraulic cylinder and mold frame to drive the hydraulic cylinder at different running speeds, represented by C.

4.2.33 Hydraulic Oil Press

Hydraulic oil press is a pressing equipment that uses Pascal's law to squeeze out grease from oil materials under pressure in the cake ring. Provisions for relevant terms and definitions, working principles, classification, models and basic parameters, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, signs, packaging, transportation and storage requirements of hydraulic oil press are specified in GB/T 25732-2010, applicable to intermittent hydraulic oil presses with a total pressure not exceeding 200kN.
1. Working Principle

Hydraulic oil press uses Pascal's mechanical principle, using liquid as the medium for pressure transmission to generate working pressure, so that oil materials are squeezed out of grease under pressure in the cake ring. It is a closed-loop system composed of two major parts: hydraulic system and oil press body.
2. Classification

items: 1) According to different piston plate movement modes: ① Vertical hydraulic oil press. Its piston plate moves vertically. ② Horizontal hydraulic oil press. Its piston plate moves horizontally.
2) According to different power sources: ① Manual pressurization hydraulic oil press. ② Electric pressurization hydraulic oil press.

sections.text: 3. Models and Basic Parameters
(1) Model Compilation Method: The model compilation method of hydraulic oil press shall comply with Appendix A of GB/T 25732-2010.

(2) Basic Parameter Items: The basic parameter items of hydraulic oil press include model specifications, production capacity, motor power, external dimensions, overall mass, working pressure, total pressure, service life and working time before first failure of key parts (such as piston plate and cake ring), etc. They should be clearly marked in technical documents such as instruction manuals.
4. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements

items: 1) Hydraulic oil press shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 25732-2010 standard, and be manufactured according to drawings and technical documents approved through prescribed procedures.
2) Raw materials, purchased parts, outsourced parts, etc. shall be accompanied by qualification certificates, and can only be used after passing acceptance.
3) Plate-shaped steel structural parts shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 24857.
4) Castings shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 24856.
5) Welded parts shall comply with the provisions of LS/T 3051.6.
6) The quality of main parts shall comply with the provisions of LS/T 3501.2.
7) Assembly shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 24855.
8) Product painting shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 25218.
9) The selection of materials and mechanical processing quality of the hydraulic system shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766.

sections.text: (2) Mechanical Performance

items: 1) Operation should be normal and stable, without abnormal vibration or noise.
2) Various adjustment, operation, display and other devices must be complete, sensitive, accurate and reliable.
3) During normal operation, the no-load noise should not exceed 85dB(A).
4) The verticality of the piston rod or plunger of the main hydraulic cylinder to the pressure-bearing beam should be less than or equal to 1.5/1000 throughout the entire stroke.
5) The installation of hydraulic components and pipelines should prevent sealing parts from being scratched, ensuring no external leakage. Exposed pipelines should be arranged neatly and firmly.
6) The unit pressure of the oil press on the cake surface should not be less than 9MPa.
7) During the pressure test, the hydraulic system should have no external leakage; the pressure drop after stabilization for 15 minutes should be less than 4% of the working pressure.

sections.text: (3) Safety Requirements

items: 1) Safety warning signs should comply with the provisions of GBZ 158-2003 "Occupational Disease Hazard Warning Signs in Workplaces".
2) The electrical safety of the equipment should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1, and its overload protection and grounding protection should have interlocking devices.
3) The hydraulic system should have an overload protection device.

(1) Test Conditions and Requirements

items: The test site and prototype should meet the requirements for the determination items and install necessary auxiliary equipment according to the requirements of the oil pressing process.
During the same test, the operation of the prototype, measurement, inspection, and testing of the oil products should be equipped with fixed and skilled personnel.
The hydraulic oil used in the test should meet the requirements for hydraulic oil specified in the instruction manual.
The room temperature of the test site should not be lower than 20°C.
The instruments and meters used in the test should be qualified after verification and within the validity period.

The test operation can be performed by electric pressurization or manual pressurization. When using electric power, the test power supply voltage should be 380V, with a deviation not exceeding ±5%. During the test, the motor load should not exceed 10% of the rated power.

sections.text: (2) Main Performance Testing

items: Pressure Test. Perform 5 consecutive pressurizations on the oil press to the safety valve's popping pressure, observe and record the pressure gauge readings each time the valve pops. After the safety valve test is completed, perform the overall pressure test. Pressurize the oil press, extend the piston to its maximum stroke, stop pressurizing when the pressure gauge reading is 1.25 times the working pressure, stabilize for 15 min, record the pressure gauge reading, and observe whether there is any oil leakage in the hydraulic system; after depressurization, observe and measure the deformation of each component.

Verticality Inspection. Use test tools to inspect whether the verticality of the piston rod or plunger of the main hydraulic cylinder to the pressure beam meets the requirements throughout the entire stroke.

4.2.3.4 Isothermal Forging Hydraulic Press

Isothermal forging hydraulic press is a precision forging hydraulic press suitable for isothermal forging process. JB/T 12517.1—2015 specifies the terms and definitions, types and basic parameters of isothermal forging hydraulic presses with a nominal force of 3150~100000 kN; JB/T 12517.2—2015 specifies the precision inspection of isothermal forging hydraulic presses, applicable to isothermal forging hydraulic presses (hereinafter referred to as hydraulic press).

sections.text: 4.2.35  Hydraulic Press for Free Forging with Direct Drive Pump and Tilted Double-Column

The hydraulic press for free forging is a hydraulic press that uses high-pressure liquid transmission and is used for free forging processing. In the first product standard for free forging hydraulic presses in China, JB/T 12229—2015, the types and technical parameters, technical conditions, test methods, inspection and acceptance rules, markings, packaging, transportation, and storage of hydraulic presses for free forging with direct drive pump and tilted double-column are specified. It is applicable to hydraulic presses for free forging with direct drive pump and tilted double-column that use mineral oil-based hydraulic oil as the working medium (hereinafter referred to as double-column forging hydraulic press).
1. Types and Technical Parameters
(1) Types

There are two basic types of frames for double-column forging hydraulic press: pre-stressed combined frame with tilted double-column and integral frame with tilted double-column. The transmission types of the main (side) cylinder are upper transmission and lower transmission. When applicable, a tilted double-column pre-stressed combined frame with lower transmission type can also be used, as well as a "cylinder-moving" type of tilted double-column frame. The main (side) cylinder is generally a plunger type. The connection between it and the movable crossbeam or the integral frame should preferably adopt a double-ball hinge connecting rod shaft structure. The guiding method of the movable crossbeam or the integral frame adopts an adjustable clearance plane guiding structure.
Note: In JB/T 12229—2015, "double-column combined frame" and "double-column integral frame" are defined.

items: 1) Tilted double-column pre-stressed combined frame with upper transmission forging hydraulic press (type shown in Figure 1a of JB/T 12229—2015).
2) Tilted double-column integral frame with lower transmission forging hydraulic press (type shown in Figure 1b of JB/T 12229—2015).

sections.text: (2) Technical Parameters

1) Main Parameters (Nominal Force) Series. The main parameters (nominal force) series of the double-column forging hydraulic press are arranged in an approximate geometric series, with the rounded values of the preferred number R10 specified in GB/T 321 as the common ratio. See Table 4-110.

2) Maximum Working Pressure of Liquid and Grading of Forging Force

The series of maximum working pressure of liquid for double-column forging hydraulic presses and the grading of forging force under different forging conditions are shown in Table 4-112. When the nominal force is greater than or equal to 63 MN, three cylinders of equal diameter should be configured; when three cylinders of unequal diameter are configured, the main cylinder should have the largest diameter, and the side cylinders should have the smallest diameter; when the nominal force is less than 25 MN, a single cylinder configuration is generally used.
Note: For the setting of return stroke cylinders, please refer to Appendix A of JB/T 12229-2015.

Generally, the forging force of level 3 used under normal forging conditions is less than the nominal force; during upsetting, the working pressure of the liquid can be adjusted to the maximum working pressure according to the deformation requirements, i.e., reaching the nominal force of the hydraulic press. sections.text: The double-column forging hydraulic press should be arranged near one side of the column axis of the factory building. The moving direction of the movable working table is determined as the longitudinal direction of the hydraulic press, and the direction of the anvil's transverse movement perpendicular to the movable working table is determined as the transverse direction of the hydraulic press. The angle between the center line connecting the two columns and the center line of the anvil's transverse movement is the oblique angle α of the frame.

The appropriate oblique angle α should meet the requirements of the lateral clearance distance of the columns specified in Table 4-113; it should also take into account the longitudinal clearance distance of the columns, maximize the allowable eccentric distances in both the lateral and longitudinal directions, and it is advisable to set the anvil's transverse movement device between the columns; it should facilitate the operator in the control room to observe the state of the anvil and the forging held by the operation machine on the hydraulic press, and consider the accessibility of the main hook of the crane.

The length of the movable working table should at least meet the needs of arranging the upsetting table and a pair of anvils, and there should be an appropriate interval distance between the anvil tools. The stroke of the movable working table should meet the needs of moving the anvil tools out of the hydraulic press for convenient replacement of anvil tools, loading and unloading of forgings, and other auxiliary operations by the crane. It can be selected to have equal strokes in both directions, or different strokes towards and away from the operation machine side.

According to the needs of the forging process of the product, adjustments can be made to the size and stroke of the working table surface; the thickness dimension of the working table should refer to Appendix A of JB/T 12229-2015. An upper anvil pad should be installed between the lower plane of the movable crossbeam or the upper beam of the integral frame and the upper anvil, and its thickness dimension should refer to Appendix A of JB/T 12229-2015.

Under normal forging conditions, the working speed of the hydraulic press should comply with the regulations in Table 4-113. The working speed value under upsetting conditions should be separately specified in the contract or agreement.

Both the normal forging frequency and the finishing frequency are calculated values of the number of working cycles per minute of the hydraulic press, and are related to parameters such as the pressing amount, return amount, and their corresponding working speeds. Among them, the pressing amount has a wide selection range and is closely related to factors such as the rated force of the hydraulic press, forging material, deformation process, operation method, etc. During hot normal forging, it is generally calculated based on the pressing amount usually used in the forging process; during hot finishing, the minimum pressing amount can generally be selected within 3-30 mm.
For the forging capacity of the double-column forging hydraulic press and its matching with the main parameters of the forging operation machine, please refer to Appendix B of JB/T 12229-2015.
2. Technical Requirements
(1) General Technical Requirements
1) The general technical conditions of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of JB/T 1829 and JB/T 3818.

2) The scope of equipment for the double-column forging hydraulic press includes: the hydraulic press body (including the upper anvil rotation and quick-change device), hydraulic transmission and control system (including the pump station, operation valve and pipelines, etc.), electrical transmission and control system (including the control cabinet, operation panel and pipelines, etc.), lubrication system, special tools, a pair of upper and lower flat anvils and their bases, and necessary consumables.

3) The mechanized equipment and auxiliary devices of the double-column forging hydraulic press (such as the anvil's transverse movement device, anvil library, ingot rotation lifting platform or ingot transfer trolley, forging temperature measurement device, etc.) and other forging tools (such as various special-shaped anvil tools, rotating forging table, and spare parts, etc.) can be selected according to actual production needs.

4) The working environment temperature of the double-column forging hydraulic press (including the pump station) can be 5-40°C, with a relative humidity of less than or equal to 85%, and an altitude of less than 2500 m. If there are special working environment requirements, they should be clearly stated in the technical agreement.

5) Within 12 months from the day of the load test acceptance of the double-column forging hydraulic press, if damage occurs due to design and manufacturing reasons under the conditions of correct use, normal maintenance and care, the manufacturer should provide free corresponding repair or part replacement (except for consumables).

6) After the double-column forging hydraulic press is put into use, under the conditions of correct use and normal maintenance and care, the first comprehensive overhaul should be arranged after 28,500 hours of load work or between 4-6 years of use.

7) The product manual of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comprehensively provide product knowledge and usage methods suitable for the expected function, which should include important information related to the safety and economical use of the hydraulic press, as well as the drawings and technical documents provided with the product. This information should help prevent dangers, reduce maintenance costs and downtime, and improve the reliability and service life of the hydraulic press.
(2) Safety and Environmental Protection
1) The safety and health design of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB 5083.
2) The safety protection of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB 17120 and JB/T 3915 (which has been abolished).
3) The hydraulic transmission and control system of the double-column forging hydraulic press should be equipped with overload safety protection devices.
4) The safety requirements of the electrical transmission and control system of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB 5226.1.
5) The double-column forging hydraulic press and its mechanized equipment and auxiliary devices should be equipped with safety interlocking control and stroke limit protection devices.
6) The double-column forging hydraulic press should be equipped with emergency stop buttons on the operation panel in the control room, the control system, the pump station, and other locations.
7) The noise limit value of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB 26484.
8) The measurement methods for the noise sound pressure level and sound power level of the double-column forging hydraulic press should comply with the regulations of GB/T 23281 and GB/T 23282.

9) The scrap or leaked working medium of the double-column forging hydraulic press should be entrusted to a qualified professional company for recycling and treatment, or processed according to the requirements of the local environmental protection department. It is prohibited to burn it by oneself or dump, abandon, and discharge it at will.
10) The double-column forging hydraulic press uses mineral oil hydraulic oil as the working medium.

The hydraulic press uses oil as the working medium and is a device directly driven by a hydraulic pump to generate force, equipped with oil pressure and gas pressure systems. Therefore, the fire prevention requirements for the design and use of hydraulic presses should be consistent with recognized fire safety standards. In addition, the following requirements should be followed:

items: Pressurized charging tanks should be filled with nitrogen or other inert gases and should preferably be installed in the pump station or below ground level.

An emergency quick shut-off valve should be installed on the charging outlet pipe of the charging tank, or an emergency quick vent valve should be installed on the gas side of the charging tank, and should be interlocked with the emergency stop button on the control panel.
All hydraulic devices installed on the top of the hydraulic press should emphasize reliable design, correct installation, and maintenance.
The design grade of hydraulic pipelines, flanges, and fasteners should be adapted to the pressure they may bear.
Oil tanks, flanges, joints, and valve blocks on the top of the hydraulic press should be designed with anti-spray oil facilities.
Reliable oil leakage collection devices should be installed for each working cylinder, pump station, valve block, pipeline, etc.

sections.text: The product manual should clearly list fire safety guidelines and propose engineering design requirements for fire alarm installation, and prevention of fire spread and expansion.
11) It is encouraged to research and adopt appropriate measures and devices for oxide scale cleaning and collection.
(3) Strength and stiffness conditions of the frame

items: Double-column forging hydraulic presses should use computer three-dimensional finite element (FEM) analysis to calculate and analyze the stress and deformation of the frame, especially paying attention to the optimization design of high stress concentration areas (such as sand hole, transition fillet, and sections with drastic changes).

The equivalent stress and stiffness values of the frame can be taken as the values specified in Table 4-114. Among them, the stiffness of the upper and lower beams is expressed as the deflection per meter span between the center distances of the columns in the wide face, and the column stiffness is the deflection in the horizontal direction of the column under the condition of elongation and within the allowable forging eccentricity.

The tie rods in the combined frame should be designed with high-strength multi-tie rod design, while single tie rods can also be used for small (nominal force less than or equal to 25 MN) or other special structural design double-column forging hydraulic presses.

The shortest length of the lower beam in the direction of movement of the worktable should be able to withstand the pressing force during core bar reaming, and its length value can be found in Appendix A of JB/T12229-2015.

sections.text: (4) Manufacturing and performance of key components

1) The upper beam, movable beam, lower beam, column, and frame in the overall frame of the combined frame are generally manufactured with low alloy steel castings specified in JB/T6402, and should be subjected to stress relief heat treatment. After rough machining, secondary heat treatment should also be performed. Select appropriate materials and ReL values according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor should be 2 to 2.5 (take the upper limit for small hydraulic presses and the lower limit for large hydraulic presses). The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the standards used (selected materials).

2) The tie rods in the combined frame are generally manufactured with alloy structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6396, and should be subjected to quenching and tempering heat treatment. Select appropriate materials and ReL values according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor should be 2.5 to 3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the selected material standards. The inspection items and sampling quantity should meet the requirements of Level V of the forgings acceptance grouping specified in JB/T5000.8-2007.

3) The main (side) cylinder and return cylinder are generally manufactured with alloy structural steel forgings specified in GB/T1591, NB/T47008, and JB/T6396, or carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6397. They can also be manufactured by welding method with split forgings. The forgings should be subjected to quenching and tempering heat treatment. Select appropriate materials and ReL values according to the calculated stress, and the safety factor should be greater than or equal to 3. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the standards used (selected materials). The inspection items and sampling quantity should meet the requirements of Level V of the forgings acceptance grouping specified in JB/T5000.8-2007, and the tangential mechanical properties ReL, Rm, Z, A, and Ak should be inspected for each piece.

4) The main cylinder plunger of the column is generally manufactured with alloy structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6369 or carbon structural steel forgings specified in JB/T6397, and should be subjected to corresponding heat treatment. The chemical composition and mechanical properties of the materials should meet the requirements of the selected material standards. The surface of the plunger should be hardened, and the hardness of the working surface should not be lower than 45 HRC. The thickness of the hardened layer should be greater than 3 mm.
5) The surface hardness of the column guide plate should not be lower than 400 HBW.
6) The tensile strength of the sliding plate material on the lower beam should be well matched with the sliding plate under the movable worktable.
(5) Castings, forgings, and welded parts

items: The general technical conditions of steel castings for products should meet the requirements of JB/T5000.6.
The general technical conditions of non-ferrous metal castings for products should meet the requirements of JB/T5000.5.

sections.text: 3) The general technical conditions for cast iron parts of the product shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.4.
4) The general technical conditions for forgings of the product shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.8.
5) The general technical conditions for welded parts of the product shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.3.
6) The general technical conditions for flame-cut parts during product manufacturing shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.2.

7) The general technical conditions for repair welding of cast steel parts of the product shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.7, and ultrasonic testing and magnetic particle testing shall be performed on the repair welding areas according to the provisions of JB/T 5000.14.

8) The general technical conditions for non-destructive testing of cast steel parts of the product shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.14. In addition, the following requirements shall be met: ① The positions and levels of ultrasonic testing or magnetic particle testing of the upper crossbeam, movable crossbeam, lower crossbeam, columns or integral frame, and fixed beam after rough machining shall be clearly marked on the drawing. ② When the non-destructive testing depth of the upper and lower processing planes of each beam and the upper and lower end processing planes of the columns is less than or equal to 400 mm, the ultrasonic testing level shall be Grade III.
③ The magnetic particle testing level of the important transition arc surfaces of each beam and the upper and lower end processing planes of the columns shall be Grade II.

9) The general technical conditions for non-destructive testing of forged steel parts of the product shall comply with the provisions of JB/T 5000.15. In addition, the following requirements shall be met:

items: The ultrasonic testing level of the working cylinder forging shall be Grade III according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and the ultrasonic testing level of the cylinder weld shall be Grade BII according to GB/T 11345-2013. When the cylinder thickness is greater than 300 mm, tandem scanning shall be added; the magnetic particle testing level of the arc at the bottom of the cylinder shall be Grade II according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and when applicable, it can also be executed according to the provisions of JB/T 4730.3 (which has been repealed).

The ultrasonic testing level within 350 mm of the outer surface of the working cylinder plunger shall be Grade III according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and greater than 350 mm shall be Grade IV; when the plunger is of welded structure, the ultrasonic testing levels of the forging and weld shall be the same as those of the working cylinder. The outer surface of the plunger shall be subjected to magnetic particle testing, and no cracks or other defects are allowed; when applicable, it can also be executed according to the provisions of JB/T 4730.4 or JB/T 4730.5 (the JB/T 4730 series of standards was repealed on September 1, 2015).

The ultrasonic testing level within 100 mm of the outer surface of the tie rod shall be Grade II according to JB/T 5000.15-2007, and the rest shall be Grade III; the surface of the tie rod shall be subjected to magnetic particle testing, and no cracks or other defects are allowed.

sections.text: 4.2.3.6 Electro-Hydraulic Hammer

The terms "electro-hydraulic hammer" and its definition are not included in GB/T8541-2012, GB/T36484-2018, JB/T4174-2014, GB/T25718-2010, and GB/T25719-2010. In GB/T25718-2010, the types and basic parameters of electro-hydraulic hammers are specified, applicable to anvil-based, gas-liquid driven, and hydraulic driven electro-hydraulic hammers; in GB/T25719-2010, the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, and marking, packaging, transportation, and storage of electro-hydraulic hammers are specified, applicable to electro-hydraulic hammers (including anvil-based free forging electro-hydraulic hammers, die forging electro-hydraulic hammers, and CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers), and also applicable to the electro-hydraulic power heads for transforming steam-air forging hammers.

Note: In GB/T25718-2010, terms such as "double-arm free forging electro-hydraulic hammer, single-arm free forging electro-hydraulic hammer, bridge-type free forging electro-hydraulic hammer, die forging electro-hydraulic hammer, and CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammer" are defined.

1) Double-arm free forging electro-hydraulic hammer (see Figure 1 in GB/T 25718—2010).
2) Bridge-type free forging electro-hydraulic hammer (see Figure 2 in GB/T 25718—2010).
3) Single-arm free forging electro-hydraulic hammer (see Figure 3 in GB/T 25718—2010).
4) Die forging electro-hydraulic hammer (see Figure 4 in GB/T 25718—2010).
5) CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammer (see Figure 5 in GB/T 25718—2010).

sections.text: 2. Technical Requirements
(1) Basic Requirements

items: The electro-hydraulic hammer should comply with the provisions of JB/T 1829 and GB/T 25719-2010 standards, and be manufactured according to approved drawings and technical documents.
Cast iron parts should comply with JB/T 5775, and welded parts should comply with JB/T 8609.
The instruction manual should comply with GB/T 9969.

Important forgings should undergo ultrasonic testing (such as hammer rod, hammer head, anvil block, etc.). The ultrasonic testing should comply with JB/T 8467, and relevant records should be maintained.
The random spare parts and accessories of the electro-hydraulic hammer should be interchangeable and comply with relevant technical documents.
All fasteners used in the electro-hydraulic power head and frame should be equipped with anti-loosening measures. The power head and frame should be provided with vibration damping pads.

sections.text: (2) Type and Basic Parameters
The type and basic parameters of the electro-hydraulic hammer should comply with GB/T 25718, except for special requirements from users.
(3) Performance

items: The operating system of the electro-hydraulic hammer should be safe, reliable, and flexible.

Free forging electro-hydraulic hammers and die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be able to achieve hammer head lifting, holding, heavy striking, light striking, slow lowering, pressing, and emergency stop functions. By changing the lifting height of the hammer head, the striking energy of the electro-hydraulic hammer can be altered. CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers can achieve lifting, heavy striking, light striking, and slow lowering functions. By adjusting the closing time of the striking valve, the striking energy of the electro-hydraulic hammer can be precisely controlled to meet the requirements of the forging process. The striking energy control accuracy of CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be ±3%.
The moving parts of the electro-hydraulic hammer, such as the hammer head system (welded hammer head and hammer rod), should be flexible and free of jamming within the effective stroke.

During normal use of free forging electro-hydraulic hammers and die forging electro-hydraulic hammers, the hammer should be able to lift the hammer head from the closed position to any position within the stroke height. If striking is not immediately performed, a slight sliding of the suspended hammer head is allowed, but the sliding distance within 5 seconds should not exceed 10 mm.

In the instant of striking with free forging electro-hydraulic hammers and die forging electro-hydraulic hammers, if a misoperation is detected, an immediate emergency stop should be possible. This anti-misoperation function should only be used in emergency situations.
During the slow lowering process, CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should operate in a jog mode. The sliding distance within 5 seconds in the stopped state should not exceed 5 mm.
A return stop device should be installed to ensure that the hammer head system does not experience rigid impact at the maximum return speed.

When required by the user, die forging electro-hydraulic hammers and CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be equipped with an ejector device. The ejecting force should be at least 10 times the weight of the hammer head.

Adjusting the striking energy of CNC die forging electro-hydraulic hammers should be convenient. After replacing different dies, the die closing height parameters should be re-entered, and the striking energy should be automatically adjusted.

sections.text: (4) Appearance

items: The appearance quality of the electro-hydraulic hammer should comply with JB/T 1829.

After removing sand, adhering sand, scabs, and excess material from the external surface of castings, the flatness of the unmachined surface should be checked using a 500 mm straight edge. The deviation should not exceed 2.5 mm.

The anvil base and embedded parts should only be painted with anti-rust paint. Riveted and welded parts may not be puttied. The putty thickness should not exceed 1.5 mm, and local thickening should not exceed 3 mm.

4.2.37 Hydraulic universal testing machine

The hydraulic universal testing machine is a universal testing machine that uses a hydraulic system to apply force and measure force for testing. GB/T 26111-2007 "General Technical Conditions for Testing Machines" stipulates the basic requirements for testing machines, and also stipulates the requirements for assembly and mechanical safety, machined parts, castings and welded parts, electrical equipment, hydraulic equipment, appearance quality, and random technical documents, which are applicable to metal material testing machines, non-metal material testing machines, balancing machines, vibration tables, impact tables and collision test tables, force and deformation measuring instruments, process testing machines, packaging testing machines, and non-destructive testing instruments (hereinafter collectively referred to as testing machines).

Note: The universal testing machine is a material testing machine that can perform tensile, compression, bending tests, and more than three kinds of tests. Universal testing machines have mechanical, hydraulic, electronic, and electro-hydraulic servo types; they can measure the bending strength, deflection, and other mechanical properties of materials; they can also perform "cold bending (or hot bending) tests" for the ductility test of material bending deformation. This type of test belongs to the process performance test.
Among them, the requirements for hydraulic equipment (i.e., Chapter 8 of GB/T 26111-2007) are as follows:

items: The working surfaces of parts such as pistons, hydraulic cylinders, and valves in the hydraulic system shall not have cracks or scratches.
The hydraulic transmission part should not produce vibration, impact, and stagnation beyond the specified range within the working speed range.
The hydraulic system should be equipped with an exhaust device and reliable sealing, and there should be no oil leakage.

The structure and shape of the oil tank should meet the following requirements: ① Under normal working conditions, it should be able to accommodate all the hydraulic oil flowing from the system. ② Prevent the polluted hydraulic oil that overflows and leaks from directly returning to the oil tank. ③ The shape at the bottom of the oil tank should allow the hydraulic oil to be completely discharged. ④ The oil tank should be easy to clean and be equipped with an oil filling port and an oil discharge port. ⑤ The oil tank should be equipped with an oil level indicator.

The hydraulic system should be provided with waterproof and dustproof measures. To eliminate harmful impurities in the hydraulic oil, a filter device should be installed to make the hydraulic oil reach the specified cleanliness. Systems containing servo valves and proportional valves should be equipped with non-bypass filters at the pressure oil port.
Sufficient space should be left at the installation position of the filter device for replacement.
The outlets of all return oil pipes and drain oil pipes should be below the oil level to prevent foam generation and air entry.
When the working pressure or flow in the hydraulic system loop exceeds the specified value and may cause danger or accidents, a protection device should be provided.
The hydraulic transmission part should be equipped with a working stroke limit switch when necessary.

When there are one or more interconnected automatic or manual control devices in the hydraulic system, if any failure of any one of them may cause personal injury and equipment damage, an interlock protection device should be installed.

When the hydraulic system is in the parking position, if the return of hydraulic oil from valves, pipelines, and actuators to the oil tank will cause equipment damage or danger, measures should be taken to prevent the hydraulic oil from returning to the oil tank.

GB/T 3159-2008 specifies the main parameter series, technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, markings and packaging of hydraulic universal testing machines and hydraulic pressure testing machines, which is applicable to hydraulic universal testing machines and hydraulic pressure testing machines for mechanical property testing of metal materials, and also applicable to hydraulic universal testing machines and hydraulic pressure testing machines for mechanical property testing of non-metallic materials (hereinafter referred to as testing machines). Horizontal hydraulic tensile testing machines can also be used as a reference.

The normative reference files in GB/T 3159-2008 "Hydraulic Universal Testing Machine" include GB/T2611-2007 "General Technical Requirements for Testing Machines" and GB/T1682.5-2008 "Verification of Static Uniaxial Testing Machines Part 1: Verification and Calibration of Force Measuring Systems for Tensile and/or Compression Testing Machines" and other standards. 1. Electro-hydraulic servo universal testing machine

The electro-hydraulic servo universal testing machine is a universal testing machine that uses a hydraulic system to apply force and adopts electronic measurement and hydraulic servo control technology for testing. GB/T 16826—2008 specifies the main parameter series, technical requirements, test methods, test rules, marking and packaging of the electro-hydraulic servo universal testing machine that uses hydraulic power, adopts electronic measurement and servo control technology to measure mechanical performance parameters, which is applicable to the electro-hydraulic servo universal testing machine (hereinafter referred to as the testing machine) with a maximum test force not greater than 3000 kN for tensile, compression, bending and shear mechanical performance tests of metal and non-metal materials. It is also applicable to the electro-hydraulic servo pressure testing machine. Testing machines with a maximum test force greater than 3000 kN can also be used as a reference. The normative referenced documents in GB/T 16826—2008 include GB/T 2611—2007 "General Technical Requirements for Testing Machines", GB/T 16825.1—2008 "Verification of Static Uniaxial Testing Machines Part 1: Verification and Calibration of Force Measuring Systems of Tensile and/or Compression Testing Machines", GB/T 22066—2008 "Evaluation of Computer Data Acquisition Systems for Static Uniaxial Testing Machines" and JB/T 6146—2007 "Extensometer Technical Conditions" and other standards. 2. Electro-hydraulic Servo Static and Dynamic Universal Testing Machine

The electro-hydraulic servo static and dynamic universal testing machine is a testing machine that uses an electro-hydraulic servo control system to apply both static and dynamic forces, combining the functions of an electronic universal testing machine and a fatigue testing machine. JB/T 8612-2015 stipulates the symbols and descriptions, main parameter series, technical requirements, inspection methods, inspection rules, markings, and packaging of the electro-hydraulic servo static and dynamic universal testing machine for conducting static and dynamic mechanical property tests on metallic and non-metallic materials (hereinafter referred to as the testing machine).

The normative references in JB/T 8612-2015 include GB/T 2611-2007 "General Technical Requirements for Testing Machines," GB/T 16825.1-2008 "Verification of Static Uniaxial Testing Machines Part 1: Verification and Calibration of Force-Measuring Systems of Tension and/or Compression Testing Machines," GB/T 25917-2010 "Dynamic Force Calibration of Axial Force Fatigue Testing Machines," and JB/T 6146-2007 "Extensometer Technical Conditions," etc.
JB/T 8612-2015 deletes the grading of testing machines.

The main parameter of the testing machine is the maximum static test force, and the specifications of the testing machine are divided according to the main parameter, which also characterizes the maximum capacity of the testing machine. sections.text: (2) Technical Requirements
1) Environment and working conditions. The testing machine should be able to work normally under the following conditions:
① The ambient temperature should be within the range of 10-35°C.
② The relative humidity should not exceed 80%.
③ It should be in an environment without corrosive media.
④ The fluctuation range of the power supply voltage should be within ±10% of the rated voltage.
⑤ It should be correctly installed on a solid foundation with a levelness of 0.2/1000.
2) Force Application System
① General requirements.

a. The frame of the testing machine should have sufficient rigidity and test space, should be able to easily perform various tests, and should facilitate the loading and unloading of specimens, specimen clamping devices, and testing machine accessories, as well as the installation and use of standard force-measuring instruments.
b. The testing machine should work normally within its given frequency response characteristics.
c. The testing machine should be stable and free from impact and vibration during the application and removal of force.
② Hydraulic system. The hydraulic cylinder, piston, valve, piping, and joints of the hydraulic system should comply with the provisions of Chapter 8 of GB/T 2611-2007.
③ Tensile test specimen clamping device. The technical requirements for the tensile test specimen clamping device of the testing machine are specified in JB/T 8612-2015.
④ Compression test device. The technical requirements for the compression test device of the testing machine are specified in JB/T 8612-2015.
⑤ Bending test device. The technical requirements for the bending test device of the testing machine are specified in JB/T 8612-2015.
3) Force Measuring System
① General requirements.

a. The force measuring system should be able to indicate the force value in real-time and continuously through a computer display or digital indicator. The numbers displayed on the indicating device should be clear, easy to read, and have an indication of the force application direction (such as "+" or "-"). Regardless of the type of indicating device, the force value should be directly displayed in units of force.
b. The testing machine should be able to accurately store, indicate, and record the peak and valley values of the cyclic force during the test.
c. The force measuring system should have the function of zeroing and/or clearing.
d. The warm-up time of the testing machine should not exceed 30 min. After warm-up, the maximum allowable zero drift within 15 min should be ±1% of the lower limit of the force measuring range.
② Static Force
a. The maximum allowable relative error of the static force indication is ±1%.
b. The repeatability of the static force indication should not exceed 1%.
c. The maximum allowable difference between the forward and reverse readings (reversibility) is ±1.5%.
d. The maximum allowable relative error of the zero point is ±0.5%.

e. The minimum relative resolution of the testing machine's force measuring system is 0.5%, and the discrimination threshold of the force measuring system should not exceed 0.25% of the lower limit of the measuring range.
③ Circulating force

items: a. The maximum permissible relative error of the indicated value of the circulating force is ±2%.
b. The repeatability of the indicated value of the circulating force should not exceed 2%.
④ Extensometer system. The extensometer system consists of an extensometer and a deformation signal measurement and display unit of the testing machine.

⑤ Displacement measurement system. a. The minimum resolution of the displacement indicator of the crossbeam is 0.01 mm. b. Within the measuring range, the maximum permissible relative error of the displacement indicator of the crossbeam is ±1%.
⑥ Control system. The technical requirements for the control system of the testing machine are specified in JB/T 8612—2015.

⑦ Safety protection. a. The testing machine should be equipped with an overload protection device. When the applied force exceeds 2% to 10% of the maximum capacity of the testing machine, the overload protection device should ensure that the testing machine stops automatically. b. The testing machine should have an alarm or automatic shutdown protection function for oil temperature, liquid level reaching extreme values, and filter blockage. c. During the testing process, after the specimen breaks, the testing machine should stop automatically.
⑧ Noise. The noise level of the testing machine (excluding the hydraulic source) during operation should not exceed 75 dB(A).

⑨ Shock resistance during transportation: The testing machine should be able to withstand shock tests during packaging without damage. After the test, the testing machine should still be able to meet all the requirements of GB/T 8612—2015 without adjustment (except for normal adjustments permitted by the operating procedures).

⑩ Other requirements. The assembly quality, mechanical safety requirements, and appearance quality of the testing machine should comply with the provisions of Chapter 4 and Chapter 10 of GB/T 2611—2007.

items: The standard to be followed should be clearly stated in the contract or agreement, whether it is GB/T 16826—2008 or JB/T 8612—2015, so as to determine the design and manufacturing of the hydraulic cylinder for what kind of testing machine.

sections.text: 3. Electro-hydraulic servo cement pressure testing machine

The electro-hydraulic servo cement pressure testing machine is a pressure testing machine that uses a hydraulic system to apply force and uses electronic measurement and hydraulic servo control technology to perform compression tests on cement and other building materials and their products. JB/T 8763—2013 specifies the technical requirements, inspection methods, inspection rules, marking and packaging, and accompanying documents of electro-hydraulic cement pressure testing machines, applicable to electro-hydraulic cement pressure testing machines with a maximum test pressure not exceeding 300 kN (hereinafter referred to as the testing machine).
Technical requirements

items.text: Environmental and working conditions. The testing machine should be able to work normally under the following environmental and working conditions: a. Room temperature in the range of 10 to 35°C. b. Relative humidity not exceeding 80%. c. In an environment without vibration, corrosive media, and strong electromagnetic field interference. d. The fluctuation range of the power supply voltage should be within ±10% of the rated voltage. e. Installed horizontally on a solid base with a levelness of 0.2/1000.

4.3.1 Shearing Machine

According to the standard JB/T1826.1-1999 "Shearing Machine - Terms and Definitions", a shearing machine is a machine that uses a reciprocating linear motion of one blade relative to another blade to shear sheet metal; a pendulum shearing machine is a shearing machine with a swinging upper blade; a hydraulic shearing machine is a shearing machine driven by hydraulic power; a hydraulic pendulum shearing machine is a pendulum shearing machine driven by hydraulic power. JB/T1826-1991 "Shearing Machine - Types and Basic Parameters" specifies the types and basic parameters of shearing machines; JB/T5197.2-2015 "Shearing Machine - Part 2: Technical Conditions" specifies the technical requirements, test methods, inspection rules, packaging, transportation, storage, and manufacturer's guarantee for shearing machines; GB/T1440-2011 "Shearing Machine - Accuracy" specifies the accuracy inspection, allowable values of inspection accuracy, and inspection methods for shearing machines, applicable to general-purpose shearing machines (newly designed).

2) Pendulum-type shearing machine, see Figure 2 in JB/T1826-1991 (Figure 2 does not determine the structure of the shearing machine).

4) The instruction manual shall comply with GB/T 9969.

sections.text: (2) Type and Basic Parameters
The type and basic parameters of shearing machines shall comply with JB/T 1826. The blades for shearing machines shall comply with JB/T 1828.1 and JB/T 1828.2.
(3) Supporting Parts and Compatibility

1) The shearing machine shall be complete when it leaves the factory, and special accessories and spare consumable parts required for normal use and maintenance shall be provided. Special accessories shall be determined by the user and the manufacturer, and shall be supplied with the machine or ordered separately.

2) The manufacturer shall ensure that the purchased supporting parts of the shearing machine (including electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic components, etc.) have obtained the certificate of conformity and shall be tested for operation simultaneously with the main engine.
(4) Safety and Protection
The safety and protection of shearing machines shall comply with GB 28240.
(5) Structure and Performance
1) The rigidity of the shearing machine shall comply with the provisions of technical documents.
2) Other requirements for structure and performance are specified in JB/T 5197.2—2015.
(6) Nameplate

items: 1) The shearing machine shall have a nameplate and various signs and marks indicating lubrication, operation, safety and other requirements. The requirements for signs shall comply with GB/T 13306. The pictographic symbols on the nameplate shall comply with JB/T 3240.
2) The nameplate shall be fixed properly and firmly in an obvious and suitable position.

sections.text: (7) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts

1) Gray cast iron shall comply with JB/T 5775. Nodular cast iron shall comply with GB/T 1348. Cast carbon steel parts shall comply with GB/T 11352. Welded parts shall comply with JB/T 8609. Forgings and non-ferrous metal castings shall comply with the provisions of technical documents. Defects that do not affect use and appearance are allowed to be repaired according to the provisions of technical documents, provided that the quality is guaranteed. Composite parts used shall comply with the provisions of technical documents. Steel body copper lined composite parts shall comply with JB/T 11196.

2) The machine frame (left column, right column), upper knife frame, worktable (lower knife frame), connecting rod, large gear, flywheel, eccentric wheel, cylinder block, piston, main (crankshaft), adjusting screw rod, piston rod, blade, and reducer housing, etc. of important castings, forgings, and welded parts shall be subjected to stress relief treatment.
(8) Machining

items: 1) The machining of parts shall comply with the requirements of design and process technical documents. The machined surfaces shall not have burrs, spots, and other mechanical damage. Except for special requirements, sharp edges shall be blunted.

2) The machine frame, upper knife frame, main (crankshaft), piston rod, cylinder block, key, sliding pin, and crescent fork (brake knife) and other main friction pairs shall be provided with wear-resistant measures.
3) Other requirements for machining are specified in JB/T 5197.2—2015.

sections.text: (9) Electrical Equipment
The electrical equipment of the shearing machine shall comply with GB 5226.1.
(10) Hydraulic, Lubrication, and Pneumatic Systems

1) The hydraulic system of the shearing machine shall comply with GB/T 3766. Hydraulic components shall comply with GB/T 7935. The pneumatic system shall comply with GB/T 7932. The working parts shall not have crawling, stagnation, and vibration within the specified range, and there shall be no obvious impact phenomenon during commutation and depressurization.
2) The design, manufacture, and inspection of pressure vessels shall comply with the provisions of technical documents.

3) The shearing machine shall be equipped with a reliable lubrication device. The lubrication pipelines and lubrication points shall have corresponding signs to ensure that all rotating parts are properly lubricated.

Lubrication.
4) Leakage of oil and gas in hydraulic, lubrication, and pneumatic systems should not occur.
5) Oil on rotating parts should not be thrown out, and there should be an oil collection and recovery device for non-circulating thin oil lubrication parts.
(11) Assembly

items: The shearing machine should be assembled according to the assembly process specification. All components assembled on the shearing machine should meet quality requirements, and it is not allowed to install gaskets, sleeves, and other parts not specified in the drawing.

Within the same motion pair, the hardness of the replaceable guide rails should be lower than that of the non-replaceable guide rails; the hardness of small part guide rails should be lower than that of large part guide rails.
The cleanliness of the hydraulic system of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
Other assembly requirements are specified in JB/T 5197.2-2015.

sections.text: (12) Noise

The gear transmission mechanism, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic components of the shearing machine should produce uniform sound during operation, without irregular impact sounds and periodic sharp noises. The noise of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of GB 24389.
(13) Appearance

1) The outer surface of the shearing machine should not have protrusions, depressions, or roughness that are not specified in the drawing. The edges of the joint surfaces of components should be neat and uniform, and the allowable deviation should comply with the provisions of relevant standards.
2) Countersunk screws should not protrude from the outer surface of the part, positioning pins should generally protrude slightly from the outer surface of the part, and the protrusion value should be equal to the chamfer value; the end of the bolt should protrude beyond the nut, and the protrusion value should not be greater than 1/5 of its diameter; the exposed shaft end should protrude beyond the end face of its enclosing part, and the protrusion value should be approximately equal to the chamfer value.
3) The outer machined surfaces of the main components of the shearing machine should not have marks such as bumps, scratches, or rust.
4) The installation of various pipe and wiring systems should be neat and beautiful, and should not cause friction or collision with other components. The bent parts of the pipes should be smooth.
5) The painting of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of the technical documents.
4. Testing Method for Shearing Machine
(1) Basic Parameter Inspection

items: The basic parameter inspection of the shearing machine should be carried out under no-load conditions, and the basic parameters of the shearing machine should meet the design requirements.
For batch-produced standard shearing machines, sampling inspection is allowed, and the number of samples should not be less than 10%, and not less than one machine.

sections.text: 3) The allowable deviation of the shearing machine parameters should comply with the provisions of Table 4-136.

2. The rounding result of the deviation (length, angle, number of strokes) should be rounded off according to the provisions of GB/T 8170-2008 "Rules for Numerical Rounding and Representation and Determination of Limiting Values" to one decimal place.
3. When the number of strokes of the upper blade holder per minute is less than or equal to 5 times/min, the rounding result of the deviation should be rounded off according to the provisions of GB/T 8170-2008 to 0.5 units of the number of digits.

4) For basic parameters with dimensions not marked with tolerances, the maximum deviation for the dimension between two machined surfaces should be calculated according to the provisions of class m in GB/T 1804; for the dimension between two unmachined surfaces or where only one of them is machined, it should be calculated according to the provisions of class c in GB/T 1804 (excluding the thickness of putty film and paint film).
(2) Load Test

items: Each shearing machine should undergo a full-load test, and the number of tests should not be less than 2 times. During the full-load test, the thickness and length of the sheared plate should be equal to the maximum thickness and width that can be sheared, and metal plates with Rm of 450 MPa should be used. For batch-produced shearing machines, sampling inspection can be carried out according to 4.(1)2).

For new or updated products, overload test should be conducted during trial production and appraisal. The shearing machine with mechanical transmission should be tested at 120% of its shearing force, and the shearing machine with hydraulic transmission should be tested at no more than 110% of the rated pressure, and the number of tests should not be less than 3 times. During the overload test, the test can be carried out by shearing metal plates or loading with a loading device.

sections.text: 3) All mechanisms and working systems of the shearing machine should operate in a coordinated and reliable manner during the load test, and the overload protection device should be sensitive and reliable.
(3) Precision Inspection

items: The shearing machine should undergo precision inspection after the full-load test.
The precision inspection of the shearing machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 14404.

sections.text: Other tests, inspections, packaging, transportation and storage of shearing machine technical requirements shall comply with JB/T 5197.2—2015. The manufacturer's guarantee shall meet the requirements of JB/T 1829.
5. Accuracy Inspection Requirements for Shearing Machine
(1) General Requirements

items: The inspection conditions shall meet the requirements of power supply voltage fluctuation within ±10% and ambient temperature within 5~40°C.

Before the accuracy inspection of the shearing machine, its installation levelness shall be adjusted. Place the level gauge at the middle, left and right positions of the worktable along the longitudinal and transverse directions of the shearing machine. The readings of the level gauge shall not exceed 0.20/1000.
During the inspection process, the components and parts affecting accuracy shall not be adjusted.
The accuracy inspection and measuring tools for inspection shall comply with the relevant provisions of GB/T 10923.

When the actual measured length is less than the length specified in the tolerance, it shall be converted according to the actual measured length, and the converted result shall be rounded off to the number of micrometers according to GB/T 8170.

For the shearing machine with the upper tool holder making inclined reciprocating motion, the "parallelism of the vertical supporting surface in contact with the lower blade to the stroke of the upper tool holder" shall not be inspected.

For the swing-type shearing machine, the "parallelism of the vertical supporting surface in contact with the lower blade to the stroke of the upper tool holder" and the "parallelism of the vertical supporting surface in contact with the upper blade to the stroke of the upper tool holder" shall not be inspected.

sections.text: (2) Inspection Conditions for Working Accuracy

items: The length of the test piece shall comply with the provisions of Table 4-137.

3) The thickness of the test piece is half of the thickness that can be sheared by the shearing machine.
4) The material of the test piece is Q235A steel plate, and its tensile strength Rm ≤ 450MPa.
5) The number of test pieces shall not be less than 3 pieces.

6) When the length of the test piece is less than the shearing width of the shearing machine to be inspected, the test piece for working accuracy inspection shall be obtained at the left, middle and right positions within the shearing range of the shearing machine to be inspected respectively.
7) The inspection shall not be conducted within the length range of 10 times the thickness of the test piece from the end of the test piece.
8) The working accuracy shall be inspected after the full-load test.

When the upper tool holder moves downward, the measurement shall be carried out, and the error shall be calculated by the maximum reading difference of the indicator. sections.text: 4.3.2 CNC Shearing Machine

The CNC shearing machine is a shearing machine with the tool holder and/or the material blocking device controlled by the CNC system. GB/T 28762—2012 "CNC Shearing Machine" stipulates the terms and definitions, technical requirements, accuracy, test methods, inspection rules, marks, nameplates, packaging, transportation and storage of the CNC shearing machine, which is applicable to the CNC shearing machine. The shearing machine with the CNC feeding device can also be used for reference.
1. Technical Requirements
(1) General Requirements

items: 1) The drawings and technical documents of the CNC shearing machine shall comply with the provisions of GB/T 28762—2012 standard and technical documents, and shall be approved through the prescribed procedures before production.

2) When the CNC shearing machine leaves the factory, it shall ensure its integrity and be equipped with the necessary accessories and tools for normal use and maintenance; the special accessories shall be determined by the user and the manufacturer together and supplied with the machine or ordered separately. The purchased parts (including electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic components, etc.) shall comply with the provisions of the technical documents and must be tested together with the main machine.

3) The actions of the working mechanism and the operation and adjustment mechanism of the CNC shearing machine shall be accurate and coordinated; when an operation cycle is completed, the tool holder shall be reliably stopped at the upper dead point.

sections.text: 4) The operation of the handle, foot pedal device, etc. should be safe, flexible, and reliable.

5) When designing the CNC shearing machine, it should meet the requirements of two-shift operation and, under the condition of adhering to the usage rules, the service life before the first planned major overhaul should not be less than 5 years.

6) The instruction manual should comply with the provisions of GB/T 9969, and the content of the instruction manual should include requirements and explanations for installation, transportation, storage, use and maintenance, and safety.
(2) Parameters
The parameters of the CNC shearing machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T 1826 or the product technical documentation.
(3) Rigidity
The rigidity of the CNC shearing machine should comply with the provisions of the technical documentation.
(4) Safety and Protection
The safety and protection of the CNC shearing machine should comply with the requirements of GB 17120 and JB 8781 (already repealed).
(5) Castings, Forgings, and Welded Parts

items: Gray cast iron parts should comply with the provisions of JB/T 5775; nodular cast iron parts should comply with the provisions of GB/T 1348; welded parts should comply with the provisions of JB/T 8609; forgings and non-ferrous metal castings should comply with the provisions of JB/T 1829 and the technical documentation. For defects that do not affect usage and appearance, repair is allowed according to the provisions of the technical documentation under the condition of ensuring quality.

Important castings, forgings, and welded parts such as the machine frame, tool holder, worktable, cylinder body, piston, adjustment screw, piston rod, and blades should undergo stress relief treatment.

sections.text: (6) Machining of Parts

items: The machining of components should comply with the requirements of the design and process technical documentation. The machined surfaces should not have burrs, spots, or other mechanical damage. Except for special requirements, sharp edges should be chamfered.
Important sliding pairs such as the main guide rails, tool holder, cylinder body, and piston rod of the CNC shearing machine should take wear-resistant measures.
Other technical requirements for part machining can be found in GB/T 28762—2012.

sections.text: (7) Assembly

items: The CNC shearing machine should be assembled according to the assembly process specifications. The components assembled onto the CNC shearing machine should all meet quality requirements. It is not allowed to assemble gaskets, sleeves, and other parts that are not specified in the drawings.
Other technical requirements for assembly can be found in GB/T 28762—2012.

sections.text: (8) Electrical Equipment and CNC System

items: The electrical equipment of the CNC shearing machine should comply with the provisions of GB 5226.1.

The CNC system should comply with the provisions of JB/T 8832 (already repealed). The mean time between failures of the CNC system should not be less than 5000 hours, and should have the following basic functions: ① Single-direction positioning function.

sections.text: ② Function to limit the range within which the CNC axis can move. ③ Function to accept compensation data and correct errors. ④ Function to automatically retreat control. ⑤ Safe area settings should be reserved for the minimum and maximum stroke positions of the back gauge. The back gauge should run at low speed within the safe area. ⑥ Function to record the number of processed parts, and the counting direction should be selectable. ⑦ After counting is completed, the processing can be done using one of the following methods: a. Stop the machine when the count reaches the set value (increment counter). b. Stop the machine when the count reaches 0 (decrement counter). ⑧ Function to automatically find the reference point, and the speed of finding the reference point should be low. ⑨ Provide teaching function to replace the operation of finding the reference point. ⑩ At least manual and automatic operation modes should be available. ⑪ After a power outage, the CNC system should be able to save processing-related data. ⑫ Provide a method to monitor the status of digital I/O ports. ⑬ At least provide a diagnostic method for the following system components: a. Input ports. b. Output ports. c. Keys. d. Display components (LED, LCD). e. Data storage.
(9) Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems

items: The hydraulic system of the CNC shearing machine should comply with the provisions of GB/T 3766, hydraulic components should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7935, and the pneumatic system should comply with the provisions of GB/T 7932.
The working parts should not have crawling, stagnation, or vibration within the specified range, and there should be no obvious impact phenomenon during commutation and depressurization.
For hydraulic systems with proportional or servo valves, a high-pressure oil filter should be installed at the outlet of the hydraulic pump.
There should be no oil or air leakage in the hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
The cleanliness of the hydraulic system of the CNC shearing machine should comply with the provisions of JB/T 9954.
The oil temperature at the inlet of the hydraulic pump should not exceed 60°C.

sections.text: (10) Lubrication System

items: The CNC shearing machine should have a reliable lubrication device. The lubrication points of the lubrication pipeline should have corresponding numbered signs to ensure that each moving part receives normal lubrication. The lubrication system should comply with the provisions of GB/T 6576.

The lubrication of important friction parts should generally adopt a centralized lubrication system. Only when a centralized lubrication system cannot be used can a dispersed lubrication device be adopted. Dispersed lubrication should have a separate lubrication label, and the label should indicate the lubrication parts.
There should be no oil leakage in the lubrication system.
Oil should not be thrown out from rotating parts. For non-circulating thin oil lubrication parts, an oil collection and recovery device should be provided.

638.page_header: Chapter 4  Hydraulic Cylinder Design and Selection for Hydraulic Press (Machine)  627

sections.text: (11) Noise

The gear transmission mechanism, electrical, hydraulic components and other parts of the CNC shearing machine should produce uniform sound during operation, without irregular impact sounds and periodic screaming sounds. The noise should comply with the provisions of GB 24389.
(12) Appearance

items: The outer surface of the CNC shearing machine should not have protrusions, depressions or rough unevenness that are not specified in the pattern. The edges of the joint surfaces of parts should be neat and uniform, and the allowable deviation and tolerance of the gap of the cover should comply with the provisions of GB/T 28762-2012 standard.
The protective cover of the CNC shearing machine should be flat and uniform, without warping or depression.

The countersunk screws should not protrude from the outer surface of the parts. The locating pins should generally protrude slightly from the outer surface of the parts, with the protrusion value being approximately equal to the chamfer value. The end of the bolt should protrude beyond the nut, and the protrusion value should not be greater than 1/5 of its diameter; The exposed end of the shaft should protrude from the end face of its enclosing member, with the protrusion value being approximately equal to the chamfer value of the shaft end.
Adjustment bolts and nuts that need to be frequently tightened, as well as non-metallic pipes, should not be painted.

The non-machined metal outer surfaces should be painted or protected by other methods. The painting should comply with the provisions of the technical documents, the paint film should be flat, the color should be uniform, clean, without obvious protruding particles and adhesions, and there should be no obvious depressions, sandpaper marks, sagging, bubbles, whitening or loss of gloss. The paint layer on the joint surface of the assembled parts must be firm and have clear boundaries, with clear and neat edge lines. The dividing line between paints of different colors should be clear. After painting, the joint surface of the detachable assembly joint should be cut open, and the edge should not be torn during cutting. For parts whose surfaces have been treated for rust prevention (such as bluing, chrome plating, nickel plating, galvanizing, spraying, etc.), no painting is allowed on the surface.
The exposed weld seams should be straight and uniform.

The installation of pipes and lines for various systems should be neat and beautiful, and fixed with pipe clamps. They should not rub or collide with other parts. The bent part of the pipe should be smooth and meet the requirements of its minimum bending radius.
The machined outer surfaces of the main parts of the CNC shearing machine should not have bumps, scratches, or rust marks.

3. Test methods
(1) General requirements
The general requirements for the testing of CNC shearing machines are shown in GB/T 28762-2012.
(2) Parameter inspection

items: The main parameters should be inspected by the method of shearing steel plates, which should comply with 1.(2) or the provisions of the product design documents.
The basic parameters should be measured with general measuring tools, which should comply with 1.(2) or the provisions of the product design documents.
For CNC shearing machines produced in batches, sampling inspection is allowed, and the number of inspection per batch should not be less than 3.
